sanskrit: rbhāvaireva manoharaiśca caraṇābjaikaprasādālayam jñānānandagirirmaheśacaraṇābjaikaprasādālayaḥ tāṃ namāmi mahādevīṃ bāṇīṃ vāgvibhavapradām yāmalaṃ śaktisaṃjñañca bhāvacūḍāmaṇiṃ tathā kulasāraṃ kuloḍḍīśaṃ kulāmṛtakulārṇavam kālītantrakulānandaṃ kulacakraṃ tathaiva ca samayākhya kālītantraṃ phetkārīṃ pheravīṃ tathā svatantraṃ tantrarājañca jñānamālāṃ tataḥ param mantranirṇayatantrañca yoginīhṛdayaṃ tathā śivaśāsanatantrañca mandaraṃ plāvanīṃ tathā nīlatantraṃ matsyasūktaṃ lalitātantrameva ca vaṭukasaṃhitāñcaiva tārārṇavaṃ tataḥ param samayākhyaṃ tantrasāraṃ tato mantravimarśinīm bhairavākhyaṃ mahātantraṃ siddhasārasvataṃ tataḥ chinnātantraṃ vātulañca dakṣiṇāmūrttisaṃhitām guruṇāñca mataṃ jñātvā sārātsārataraṃ mahat atiyatnena goptavyaṃ mātṛmaithunavat sadā p. 4) na dadyāt paraśiṣyāya vañcakāya tathaiva ca prakṛtācārayuktāya gurusevāparāya ca śiṣyāya bhaktiyuktāya sādhakāya pradāpayet sa bhakṣyo yoginīvṛndairmṛte ca narakaṃ vrajet pustakaṃ vīkṣya yo mūḍho na labdho guruvaktrataḥ tasya karmāṇi sarvāṇi narakāya bhavanti hi tasmājjñātvā gurorvaktrāt sādhane yatnamācaret sarvajñaḥ sarvakartā ca sarveśo nirmalodayaḥ

nirguṇaḥ saccidānandastadaṃśā jīvasaṃjñakāḥ sarvepyupādhisaṃbhinnāste karmabhiranādibhiḥ sukṛtairmānavo bhūtvā jñānī cenmokṣamāpnuyāt na mānuṣyaṃ vinā'nyatra tattvajñānantu labhyate kadācillabhate janturmānuṣyaṃ puṇyasañcayāt yastārayati nātmānaṃ tasmāt pāpataro'tra kaḥ na vettātmahitaṃ yastu sa bhavedātmaghātakaḥ tasmād dehadhanaṃ rakṣan puṇyakarmāṇi sādhayet jñānino'jñānino vāpi yāvad dehasya rakṣaṇam karmaṇonmīlite jñāne jñānena śivatāṃ vrajet sarvakarmāṇi santyaktuṃ na śakyaṃ dehadhāriṇā ahambhāvamapāsyaivaṃ yaḥ kuryāt sa na lipyate kriyamāṇāni karmāṇi jñānaprāpteranantaram tattvaniṣṭhasya karmāṇi puṇyāpuṇyāṇi saṃkṣayam utpannasahajānandatattvajñānarataḥ sadā vṛthaiva yaiḥ parityaktaṃ karmakāṇḍamapaṇḍitaiḥ phalaṃ prāpya yathā vṛkṣaḥ puṣpaṃ tyajati nispṛhaḥ aśvamedhaśatenāpi brahmahatyāśatena ca pṛthivyāṃ yāni karmāṇi jihvopasthanimittataḥ āgamotthaṃ vivekotthaṃ dvidhā jñānaṃ pracakṣate advaitaṃ kecidicchanti dvaitamicchanti cāpare dve pade bandhamokṣāya mameti nirmameti ca vidyā'vidyādvayoryogāt pakṣadvayamudīritam yanna bandhāya tat karma sā vidyā parikīrttitā yāvattadeva naivāsti tāvadeva hi mokṣaṇam

tāvadeva hi sarvañca yāvattattvaṃ na vindati tattvaniṣṭho bhaveccaiva yadīcchenmokṣamātmanaḥ yathāvidhi gurorvaktrādvidyāṃ saṃgṛhya sādhanam anyathā na bhajeditthaṃ karotyāpatparamparā prātarutthāya śirasi sahasradalapaṅkaje dhyāyennijaguruṃ dhīro rajatācalasannibham śuklamālyāmbaradharaṃ varadābhayapāṇikam priyayā savyahastena dhṛtacārukalevaram jñānānandasamāyuktaṃ smarettannāmapūrvakam gandhaṃ bhūmyātmakaṃ dadyād bhāvapuṣpaṃ tataḥ param naivedyamamṛtaṃ dadyāt pānīyaṃ varuṇātmakam darśayitvā yonimudrāṃ gurumantraṃ japettataḥ vahniyuktāṃstridhā likhya ādyadīrghatrayānvitān athārādhyapadaṃ caiva sarvamūrdhvapadaṃ tataḥ śrīgurunāthaśabdānte sahakṣamalavarānilān piṇḍīkṛtaṃ likhedādyaṃ caturthañca tato likhet tataḥ śrīśambhugurvante punarādyaṃ samālikhet catvāriṃśanmārgavarṇairmaṇḍito'yaṃ gurormanuḥ dakṣakarṇayuto gauro vahnirudreṇa bhūṣitaḥ gakāraḥ siddhidaḥ prokto rephaḥ pāpasya hārakaḥ gurorvāmakare tattu samarpyātha stutiṃ paṭhet cakṣurunmīlitaṃ yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ tatpadaṃ darśitaṃ yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ iti yasyājñayā tasmāttasya śrīpādukāsmṛtiḥ namāmīdṛgrūpaṃ paramagururūpaṃ sakaruṇam

yasya śrīpadapaṅkajodbhavasudhā siddhaiḥ sadā pīyate prasādato yasya mayā pralabdhaṃ savāsanājñānavināśabījam so'yaṃ guruḥ śirasi śuklasarojamadhye pravande sānandaṃ tamapi gururūpaṃ sakaruṇam yadi syācceto me niravadhi guroḥpādakamalam dhyāyet kuṇḍalinī śaktiṃ mūlādhāranivāsinīm suptāhisādṛśākārāṃ sārdhatrivalayānvitām samutthāpya mahādevīṃ prāṇamantreṇa sādhakaḥ sthāpayitvā ca tasyordhvaṃ dhyāyet kulagurūn kramāt kumārānandanāthañca vaśiṣṭhānandanāthakam bodhānandamathābhyarcya krameṇānena sādhakaḥ parāliṅganasambhinnacūrṇitāśeṣatāmasān varābhayakarāśeṣakulatattvārthavedinaḥ evaṃ kulagurūn natvā'mṛtavṛṣṭiṃ vidhāya ca tasyāḥ prabhāsamūhaiśca vyāptaṃ dehaṃ vibhāvayet saccidānandarūpo'hamityātmānaṃ vibhāvayet namaskuryāt prayatnena kulaṃ kulapatiṃ tathā nameruśca piyālaśca sindhuvārakadambakau athavā kulavṛkṣāṃśca kathayāmi susiddhaye vilvo vaṭoḍumbaraśca ciñceti daśamī smṛtā na svapet kulavṛkṣādho na copadravamācaret kāmabījaṃ kāmadevaṃ sarvānte janamālikhet dantādikaṃ viśudhyātha svakalpoktaṃ samācaret tasya pūjā tu viphalā śaucahīnā yathā kriyā iti śrīmajjñānānandaparamahaṃsaviracite kaulāvalīnirṇaye prathamollāsaḥ

yathāvidhi jalaṃ prāpya ātmānaṃ devatālayam unmajya tata utthāya kuladarbhaṃ vidhārayet tatra śāktaiḥ svayaṃ grāhyaṃ na ca vanyāḥ kuśāḥ kuśāḥ eṣa eva bhaveddarbho na darbho vanasambhavaḥ tasmāddūrvā grahītavyā sarvapuṣpamayī yataḥ ācāmedātmatattvādyaiḥ praṇavādyaiḥ svadhāntikaiḥ mastakāni spṛśen mantrī kuryācchrotrākṣibandhanam mūlānte cātmatattvāya vidyātattvāya tatparam svāhāntamadbhirācāmet pūrvottaramukhaḥ sudhīḥ ebhiḥ saṅkalpya vīrendraḥ samantraṃ vāriṇi nyaset sañjapya daśadhā mūlaṃ tattoyaṃ mūrdhni saṃkṣipet aṅgulībhirmukhaṃ śrotraṃ nāsāṃ netre ca rodhayan tilakaṃ mūlamantreṇa śikhāñca parikalpayet gṛhītvā vāmahaste tu jalaṃ dakṣiṇapāṇinā kṣauṇīvaruṇabījañca trivāramabhimantrayet svamūrdhni ca kṣipettoyaṃ śeṣaṃ dakṣe nidhāya ca tata uttolya dehasthaṃ pāpaṃ prakṣālya vāmayā prakṣālya hastayugalamācamettadanantaram prakāśaśaktiyuktāya arghyaṃ svāhā tato vadet vibhāvya purato yantraṃ tatra devīṃ gaṇānvitām tarpayed devatāvaktre vidhivat sādhakottamaḥ dvitīyāntāmahaṃ paścāt tarpayāmi namaḥ padam guruṃ saparivārañca āyudhaṃ vāhanaṃ tathā dhyātvā sāvaraṇāṃ devīṃ sūryamaṇḍalavāsinīm śivacaitanya tasyānte mayyai svāheti saṃsmaran

mudrayā hṛdi saṃsthāpya jalādutthāya sādhakaḥ mokṣārthī raktavastreṇa bhogārthī śvetavāsasā uccāṭane vyāghracarmaṃ vṛkṣatvak śubhakarmaṇi prakṣālya hastapādau ca pūjāsthānaṃ samāviśet snānatarpaṇaśūnyasya nādhikāraśca pūjane vinā snānena yā pūjā viphalā siddhihānidā ekaliṅge śmaśāne ca śūnyāgāre catuṣpathe ujjaṭe nirjane vāpi bhūgṛhe devatālaye haṭṭāgāre nijāgāre paśudṛṣṭivivarjite niśchidramaṇḍape vāpi kartavyaṃ pūjanaṃ sadā pañcakośāntare yatra na liṅgāntaramīkṣate catuṣpathaṃ vijānīyāt yatrāste caṇḍikāśilā dvāradeśe tato gatvā pūjayeddāradevatāḥ siddhārthākṣatadūrvābhistilamiśraiḥ susādhakaḥ ye bhūtā vighnakartāraste naśyantu śivājñayā kulabhūtaṃ samutsārya yāgabhūmiṃ tato viśet rekhācatuṣṭayaṃ kāryaṃ indravāruṇayogataḥ indrāgniyāmyanair-ṛtyapratīcyāṃ pañcavargakam lakṣau kramāt samālikhya sādhakaḥ siddhihetave pūrvādīśānaparyantaṃ ṣoḍaśasvaramālikhet kṣetrādyarṇastu yatrāste śīrṣaṃ tasya viniścitam nirdhano jāyate patsu pārśvayorvyādhireva ca kūrmacakraṃ vinā yo hi japahomaṃ samācaret pañcaśuddhivihīnena yatkṛtaṃ na ca tat kṛtam pañcaśuddhiṃ vinā pūjā abhicārāya kalpate

mantraśuddhirdevaśuddhiḥ pañcaśuddhiritīritā sāmānyārghyaṃ tataḥ kuryāt prokṣaṇārthaṃ ca sādhakaḥ ādhāraṃ sthāpayettatra saṃpūjya vahnimaṇḍalam sūryamaṇḍalamuccārya hṛnmantreṇa prapūjayet indumaṇḍalamabhyarcya prakṣiped gandhapuṣpake agnīśāsuravāyavyamadhye dikṣvaṅgapūjanam astrāntamūlamuccārya ātmānaṃ yāgabhūmiṣu praṇavaṃ bhagavatyeva dharaṇīṃ ṅeyutāṃ vadet brahāṇaṃ pūjayitvā ca puruṣaṃ vāstusaṃjñakam vitānaṃ dhūpadīpādyaiḥ puṣpamālā'bhiśobhitam vilikhya maṇḍalaṃ bhūmau pūrvavat sādhakāgraṇīḥ athāsanaṃ pravakṣyāmi śāktānāṃ sthitikāmyayā viṣṭare vā samāsīnaḥ sādhayet siddhimuttamām cūḍopanayanairhīnaṃ mṛdumacūḍakaṃ viduḥ yo mṛtaḥ pañcame varṣe tameva komalaṃ viduḥ tāvat kālaṃ nārakī syād yāvadāhūtasaṃplavam kauśeyaṃ bhogadaṃ raktakambalaṃ siddhidaṃ smṛtam ūrṇā duḥkhaharī proktā jñānasiddhirmṛgājine kāṣṭhāsanaṃ na kurvīta yatra daurbhāgyavān bhavet manoharaṃ mṛdu ślakṣṇamāsanaṃ parikīrtitam sāmānyārghyasya toyena puṭāñjalividhānataḥ kūrmo'dhidevatā cātra āsanasthāpanāya ca pṛthvi tvayā dhṛtā lokā devipadaṃ tato vadet nityaṃ pavitraṃ kuru ca āsanañca samuccaret ādhāraśaktiṃ saṃprocya ṅeyutaṃ kamalāsanam

āsane saṃviśet paścāt vīrāsanena sādhakaḥ kuryādṛjuvapurgrīvaḥ śarīraṃ ṛjuvaccaret kāmākhyādiṅmukhaḥ susthaḥ prāṅmukho vā prapūjayet iti te kathito hyatra āsanavidhiḥ pūjane stasya śrīrnetrapadme vilasati satataṃ vaktra candre ca vāṇī devatāgurubhaktābhiḥ sañcitaṃ yāgabhūmiṣu karpūrāgurudhūpādivāsitaṃ paṭavāsitam sarvālaṅkārabhūṣābhirbhūṣitaḥ sādhakottamaḥ sarvaṃ svadakṣiṇe sthāpya vāme kumbhaṃ niveśayet naivedyaṃ dakṣiṇe vāme purato vā na pṛṣṭhataḥ dīpaṃ dakṣiṇato dadyāt purato vā na vāmataḥ nivedayet purobhāge gandhapuṣpādibhūṣaṇam aṅgasaṃspṛṣṭamāghrātaṃ tyajet puṣpaṃ sadā budhaḥ raktamarghyaṃ śvetadūrvāṃ nīlakaṇṭhaṃ kuruṇṭakam sugandhiśvetalauhityakusumairarcayet kuśaiḥ patrairna cārcayed devīṃ vilvapatravivarjitaiḥ javābandhūkamandāraiḥ sindūraiśca mahotpalaiḥ nandyāvarttaṃ tilapatraṃ tathā keśarapatrakam nānopahārabalibhirnānāpuṣpaimanoharaiḥ kulapuṣpeṇa dhūpena kuladīpena tāṃ sudhīḥ na dadyānmālatīpuṣpaṃ tārākālīprapūjakaḥ na paryuṣitadoṣo'sti jalajotpalacampake nijadevasya puṣpāṇi pṛthakpātre nidhāpayet naivedyādīni sarvāṇi tathā jānīhi niścitam pūjāphalaṃ na cāpnoti narakaṃ pratipadyate

hastaprakṣālanācchaucamācāmastu tadācaret saṃsthāpya vāmabhāge tu śaktiṃ svāmiparāyaṇām vinā śaktyā tu yā pūjā viphalā nātra saṃśayaḥ yā śaktiḥ sā mahādevī hararūpastu sādhakaḥ prāṇaṃ binā yathā dehī spandituṃ naiva śakyate vinā dravyādhivāsena na japenna smaret sadā na pūjāṃ na japaṃ kuryānna dhyānaṃ na ca cintanam satyametad vijānīyādvākyaṃ śaṅkarabhāṣitam na bhuktvā ca na pītvā ca na smarenna japettadā ānandena vinā yastu caṇḍikāṃ paripūjayet tasmādādau prakarttavyaṃ samvidāsavayojanam vijayāgrahaṇaṃ kṛtvā dhyānaṃ yaḥ kurute naraḥ samvitprayogasteneha pūjādau sādhakottamaiḥ tasyā bhedaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathārthaṃ tantravartmanā vaiśyā pītaprasūnā ca śūdrā kṛṣṇaprasūnikā samvide brahmasambhūte brahmaputri sadānaghe oṃ brahmāṇyai namaḥ svāhā brahmāṇīṃ śodhayediti rājaprajāvaśaṅkari śatru kaṇṭhatriśūlini ajñānendhanadīptāgne jñānāgne jñānarūpiṇi hrīṁ vaiśyāyai namaḥ svāhā śūdrāṃ saṃśodhayedatha trailokyavijaye mātaḥ samādhiphaladā bhava oṃ amṛte amṛtodbhave amṛtavarṣiṇi padantataḥ trailokyaṃ me tato brūyādvaśamānaya tatparam hasakṣamalavarayūṁ hasarauñca tataḥ param anayorekatareṇaiva viśodhya vijayāṃ tataḥ

āvāhanyādimudrāñca dhenuyoniñca darśayet divyadṛṣṭyā padāghātairvighnāṃśca vinivārayet tattvamudrāvidhānena hṛdi devīṃ gaṇānvitām gṛhītvā vāmahastena paṭhedamuṃ manuṃ tataḥ mama jihvāgre sthireti bhava sarvapadaṃ likhet svīkuryāt sādhakaśreṣṭho mumukṣuḥ prasamīkṣayā dugdhaghṛtamadhusurāvarṇānāmanupānakam kramāt saṃsevanīyā ca siddhidā siddhimūlikā yathā yathā na hi bhavet prākaṭyaṃ paśumelake na pituḥ sannidhāne vā na mātuḥ sannidhau tathā kulapuṣpaṃ kuladravyaṃ kulapūjāṃ kulaṃ japam kulacakraṃ kuladhyānaṃ sarvathā na prakāśayet prakāśānmantranāśaḥ syāt prakāśāddevahiṃsanam pūjākāle tu saṃprāpte yadi ko'pyatra gacchati prakāśādyadi guptiḥ syāttatprakāśaṃ na dūṣaṇam varaṃ pūjā na kartavyā na ca vyaktiḥ kadācana tāmbūlapūritamukho dhūpāmodasugandhitaḥ astreṇa gandhapuṣpābhyāṃ surabhīkṛtahastakaḥ nirmañchanaṃ tridhā kṛtvā astreṇa vāmapāṇinā aṅguṣṭhāgre tu tarjanyā saṃyojyādhordhvarekhayā dhyātvā guruṃ nyasedvāme dakṣiṇe gaṇapatiṃ tathā pārṣṇighātakarāsphoṭa samudañcitavakrakaiḥ prāṇāyāmairvinā yasya japahomārcanādikāḥ japasya purataḥ kāryaṃ prāṇāyāmaṃ samāhitaiḥ ṛtucandrairvedarasairnetrarāmairyathākramam

vāmā ca madhyamā caiva tathā dakṣiṇanāḍibhiḥ prāṇāyāmaḥ sa vijñeyastarjanīmadhyame vinā uccārayaṃstu praṇavaṃ vāmenaikena mantravit prāṇāyāmo bhavatyevaṃ pūrako dehapūrakaḥ sampūrṇakumbhavattiṣṭhet prāṇāyāma sa kumbhakaḥ niśvāsayogayuktastu vāyuṃ vāhyena recayet jānupradakṣiṇīkṛtya na drutaṃ na vilambitam tato dvādaśamātrābhiḥ pūrakaḥ kriyate budhaiḥ tasmād dviguṇamātrābhiḥ kriyate kumbhakastathā liṅgaṃ kāryaṃ hṛdisthaṃ tu caitanyaṃ sarvasākṣiṇam tenaiva saṃpuṭīkṛtya mastakopari vinyaset nābhimaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ vāyumaṇḍalamadhyagam agnimaṇḍalasaṃsthena raṃbījenāgnirūpiṇā bhrūmadhyasthaṃ hṛdisthaṃ vā dhyāyedvaruṇamaṇḍalam tatrasthena vakāreṇa plāvayenmadhurūpiṇā praṇavena dvidhākṛtya tatra caitanyarūpiṇā amṛtaplāvitaḥ piṇḍaḥ sa martyo dhautakalmaṣaḥ prāṇāyāmañca kathitaṃ bhūtaśuddhiṃ tathāparam prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā bhūtaśuddhiṃ tataścaret tāvattadviphalaṃ sarvaṃ prakāśenāpyanuṣṭhitam nyāsajālaṃ vṛthā tasya pūjā sā viphalā bhavet mūlādhārāttataḥ prāṇaṃ brahmamārgeṇa tāntrikaḥ saṃhārakramayogena pañcatattvaṃ samuddharet anena vidhinā mantrī bhūtaśuddhiṃ samācaret svadehe devatājīvaṃ vinyasettadanantaram

jīvanyāse manuḥ prokto jīvanyāseṣu yojayet kramāt prāṇā iha prāṇāstathā jīva iha sthitaḥ vāṅmanonayanaśrotraghrāṇaprāṇapadānyatha athavā pāśabījañca lajjā cāṅkuśameva ca jīvanyāsamanuḥ prokto jīvanyāseṣu yojayet ṣaḍaṅgānāñca mudrāñca sthānañca mantramucyate hṛdi maste śikhāyāñca kavace locanāstrake ṛṣiśchandaśca saṃyuktaṃ devatābījaśaktikam śirovadanahṛdguhyapādasarvāṅgake nyaset pañcāśadakṣaranyāse yadviśeṣastaducyate tarjanīmadhyamānāmā vṛddhānāmā ca netrayoḥ madhyāstisro gaṇḍayośca madhyamāmoṣṭhayornyaset mukhe'nāmāṃ madhyamāñca haste pāde ca pārśvayoḥ tāḥ sāṅguṣṭhā nābhideśe sarvāḥ kukṣau ca vinyaset hatpūrvaṃ hastapat kukṣimukheṣu talameva ca ajñātvā vinyasedyastu nyāsaḥ syāttasya niṣphalaḥ omādyantyo namo'nto vā sabindurbinduvarjitaḥ athavā kevalaṃ sargabinduyuktāṃ kalānvitām śaktipūrvāṃ śriyā yuktāṃ sudhāsyāṃ vā tanau nyaset ajapā paramātmā ca dviṭhaprapañcayāgakaḥ yasya yatra rucirgacchettadrūpāttattanau ca tām spṛṣṭvā vānāmayā vāpi manasā vā nyasedbudhaḥ prāṇāyāmādibhirnyāsaiḥ ātmaśuddhiśca jāyate iti śrīmajjñānānandaparamahaṃsaviracite kaulāvalīnirṇaye dvitīyollāsaḥ antaryāgavidhiṃ kṛtvā bahiryāgaṃ samācaret

bahiryāgaphalaṃ nāsti vināntaryajanaṃ kadā śivaśaktisamāyogāt sudhāvṛṣṭiṃ vidhāya ca mūlādhāre samānīya so'haṃ sañcintayettataḥ yadvāntaryajanaṃ vakṣye sādhakasya susiddhaye ratnadvīpaṃ tu tanmadhye suvarṇabālukāmayam tatra kalpadrumaṃ dhyāyet pañcāśadakṣarātmakam udyadādityasaṅkāśaṃ vyāptaṃ brahmāṇḍamaṇḍalam caturdvārasamāyuktaṃ hemaprākāraśobhitam mandavāyusamākrāntaṃ gandhadhūpairalaṅkṛtam suvarṇasūtraracitaṃ cintayecchatramuttamam pādyapātratrayaṃ kuryādarghyapātratrayaṃ tathā ekaṃ tu bhogapātraṃ tu sādhakaḥ ṣoḍaśe dale pīṭhapūjāṃ tataḥ kuryāt svakalpoktavidhāntaḥ sravantamamṛtaṃ nityaṃ divyāṅgakamalāntare svasvarūpāṃ samāvāhya parivāragaṇaiḥ saha āsanaṃ svāgataṃ pṛṣṭvā kuśalaṃ tadanantaram sahasradalabhṛṅgārāllambikānālavicyutam svarṇapātre jalaṃ kṛtvā dadyādācamanaṃ mukhe caturviṃśatitattvena gandhaṃ dadyādvicakṣaṇaḥ saptāṣṭabhāvapuṣpaiśca saṃpūjya dhūpadīpakam tarpayecca tridhā devīṃ yathoktavidhinā tataḥ pūjayitvā prayatnena snānīyaṃ dāpayedyathā tatra devīṃ samānīya nānāgandhasamanvitam dattvā devyai prayatnena snānīyaṃ dāpayettataḥ nānātīrthajalenaiva snāpayet paradevatām

nayane tejasastattvaṃ proñchayettena vai tanum vidhivadvandanaṃ kṛtvā keśasaṃskāramācaret paṭṭagucchaṃ keśapāśe nānāratnasamākulam nāgendradantaracitaṃ śaṅkhaṃ dadyānmanoharam pādāṅgurīyakaṃ dadyānnānāratnopaśobhitam śiroratnaṃ pradadyācca mukuṭaṃ ratnanirmitam nayane kajjalaṃ dadyānnāsāgre gajamauktikam ānandahāratritayaṃ aṅgurīyakaratnakam kāñcanāñcitakañcūlīmalaktaṃ radanacchade maṇḍapeṣu samānīya ratnanirmitadolayā gandhādikaṃ tato dattvā bhāvapuṣpaiḥ prapūjayet amohakamadambhañca adveṣākṣobhakau tathā ahiṃsā paramaṃ puṣpaṃ puṣpamindriyanigraham iti pañcadaśairbhāvapuṣpaiḥ saṃpūjayecchivām aparāñca kadambañca pārijātādikaṃ tathā sumekhalāṃ padmamālāṃ puṣpaṃ nānāvidhaṃ tathā kuṇḍagolodbhavañcaiva dhūpaṃ dadyāt samīraṇam mūlādhāre varttirūpaṃ cidagniḥ syāt pradīpakam anāhatadhvanimayīṃ ghaṇṭāmetāṃ nivedayet sūryañca darpaṇañcandramaṇḍalaṃ chatramuttamam supakvañcarukañcaiva ghṛtāktaṃ paramānnakam dadyāccheṣārghyaṃtoyena punarācamanīyakam rajaḥsattvaguṇāḍhyañca karpūracūrṇāmiśritam tarpayitvā punardevīṃ pūjayeccāṅgadevatāḥ vidhivat pūjanaṃ kṛtvā tarpayettadanantaram

puṣpaśayyāñca saṃskuryāttatra devīṃ sureśvarīm gītairnānāvidhairdevīṃ toṣayet sādhakottamaḥ manasyaikyaṃ vibhāvyātha sādhakaḥ siddhibhāg bhavet raktapadmasahasrāṇi manasā yaḥ prayacchati sthitvā devīpure śrīmān tato rājā kṣitau bhavet yo naro bhaktisaṃyuktaḥ sa dīrghāyuḥ sukhībhavet devīgṛhe vaset so'pi narakāṇi na paśyati so'pi lokān vijityāśu śivaloke mahīyate gurudhyānaṃ prakurvīta yathāpūrvaṃ viśāladhīḥ bindutīrthe'thavā snāyāt punarjanma na vidyate kiṃ tasya gāṅgairapi puṣkarairvā śivaśaktyoḥ samāyogo yasminkāle pravartate candrārkānalasaṃghaṭṭādgalitaṃ yat parāmṛtam tarpaṇaṃ kathitaṃ divyamarghyasādhanamucyate kalāsāreṇa saṃpūrya tarpayettena khecarīm hakṣau kodaṇḍamadhye nyasatu vimaladhīrnyāsasampattisiddhau ṣaḍaṅgamatha kuryāttu yena devīmayo bhavet kriyate tat paratvena hṛnmantreṇa tataḥ param kriyate viṣayāhāraḥ śiromantreṇa deśikaiḥ kriyate nijadehasya śikhāmantreṇa deśikaiḥ sarvato mantravarṇena kriyate tasya saṃvṛtiḥ hṛdayādimayaṃ tejaḥ syādetannetrasaṃjñitam avidyājātamantraṃ tat paraṃ dhāma samīritam śaktidvayapuṭāntaḥsthahalakṣatrayasaṃsthitam atha śṛṅgāṭamadhyasthaśaktidvayapuṭīkṛtam

kiraṇasthaṃ tadagrasthaṃ candrabhāskaramadhyagam nirālambe pade śūnye yatteja upajāyate atha pūjāṃ pravakṣyāmi yathātantrānusārataḥ nyāsastanmayatābuddhiḥ so'haṃbhāvena pūjayet atha vakṣye japaṃ tatra padmasthavarṇamālayā grathitā kuṇḍalīśaktiḥ kalānte merusaṃsthitiḥ anulomavilomābhyāṃ yathāśakti japañcaret stutibhiḥ sakalaṃ tatra samarpaṇaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ātmānamaparicchinnaṃ jñātavyaṃ sādhakottamaiḥ etadrūpantu cit kuṇḍaṃ caturasraṃ vibhāvayet ardhamātrāyonirūpaṃ brahmānandamayaṃ bhavet samvidagnau huneddhavyaṃ sādhakaḥ sthiramānasaḥ akṣarāṇi hutānyatra niḥśabdaṃ brahma jāyate dharmādharmau sādhakendro havistvena prakalpayet nābhimaṇḍalacaitanyarupāgnau manasā śrucā vahnijāyāntamantreṇa dadyācca prathamāhutim suṣumnāvartmanā nityamakṣavṛttīrjuhomyamaham prakāśākāśahastābhyāmavalambyonmanīśrucā vahnijāyāntamantreṇa tṛtīyāmāhutiñcaret viśvaṃ juhomi vasudhādiśi vāvasānam pūrṇāhutimaye vahnau pūrṇahomaṃ juhomyaham ityantaryajanaṃ kṛtvā sākṣādbrahmamayo bhavet mahāntaryajanaṃ vakṣye brahmayajñasvarūpakam manasā ca mano dṛṣṭvā yathā sindhugatā nadī yajñakarttā mahāyogī sarvamantraṃ japet punaḥ

karmayajño manoyajñaḥ prāṇayajño hutāśanaḥ brahmārpaṇaṃ brahmahavirbrahmāgnau brahmaṇā hutam brahmavat sarvamārgeṣu sarvakarma samabhyaset eṣāmanyatamaṃ kṛtvā yantrarājaṃ samālikhet gaṇḍakītīrapāṣāṇe tathaiva rucipīṭhake yadvā suvarṇarūpyādau tāmre vā darpaṇe tathā gomayena ca saṃlipte bhūpradeśe manorame śuddhe same bhūrjapatre athavānye tāmrapaṭṭake ratne vā kulaśaktau vā yantraṃ kuryāt susādhakaḥ svayambhu kusumaṃ kuṇḍagolotthaṃ rocanāguruṃ eṣa gandhaḥ samākhyātaḥ sarvadā caṇḍikāpriyaḥ svayambhukusumenaiva kuṇḍagolena vā punaḥ candanāgurucandreṇa sindūrarajasāpi vā kuṇḍagolodbhavairdravyaiḥ svayambhukusumena ca suvarṇaratna lekhanyā sarvakāryārthasiddhaye candrasūryātapaṃ yā vā athavā bilvakaṇṭakaiḥ eṣāmekatamaṃ labdhā svīyayantraṃ samuddharet tat phalaṃ labhate vīraḥ kṛtveṣṭacakradarśanam na jñātvā suṣamāṃ rekhāṃ nālikhya suṣamaṃ mukhaṃ atha vakṣye ca śāktānāṃ sāmānyaṃ yantramūttamam karavīre raktaśukle droṇe vā yantrarājake paśorālokanaṃ na syāttathā kuryāt prayatnataḥ devyaṅgakṣatirevātra kriyate pāpabuddhinā uttarāśā tadā sāpi pūrvāśaiva na saṃśayaḥ paścimāśāmukho mantrī yathācakraṃ samuddharet

vāyukoṇaṃ tadāgneyamīśānaṃ rākṣasaṃ bhavet pūrvāśaiva tadā sā dik rakṣaḥkoṇantu vahnikam pūrvāśāpi tadā jñeyā pūrvāśaiva na saṃśayaḥ yadāśābhimukho mantrī pūjayeccaṇḍikāṃ śubhām devīpaścāt pratīcī syāt prācī tu caṇḍikāpuraḥ pūjyapūjakayorantaḥ pūrvāśaiva nigadyate sīsake kāṃśyapātre vā raṅge vā sādhakottamaḥ sthāpitaṃ yadi lobhena mohenājñānato'pi vā puṣpaṃ tatra vinikṣipya gandhacandanasaṃyutam ātmābhedena saṃbhāvya puṣpaṃ dadyāt svamūrddhani iti śrīmajjñānānandaparamahaṃsaviracite kaulāvalīnirṇaye tṛtīyollāsaḥ bālāṃ vā tripurāṃ devīṃ savyāṃ vāpyatha bhairavīm dākṣiṇyādvāmabhāvādvā sarvathā siddhimāpnuyāt yathā tathā prakāreṇa vāmadakṣiṇato yajet ucchiṣṭabhairavīñcaiva tārāṃ tripurasundarīm etāstu vāmabhāvena pūjyā dakṣiṇatāṃ vinā vāmāt sarvasamṛddhiḥ syāddevyāḥ priyataro bhavet brahmāpi ca bhavedvāmo viṣṇuścaiva sadāśivaḥ sā tu dakṣiṇavāmābhyāṃ pūjanīyā prayatnataḥ matsyamāṃsāsavābhogī lolupaḥ strīṣu sarvadā bhairavo'pi bhavedvāmastathānye devatādayaḥ anyāśca caṇḍikādevyā bālikāmūrtayaḥ smṛtāḥ vāgbhavī ca sarasvatyā bālikāmūrtirīritā pūjako'pi bhavedvāmastathaiva satataṃ guruḥ mahābhairavarūpeṇa tathā ca ratisaṅgame

athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi pañcatattvavinirṇayam pañcāmāttu paraṃ nāsti śāktānāṃ sukhamokṣayoḥ kevalenādyayogena sādhako bhairavo bhavet kevalena tṛtīyena mahābhairavatāṃ vrajet pareṇa paratāṃ yāti śivatulyaḥ sa sādhakaḥ yasya bhavedyadā nityaṃ pañcatattvasya sambhavaḥ pañcamena vinā devīṃ pañcamīṃ pūjayettu yaḥ anyamūrtestu durgāyāḥ pañcamena vinā sadā tadvihīnasya yā pūjā japaṃ vā tarpaṇaṃ punaḥ caṇḍikāṃ pūjayedyastu vinā pañcamakārakaiḥ makārapañcakaṃ caiva devatāprītikārakam madyaṃ māṃsaṃ tathā matsyaṃ mudrā maithunameva ca vinā pañcopacāraṃ hi devīpūjāṃ karoti yaḥ vinā māṃsena madyena nā se naṃ śca vi lī va pum pramādādyadi lupyeta devatāśāpamāpnuyāt tṛptyarthaṃ sarvadevānāṃ tattvajñānodbhavāya ca madyasya lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye sādhakānāṃ hitāya ca tretāyāṃ pūjitā devī ghṛtena sarvajātibhiḥ pūjanīyā kalau devī kevalairāsavaiśca taiḥ tattu nānāvidhaṃ dravyaṃ kathyate tantravartmanā sarvotkṛṣṭantu vijñeyaṃ dravyamannena sambhavam rasaṃ vṛkṣalatājātamaikṣavaṃ daśavidhaṃ smṛtam madhūtthaṃ sīdhu mādhvīkaṃ maireyaṃ nārikelajam dvādaśantu surāmadyaṃ sarveṣāmuttamottamam sarvasiddhikarī paiṣṭī gauḍī bhogapradāyiṇī

nārikelodbhavā śrīdā aikṣavaṃ sukhavarddhanam anyā yā vihitā sadā śubhakarī mokṣapradāḥ saptikāḥ tarpaṇaṃ parameśānyāḥ sarvakāmaphalapradam yāvanna kurute mantrī tāvaddevārcanaṃ kutaḥ svapriyeṇa hataṃ māṃsaṃ rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet kṛte'pi siddhihāniḥ syāt kruddhā bhavati caṇḍikā vāmabhāge ca ṣaṭkoṇaṃ tanmadhye brahmarandhrakam sāmānyārghyajalenaiva prokṣayenmaṇḍalaṃ tataḥ tatra saṃpūjayedvahnimaṇḍalaṃ tadanantaram tāmraṃ bhūmimayaṃvāpi yadvā lauhavivarjitam kāṃsyaṃ śāntikarañcaiva mṛṇmayaṃ puṣṭidaṃ tathā kalasānāṃ pramāṇaṃ tu mukhamaṣṭāṅgulaṃ bhavet ādhāre sthāpayitvā tu pūjayet sūryamaṇḍalam bhūṣayedraktapuṣpeṇa raktamālyena sādhakaḥ somamaṇḍalamabhyarcya amṛtaṃ paribhāvya ca praṇamedbhaktibhāvena mudrābhiḥ pañcasaṃjñakaiḥ sakalāṅgulibhiḥ samyaṅmudreyaṃ caturasrikā anyonyābhimukhau hastau puṭākāreṇa kārayet etasyā eva mudrāyāḥ kaniṣṭhāmūladeśake madhyame sarale kṛtvā tarjanyupari saṃsthite sarvā ekatra saṃyojya aṅguṣṭhaparipīḍitā hrāṃ namaścaturasraṃ syāt hrīṃ namaḥ saṃvṛtastathā saḥ namo yonimudrā syāt pañcamudrāḥ prakīrtitāḥ praṇavaṃ varuṇaṃ sendu vāmadevañca ṅeyutam viṣaṃ kūrcaṃ tataḥ paśupataye tadanantaram

anenādau prapūjyaiva pathikasya baliṃ haret sindūrakuṅkumābhyāñca sarvapathikadevatāḥ sahetuṃ sāmiṣānnañca nidhāya manumuddharet bhyo hṛnmanuṃ samuccārya anenotsṛjya sādhakaḥ tataḥ kṣiptvā bahiḥsthāne mūlamantraṃ samuccaran māyāṃ lakṣmīṃ paśudvandvaṃ sendu dīrghadvayānvitam dravyasya harayugmañca dviṭhāntaṃ prajapenmanum astreṇa tāḍanaṃ kuryādvarmaṇābhyukṣaṇaṃ tataḥ mūlena gandhamādāya bahannāsāpuṭe tridhā hsauḥ sahauḥ namonatena pūjayet kumbhamadhyake sudhādevyai dhīmahīti tanno'rdhanārīśvareti ca māyāvahniyutaṃ kāmaṃ ratibindusamanvitam vāhini candrataḥ prānte sūryāgnibhakṣiṇītyapi tridhā ca prajapenmantraṃ brahmaśāpaṃ vimocayet brahmaśāpapadasyānte vimocitāñca ṅeyutām māyāṃ lakṣmīṃ ka(ma)daṃ senduṃ ṣaḍdīrghasvaravahnimat amṛtaṃ srāvayadvandvaṃ dviṭhāntaṃ manumuttamam viṣaṃ binduyutaṃ vāntaṃ dīrghaṣaṭkasamanvitam sudhādevyai hṛdantañca daśadhā sañjapenmanum māyāṃ kāmeśvarīṃ vācaṃ amṛte amṛtodbhave srāvayadvitayaṃ śaktibījaṃ bhārgavamuddharet siddhisāmarthyamābhāṣya dahayugmaṃ mahāpadaṃ astrāya phaṭ dviṭhāntañca uddhṛtya daśadhā japet surāṇāmamṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ baladevena dhīmatā dattātrayeṇa muninā śukreṇa ca mahātmanā

vāratrayantu saṃjapya paṭhedanyatamaṃ manum ṣaḍdīrghasvarasambhinnaṃ nādabinduvibhūṣitam surāśukraśāpaṃ procya mocayadvitayaṃ tataḥ daśadhā parisañjapya śāpatrayaṃ vimocayet māyāṃ lakṣmīṃ tato vācaṃ amṛte amṛtodbhave dviṭhāntañca samuccārya uccaret kubjikāntataḥ hasakhaphreñca hasarīṃ bhagavati tato vadet sahakhaphreṃ yugaṃ procya sanoreva tato vadet vicco'pi hasakhānnñca hasakhableñca hasarīṃ tiraskāriṇīṃ tato dhyāyet paśupāśa vināśinīm khaḍgāyudhā bhagavatī paripātu bhaktān māyāṃ lakṣmīṃ samuddhṛtya namo bhagavatīti ca manaścakṣustiraskariṇīṃ kurudvandvañca ṭhadvayam vāṇīṃ glaiṃ tiraskariṇi sakaleti janeti ca janānte ca manaścakṣuḥ śrotrajihvāpadantataḥ ṭhadvayañca sargayutaṃ dviṭhānto'yaṃ mahāmanuḥ haṃsapīṭhe mantramaye svaguruṃ śivarūpiṇaṃ athavānyaprakāreṇa dravyaśuddhiṃ samācaret nṛsadvarasadvyomasadabjā gojā ṛtajā adrijā ṛtaṃ bṛhat kulakuṇḍalini amṛtaṃ kuru kuru svāhā sadvasurantarīkṣeti saddhotā vedisatyatha ṛtaṃ bṛhadityarddhañca asyā ṛca udāhṛtam vāk ca tṛptodbhavasyānte siddhodbhava tataḥ param amṛtāyāmṛtaṃ proktvā nāthāya padato'mṛta pibadvandvaṃ kulaṃ proktvā kuṇḍalini tato vadet

dvayaṃ nirjharayugmañca vāgbhavaṃ bhuvaneśvarīm dviṭhāntaṃ manumuccārya pāyayitvā ca kuṇḍalīm tasmāt sudhāṃ samutpādya pūrayet pātramuttamam kālikāyā viśeṣañca vakṣye'haṃ tantravartmanā kacodbhavāṃ brahmahatyāṃ tena te nāśayāmyaham amābījamaye devi śukraśāpādvimucyatām tena satyena te devi brahmahatyāṃ vyapohatu pradadyāt kālikāyai ca tato naivedyabhugbhavet eṣāmekatamaṃ kṛtvā dhyāyedānandabhairavam aṣṭādaśabhujaṃ devaṃ pañcavaktraṃ trilocanam vṛṣārūḍhaṃ nīlakaṇṭhaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam pāśāṅkaśadharaṃ devaṃ gadāmuṣaladhāriṇam kheṭakamuṇḍahastañca varadābhayavigraham tasyotsaṅge surāṃ devīṃ candrakoṭyayutaprabhām bhujāṣṭadaśasaṃyuktāṃ sarvāyudhakarodyatām athavānyaprakāreṇa surādevīñca cintayet śiraścandrādvigalantīṃ dhyāyettāṃ paradevatām ānandabhairavaṃ devamānandabhairavīṃ tathā ṣaṣṭhasvarānvitaṃ vāyuṃ bindunādavibhūṣitam tataḥ pūrvavaduddhṛtya viparītamukhaṃ dvayam ṅeyutāṃ netramantrañca kathito manusattamaḥ mūlañcopari saṃjapya amṛtaṃ paribhāvayet āvāhanīṃ darśayitvā sthāpanīṃ tadanantaram avaguṇṭhanamudrāñca vidhāya sādhakottamaḥ digbandhanaṃ prakurvīta choṭikābhiranantaram

dhenumudrāmṛtīkṛtya dravyaśuddhiṃ samācaret dravyasnānaṃ tataḥ kuryāddakṣe kṛtvā ca cullakam vāmanāsāṅguṣṭhayogāt pūjādravyeṣu nikṣipet hastābhyāṃ mārjayeddehaṃ mūlamantraṃ samuccaran ata-eva nāma tasya sureti bhuvanatraye tadgandhāghrāṇamātreṇa śatakratuphalaṃ labhet tathā tatpānataḥ sākṣāllabhet muktiṃ caturvidhām tatsvāde ca kriyāśaktiḥ cetaḥ śodhanasādhanā iti śrīmajjñānānandaparamahaṃsaviracite kaulāvalīnirṇaye caturthollāsaḥ māṃsañca trividhaṃ proktaṃ jalabhūcarakhecaram mahāmāṃsāṣṭakaṃ proktaṃ devatāprītikārakam etanmāṃsāṣṭakaṃ proktaṃ caṇḍikāprītikārakam varāhavyāghrabhallūkaśaśakāḥ kūrmakukkuṭau manuṣyo gavayaścaiva śallakī ca viśeṣataḥ vihitā balayaḥ proktāścaṇḍikāprītikārakāḥ eṣāmekatamaṃ labdhvā tarpaṇārthaṃ prakalpayet pitṛdaivatayajñeṣu vede hiṃsā vidhīyate animittaṃ tṛṇaṃ vāpi chedayenna kadācana māṃsaṃ vināpi pūjāyāṃ pāpaṃ syācca pade pade hanyānmantreṇa cānena tvabhimantrya paśuṃ tataḥ tadbuddhasva paśo tvaṃ hi māśivastvaṃ śivo'si hi paramātmā tadānande tasmāt sevyamidaṃ priye pūjāsu āmamāṃsāni dadyādvai sādhakaḥ kvacit saṃśodhayettu māṃsāni yathāśāstrapramāṇataḥ astrāntamūlamantreṇa prokṣayitvā ca sādhakaḥ

śoṣayedvāyubījena vahnibījena sandahet tataśca sañjapenmantraṃ māṃsānāṃ śodhanāya ca stavate mṛgo na bhīmaḥ saṃprocya kucaro bhavet vikramaṇeṣvadhikṣipanti bhuvanāni viśvāḥ mūlamantraṃ japedvīraḥ saptavāraṃ tataḥ param pāṭhīnañca vodālaśca tathā śakulaśālakau anena vihitāḥ sarve'pīmā mīnāḥ śubhapradāḥ japenmantraṃ tataḥ paścānmīnānāñca viśuddhaye urvārukamiva bandhanmṛtyormukṣīya mā'mṛtāt vraiheyaṃ maṇḍalākāraṃ candravimbanibhaṃ śubham pūjākāle devatāyā mudraiṣā parikīrttitā tasyāḥ saṃjñā smṛtā mudrā mahāmodapravardhinī mudrāñca prokṣayedādau śeṣaṃ pūrvavadācaret divīva cakṣurātatam viṣṇoryat paramaṃ padam iti saṃjapya vīrendraḥ śeṣaṃ pūrvavadācaret madyakumbhasahasraistu māṃsabhāraśatairapi bhagaliṅgātmikā devī bhagaliṅgāmṛtātmikā vindurūpā ca vindusthā rajovindusvarūpiṇī bhagaliṅgāmṛtenaiva tasmāttāṃ paripūjayet bhagaliṅgāmṛtenaiva devīṃ yaśca prapūjayet kulastrīkulapuṣpaiśca kuladravyaiḥ kulāmṛtaiḥ vinā kulodbhavairdravyaiḥ pūjayedyaśca caṇḍikām dravyaśodhanamācarya śaktiśodhanamācaret snāpitāṃ pramadāṃ divyāṃ hetuyuktāñca dīkṣitām

sālaṅkārāṃ suveśāñca sthāpayet tūlikopari mātṛkānyāsamācarya kalānyāsaṃ samācaret aiṅkāraṃ hṛdaye caiva nābhau bluṅkārameva ca ṛṣyādikaṃ svakalpoktaṃ pādyādibhistato yajet ādhāre hṛdaye caiva bhruvormadhye nyaset kramāt mūrddhādipādaparyantaṃ nyāsaṃ kuryāttataḥ param sīmante likhanaṃ nakhairurasijaṃ gṛhṇīta gāḍhaṃ tataḥ jaṅghāṅguṣṭhapadorugulphahananaṃ cānyo'nyataḥ kāminoḥ ekādaśasvareṇāḍhyaṃ candrabindusamanvitam vāmā yā capalacitte reto muñcadvayaṃ paṭhet somavadhūsamāyuktaṃ candramantyasvarānvitam tasyā yonau nyasedvidyāṃ ret thu mā to ca mai na ta niṃ gha yed ṅge yo na rṣa li mūlamuccārya sādhakaḥ suṣumnāvartmanā nityamakṣavṛttīrjuhomyaham tato japet striyaṃ gacchan mukhe jihvāmṛtaṃ pivet varuṇaṃ svarasaṃyukta pañcadīrghasamanvitam muhurmuhuḥ pibet pānaṃ śaktijihvāviloḍitam ātmani śaktisaṃyogādekībhūtāṃ vicintayet jihvāṃ mūlamayīṃ cintya yoniñca kularūpiṇīm śuddhamantrauṣadhenaiva ret ma na neḥ ñca pra tha yo tattvatyāge pīṭhenmūlaṃ sādhakaḥ sthiramānasaḥ dharmādharmakalāsnehapūrṇa agnau juhomyaham śivaśaktisamāyogo yatra yatra prajāyate gṛhṇīyāttatprayatnena dravyaṃ kuṇḍodbhavaṃ smṛtam golodbhavaṃ pravakṣyāmi vīrāṇāṃ siddhihetave

sālaṅkārāṃ hetuyuktāmanapatyāṃ manoramām sādhakākāṅkṣahṛdayāṃ kalāśāstravicāriṇīm pūrvoktakramayogena tattvamutpādayet sudhīḥ idaṃ golodbhavaṃ dravyaṃ devatātṛptikārakam nānāgandhasamāyuktaṃ kaṭutrayasamanvitam śodhayet kuṇḍagolādīn nayatvarcāsamāhitaḥ āsiñcatu prajāpatirdhātā garbhaṃ dadhātu te garbhaṃ te aśvinau devādhādhattāṃ puṣkarasrajau amṛte amṛtodbhave amṛtavarṣiṇīti ca śeṣaṃ pūrvavadācarya athavānyatamañcaret vahnijāyā tāramāyā śrībījaṃ suratipriye tato'mṛtodbhavāyeti amṛtavarṣiṇī param vahnijāyāntamantreṇa dravyaśuddhiṃ samācaret tenāmṛtena deveśīṃ tarpayet sādhakottamaḥ acirānmṛtyumāpnoti dvandvaṃ kṛtvā narādhamaḥ śaṅkayā jāyate glāniḥ śaṅkayā duḥkhabhājanam śaṅkayā siddhihāniḥ syāttasmācchaṅkāṃ parityajet svalpāṅgīṃ dīrghakeśīṃ ca sādhakaḥ śuddhabhāvataḥ tasyāḥ puṣpaiḥ prayatnena sarvakāmamupālabhet sugandhā sā suratādyairbilvapatraiḥ sugandhitā gaurāṅgī puṣṭajaṅghā yā puṣṭahastā madāturā puṣpagandhā jagaddhātrī sā sadā kṛṣṇarūpiṇī kṣīṇāṅgī ca yadā kṛṣṇā dīrghakeśī madākulā puṣṭā kharvā'sitāṅgī yā sā bhavenmadanāśrayā kṛśāṅgī gauradīrghā yā sā parā śiśumālinā

puṣṭā kharvā sitāṅgī yā sendīvaravikārakaiḥ kṣīṇā dīrghā ca gaurāṅgī mālatīgandhayojitā bandhūkairyadi gaurāṅgī yānaṅgamekhalā śubhā āsāṃ dravyaṃ gṛhītvā tu tenaiva pariśodhayet jñātvā naivaṃ kramaṃ yo hi yadi devīṃ prapūjayet yaduktā daśamī śaktiḥ saṅkīrṇavṛttisaṃsthitā svayaṃ sraṣṭā svayaṃ viṣṇuḥ svayaṃ devo maheśvaraḥ gajāśvānāṃ vṛṣājānāṃ narāṇāṃ śoṇitāruṇaiḥ matsyairmadyaiśca naivedyaiḥ pratyakṣīkriyate naraiḥ nādharmo jāyate kiñcinmahāmantrasya sādhane dravyaśuddherabhāvena nityaṃ karmaṃ na lopayet makārapañcakaṃ kṛtvā punarjanma na vidyate yenāvaśyaṃ vidhātavyaṃ madirādānapūjanam hetubhiḥ parapātrasthaistarpaṇaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet prāyaścittī sa varjyaśca paśureva na saṃśayaḥ vinālimāṃsagandhena paśuḥ paśupatiḥ svayam piśitaṃ tilamātrantu tilārdhamapi bindunā raktavastraiḥ samācchādya pañcatattvaṃ tu rakṣayet saṃsthāpayenna dakṣe ca dravyaśuddhiritīṃritā dvijānāmanukalpantu na sākṣācca vikalpinām brāhmaṇastāmrapātre tu madhumadyaṃ prakalpayet nārikelodakaṃ kāṃsye guḍārdrakaṃ tathaiva ca sarvaṃ śūdreṇa dātavyaṃ yatra vā tadrucirbhavet saṃmardya vaṭikāṃ kṛtvā saṃgṛhyātha vicakṣaṇaḥ guḍamiśreṇa takreṇa tarpayenmadhuyojitam

māṃsābhāve tu lasunamārdrakaṃ nāgarantu vā māṃsānukalpaṃ kathitaṃ mīnasyātha vidhiṃ śṛṇu phalamūlañca yatkiñciddagdhañcedāmiṣaṃ bhavet aparāpuṣpagarbhe tu kulasthānaṃ manoramam hayārikusume nityaṃ svayamasti sadāśivaḥ raktakuṅkumarāgaṃ vā bhinnaṃ tattvaṃ śivātmakam kṣaṇaṃ vicintya tatraiva saṃpūjya parameśvarīm antarādadhikaṃ jñeyaṃ etaddravyaṃ sudurlabham ādāya pūjayeddevīmanyathā niṣphalaṃ bhavet svahastena paśuṃ hatvā rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet iti śrīmajjñānānandaparamahaṃsaviracite kaulāvalīnirṇaye pañcamollāsaḥ gṛhītvājñāṃ mahādevyā viśeṣārghyaṃ samācaret trikoṇañcaiva ṣaṭkoṇaṃ vṛttaṃ bhūgṛhasaṃyutam astrāntamūlamantreṇa sāmānyārghyajalena ca caturasre pūrṇaśailamuḍḍīyānaṃ jalandharam aṅgaṣaṭkaṃ yajettatra ṣaṭkoṇeṣu ca mantravit ādhāraśaktiṃ madhye ca saṃpūjya tadanantaram ādhāreṇa vinā bhraṃśo na ca tṛpyanti mātaraḥ ādhāraṃ tripadaṃ proktaṃ ṣaṭpadaṃ vā catuṣpadam eṣāmanyatamaṃ sthāpya pūjayet kulavartmanā ādau senduṃ mahākālaṃ vahnimaṇḍalaṃ ṅeyutam tatra sampūjayedvahneḥ kalādaśakaṃ saṃjñayā suśrīḥ surūpā kapilā havyakavyavahe'pi ca ṅeyutā vai namo'ntāśca kalā vahneritīritāḥ svarṇaraupyaśilākūrmakapālālābumṛṇmayam

puṇyavṛkṣasamudbhūtaṃ pātraṃ kuryānmanoramam kāpālaṃ sphuṭamantrasiddhijanakaṃ muktipradaṃ mauktikam śāntike ca śilāpātraṃ stambhe caiva tu mṛṇmayam jñānapradaṃ kapālaṃ syānmāraṇe lauhamuttamam śaṅkhaṃ jñānapradaṃ muktāśuktividyāpradāyinī puṇyavṛkṣajapātrāṇi sarvapāpaharāṇi ca ṣoḍaśāṅgulavistāra ṣaṣṭhāṅgulasamucchrayam ekāṅgulaṃ tathā sārdhaṃ ṣaṭkañca vai pramāṇataḥ na yojayedbhagnapātraṃ svaprādeśaṃ praśasyate maṇḍalaṃ pūrvavat kṛtvā pūjayet pūrvavartmanā svarādyaṃ bindusahitaṃ ṅeyutam arkamaṇḍalam kalāḥ sampūjayettatra bhānordvādaśasaṃjñakāḥ suṣumnā bhogadā viśvā bodhinī dhāriṇī kṣamā bījādyāśca kalā jñeyāścaturthyādyā namo'nvitāḥ raktacandanapuṣpaiśca sugandhaiḥ sumanoharaiḥ varuṇaṃ mūlamantrañca vilomamātṛkāṃ paṭhan tatra dūrvākṣatāraktapuṣpacandanasaṃyutam māṃsaṃ matsyaṃ vinikṣipya mudrāñcaiva viśeṣataḥ elālavaṅgakakṣvelajātīphalasamanvitam svayambhūkusumaṃ kuṇḍagolotthañcāṣṭagandhakam sabinduṃ vāmakarṇañca ṅeyutaṃ somamaṇḍalam kalā somasya tatraiva dviraṣṭasaṃkhyakā yajet śaśinī candrikā kāntirjyotsnā śrīḥ prītiraṅgadā akārādyā binduyutā ṅeyutāśca namo'ntikāḥ pūrvaṃvattīrthamāvāhya pūrvavanmaṇḍalaṃ likhet

ānandabhairavīṃ devīṃ tatra saṃpūjya deśikaḥ āvāhanyādimudrāśca sādhako darśayettataḥ darśayitvā tato mudrāmiṣṭadevaṃ yajettataḥ akathāditrirekhāyāṃ madhye māyāṃ samālikhet sampūjayettataḥ paścāt pañcaratnaṃ susādhakaḥ gaganānte ca ratnebhyo namo'ntamanumuddharet svargapadaṃ samuccārya ratnebhyo nama ityapi pātālapada ratnebhyo namo'ntaścāparo manuḥ martyaratne tataḥ paścādbhyo namo'tra samuddharet nāgapadaṃ samuccārya ratnebhyo nama ityapi vāgbhavānte ca divyaughaṃ gurusaṃjñāñca pādukām siddhaughaṃ mānavaughañca pūjayitvā manuṃ japet svacchandasphuraṇāmatra nidhehyakūlarūpiṇi amṛtatvaṃ nidhehyasnin vastuni klinnarūpiṇi bhūtvā parāmṛtākāraṃ mayi citsphuraṇaṃ kuru brahmāṇḍakhaṇḍasambhūtamaśeṣarasasambhavam vāgbhavaṃ pañcamaṃ kṣauṇīṃ vāmaśrotrasamanvitam amṛtavarṣiṇi procya amṛtaṃ srāvayadvayam vāgbhavaṃ vadayugmañca vāgvādini tataḥ param kledayadvitayaṃ mahāmokṣaṃ kurudvayaṃ vadet pretabījaṃ samuccārya hasaurnamastataḥ param ānandabhairavaṃ devamānandabhairavīmapi pūrvoktāścāturasrādyāḥ śaṅkhamudrāṃ tataḥ param dakṣiṇāṃṅguṣṭha saṃsṛṣṭhā mudraiṣā śaṅkhasaṃjñikā uparyupariyogena militāḥ saralāṅgulīḥ

matsyamudrāñca sandarśya dhenumudrāñca darśayet tritālachoṭikābhiśca digbandhanaṃ tataścaret iṣṭadevasvarūpañca vibhāvya sādhakottamaḥ tathāca siddhavidyānāmācāraḥ kathyate'dhunā śrīvidyoktavidhānena tataḥ pūjāṃ samācaret tasmādvinduṃ vinikṣipya sāmānyārghye tataḥ param guroḥ pātraṃ ghaṭasyānte tadante bhogapātrakam tadante vīrapātrañca balipātraṃ tadantike uttamaṃ navapātrāṇi saptapātrāṇi madhyamam adhamaṃ tāni pātrāṇi ekapātraṃ na kārayet mantrāḥ parāṅmukhā yānti vighnāścaiva pade pade devīpātraṃ guroḥ pātraṃ bhogapātraṃ trayaṃ matam śakteḥ pātraṃ vīrapātraṃ saptapātreṣvayaṃ vidhiḥ pādyamācamanīyañca navapātreṣvayaṃ vidhiḥ kumbhasya dakṣiṇe kuryāttrikoṇaṃ vṛttabhūgṛham tatra sampūjayedvahnimaṇḍalaṃ tadanantaram abhyarcya maṇḍalaṃ tatra sūryasya pūrayettataḥ kuṇḍagolaṃ kṣipettatra kusumaṃ gandhacandanam aṅgaṣaṭkaṃ koṇaṣaṭkaṃ mudrāḥ pūrvavadācaret aṣṭadhā mūlamantrañca japtvā binduṃ kṣipettataḥ svasvanāmayutān divyān siddhamānavasaṅghakān aṅguṣṭhānāmikābhyāñca vāmahastasya sarvadā guruṃ paraguruñcaiva parāparaguruṃ tathā viśeṣārghyāmṛtenaiva tarpayennijadevatām gurūṇāṃ pātradakṣe ca bhogapātraṃ prakalpayet

bhogapātrāmṛtenaiva sammārjya karayugmakam kalāyasadṛśaṃ tatra kṣipecchuddhicatuṣṭayam vāmahastasya viprendraḥ svīkuryāttadanena tu ṅentaṃ vidyākalātmānaṃ sabinduṃ ṣoḍaśa svaram sthūladehaṃ tataḥ paścāt śodhayāmi padāt dviṭhaḥ māyāṃ lakṣmīṃ tato māyākalāniyatiśabdataḥ kādipañcakavargañca binduyuk kāmabījakam śodhayāmi tataḥ svāhā svīkuryādaparantataḥ cakṣustatorasanāghrāṇavākpāṇipadaṃ tathā gandhākāśapadaṃ vāyutejaḥ salilaśabdataḥ śaktibījaṃ svamantrañca śivatattvena tatparam svīkṛtya ca punarmāyāṃ lakṣmībījaṃ samuccaret prakṛtyādikamuccārya pañcāśanmātṛkāntataḥ tattvatrayāśritaṃ jīvaṃ śodhayāmi tataḥ svāhā svīkuryādamunā yugmaṃ dakṣavāmakrameṇa tu ahamevāhaṃ māṃ juhomi svāhā mām avatuvaktāraṃ svāhā medhayā spṛṇotu bhuvi sruvaṃ meṇopāyatu svāhā pāṇibhyāṃ sarvadehañca proñchayediti śodhanam kṣālayeddhastayugalamathavānyatamañcaret jyotirahaṃ virajā vipāpmā bhūyāsaṃ svāhā jyotirahaṃ virajā vipāpmā bhūyāsaṃ svāhā jyotirahaṃ virajā vipāpmā bhūyāsaṃ svāhā jyotirahaṃ virajā vipāpmā bhūyāsaṃ svāhā jyotirahaṃ virajā vipāpmā bhūyāsaṃ svāhā

jyotirahaṃ virajā vipāpmā bhūyāsaṃ svāhā jyotirahaṃ virajā vipāpmā bhūyāsaṃ svāhā saptamantramidañcaiva paṭhettattvaviśuddhaye yoginīnāñca saṃsthāpya vīrapātraṃ tataḥ param ācamanīyapātrañca pūrvavat sthāpayedbudhaḥ balipātrāmṛtenaiva vaṭukādīṃśca tarpayet devīpātrāmṛtaṃ binduṃ pūjādravyopari kṣipet bhogapātrāmṛtaṃ binduṃ svīkuryāttadanantaram yāvanno vaṭuke dadyāt yoginyāṃ sarvabhūtake akṛtvā balidānaṃ hi kathaṃ pūjāṃ samācaret adattvā vaṭukādīnāṃ yaḥ pūjayati caṇḍikām dakṣiṇe vaṭuke deyaḥ uttare yoginībaliḥ rājarājeśvare madhye baliṃ dadyāt susādhakaḥ prokṣaṇaṃ pūrvavat kṛtvā vaṭukaṃ tatra cintayet rjayati vaṭukanāthaḥ siddhidaḥ sādhakānām aṅguṣṭhānāmikābhyāñca baṭukasya baliṃ haret piṅgalapadato jaṭābhāsvara procya piṅgala vahnijāyāntamuccārya vaṭukasya mahātmanaḥ anena balimutsṛjya yāginīścintayettataḥ bhaktānāṃ sādhakānāmabhilaṣitaphalaṃ dīyamānāḥ suveśāḥ aṅguṣṭhamadhyamānāmā yoginībhyo baliṃ haret sarvābhyo mātṛkābhyaśca ityutsṛjya baliṃ dadet sarvabhūtapatiṃ procya bhyo namo'ntaṃ samuccaret tataḥ sañcintayet kṣetranāyakaṃ siddhihetave khaṭvāṅgaṃ vyomanīlaṃ ḍamarukasahitaṃ kṣetrapālaṃ namāmi

viśaṃ māyāṃ ramābījaṃ kṣakāraṃ bindubhūṣitam imaṃ baliṃ padasyānte pūjāṃ gṛhṇayugaṃ tataḥ kṣetrapālabaliṃ dattvā madhye dadyāttataḥ param balipātrāmṛtenaiva tarpayedvaṭukādikam vāmabhāge sthite caiva sarvavighnaharo bhavet pūrve bhūḥ baliṃ dadyāt kṣetrapālasya paścime rājarājeśvaraṃ madhye baliṃ dadyāt susādhakaḥ iti śrīmajjñānānandaparamahaṃsaviracite kaulāvalīnirṇaye ṣaṣṭhollāsaḥ pūjādau ca japādau ca japasyānte tathaiva ca prāṇāyāmaṣaḍaṅgañca kṛtvā sādhakasattamaḥ svakalpoktavidhānena dhyātvā devīṃ samāhitaḥ tejomayīṃ mahādevīṃ dīpāddīpāntaraṃ yathā āvāhanyādimudrāśca darśayettadanantaram iyaṃ tu viparītā cettadā vai sthāpanī bhavet antaraṅguṣṭhamuṣṭibhyāṃ sannirodhanarūpiṇī avaguṇṭhanamudreyamabhito bhrāmitā satī anyo'nyagrathitāṅguṣṭhaprasāritakarāṅguliḥ parivṛtya karau paścāt tarjanīmadhyamāyugam dhenumudreyamākhyātā amṛtīkaraṇe budhaiḥ darśayitvā tato mudrāṃ tālatrayapuraḥsaram lelihāmudrayā yantraṃ spṛṣṭvā pañcakuśena vā anāmāyāṃ kṣipedvṛddhāṃ ṛjuṃ kṛtvā kaniṣṭhikām mūlamantreṇa dīptātmā arghyadravyodakena ca tataḥ sampūjayeddevīṃ ṣoḍaśairupacārakaiḥ madhuparkācamanasnānavasanābharaṇāni ca

pādyārghyācamanasnānavasanābharaṇāni yaca tāmbūlamarcanāstotraṃ tarpaṇañca tataḥ param madhuparkācamanañca gandhaprasūnake tataḥ gandhādayo naivedyāntaḥ pūjā pañcopacārikā abhāve puṣpatoyābhyāṃ patreṇa tadabhāvataḥ tadabhāve'kṣatenaiva dūrvayā tadabhāvataḥ mūlānte devatānāma ṅeyutañca samuddharet hṛdayena tu pādyañca śirasārghyaṃ nivedayet śikhāmantreṇa gandhañca puṣpaṃ netreṇa dāpayet pādyādikaṃ nivedyātha snānīyañca nivedayet nānāratnasamāyuktasvarṇasiṃhāsanānvite ghṛtenodvartanaṃ kāryaṃ manasā tadanantaram sahasraiḥ svarṇakumbhaiśca sugandhajalapūritaiḥ nānātīrthodakaiḥ śuddhairgandharājasahasrakaiḥ pañcāmṛtaiḥ pañcagavyaiḥ snāpayettadanantaram saptamṛttikayā yukta śītalena jalena ca suvāsitajalenaiva devyāḥ snānaṃ samācaret bhṛṅgārāṣṭakakumbhaistu devyāḥ snānaṃ vidhāya ca kārpāsaṃ vālkalaṃ vārkṣaṃ koṣajaṃ vastramiṣyate sapītāmbarakauṣaṃ vā svadevāya ca utsṛjet nīlaraktaṃ tu yadvastraṃ tatsarvatra vivarjayet vastraṃ dadyānmahādevyai nānyasmai tu kadācana dattvā'ṅgalepanaṃ kākiryaṃ gandhacandanasihlakaiḥ yantramadhye samānīya namaskuryāt samāhitaḥ yathotpannaṃ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ tathā dadyācca patrakam

nādhomukhaṃ phalaṃ dadyāditi śāstrasya nirṇayaḥ aṅguṣṭhatarjanībhyāṃ tu jñānamudrā prakīrtitā dadyācca vimalaṃ gandhaṃ mūlamantreṇa pūrvavat madhyamānāmikābhyāṃ tu madhyaparvaṇi deśikaḥ uttolanaṃ tridhā kṛtvā gāyatryā mūlayogataḥ anyat sarvaṃ sa vīraḥ pradadyājjñānamudrayā pāyasaṃ kṛśaraṃ dadyāt pālyannaṃ madhusaṃyutam tāmbūlañca tato dadyāt karpūrādisuvāsitam punarmālyaṃ pradātavyaṃ gandhavandanapaṅkajam vidhivat pūjanaṃ kṛtvā tarpayettattvamudrayā aṅguṣṭhe bhairavo devo'nāmāyāṃ caṇḍikā sadā aṅguṣṭhamadhyamābhyāñca vaśyakarmaṇi tarpayet tarjanyaṅguṣṭhayogena tarpayedabhicārake tarpaṇañcāṣṭadhā kāryaṃ sakṛdvāpi yathecchayā tarpayitvāmahādevīṃ svīyakramamathācaret pūjākāle devatāyā nopari bhrāmayet karam dhyātvā gurukulaṃ dhīro raśmivṛndaṃ tathaiva ca vinā yo hi guroḥ pūjāmiṣṭadevaṃ yajed yadi tasmāt sarvaprayatnena gurupūjāṃ samācaret mānavaughāḥ samāsena pūjanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ yeṣu yeṣu ca mantreṣu ye ye ṛṣigaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ ajñātvā gurunāmāni gurutritayamarcayet guruḥ paraguruścaiva parāparagurustataḥ na jānāmi gurornāma vaṃśaśuddhiḥ kadācana iti stavena saṃstutya tasminnijaguruṃ yadi

gurupūjāṃ vinā caiva yadi pūjāṃ samācaret pūrvavattarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā raśmivṛndaṃ prapūjayet tanmāṃsarudhireṇaiva pāraṇaṃ tasya jāyate aṅgāṅgitvaṃ parityajya devatāśāpamāpnuyāt ubhābhyāṃ labhate śāpaṃ mantrī cañcalamānasaḥ sampūjya devatāḥ sarvāstarpayettadanantaram punaḥ sampūjayed devīmupacāraiśca vistaraiḥ vastraṃ vā cārmaṇaṃ koṣaṃ maṇḍapasyottare sṛjet śyāmā dūrvā paṅkajañca viṣṇukrāntāsamanvitam sadūrvaiḥ sarvadevānāmetadarghyamudīritam vāsitantu sugandhādyaiḥ karttavyaṃ yadi labhyate candanāgurukarpūraṃ corakuṅkumarocanāḥ nānāvidhāni puṣpāṇi vasanābharaṇāni ca sarvāṅgalepanaṃ dadyād dhūpaṃ dadyāttataḥ param madhunā ghṛtasaṃyukto dhūpo'yaṃ caṇḍikāpriyaḥ vakratārahitavārijamudrā dhūpavartiriha sundari bhadrā kuṣṭhaṃ guḍaḥ sarjarasastathaiva daśāṅgadhūpaḥ kathito munīndraiḥ dhūpayedājyasaṃmiśrairnocairdevasya deśikaḥ eṣāmekatamaṃ kṛtvā nivedya śāstravartmanā ghṛtapradīpaṃ prathamaṃ tilatailodbhavaṃ tataḥ praṇavaṃ jayadhvanipadaṃ mātaḥ svāhā tataḥ param taijasaṃ dārujaṃ vāpi ārttikyaṃ dīpavṛkṣakam evaṃ dīpaṃ prakurvīta netrarañjanakārakam abhito dīpayenmantrī dīpamālāṃ ghṛtalpatām varttā karpūragandhinyā sarpiṣā tilajena vā

dīpābaliṃ tato dattvā kuladīpaṃ nivedayet dalāṣṭakayutaṃ padmaṃ vilikhya tatra sādhakaḥ aṣṭapatreṣu madhye ca sthāpayitvā tataḥ param saptadhā tatra uttolya navadhā bhrāmayettataḥ tataśca sādhakaśreṣṭhaścakramudrāṃ pradarśayet dakṣiṇe yojayitvā tu kaniṣṭhe garbhake budhaḥ anyonyayogataścaiva cakramudrā prakīrtitā taijaseṣu ca pātreṣu prastare vā'bjapatrake sarvābhāve tu māheye svahastaghaṭite yadi yadyogyaṃ sarvapātre tu tannidhāya nivedayet na gṛhṇāti mahādevī dattaṃ vidhiśatairapi nānāvidhāni dravyāṇi dattvā devyai prayatnataḥ dattvā devyai prayatnena annaṃ bahuvidhaṃ tathā kaṭvamlamadhurañcaiva paramānnaṃ saśarkaram dugdhaṃ dadhi tathā takraṃ navanītaṃ saśarkaram carvyaṃ coṣyaṃ lehyapeyaṃ bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ nivedayet cullukañca tato dattvā prāṇamudrāṃ pradarśayet vṛddhāmadhyātarjanībhirapānasya prakīrtitā kaniṣthābhinnasarvābhirudānasya samīritā prāṇāpānau tathā vyāna udānaśca samānakaḥ vāmahaste prāsamudrā prāsavat parikīrtitā svayambhūkusumaṃ kuṇḍagolotthaṃ rocanāgurum gandhapuṣpaṃ tathā mālyaṃ raktapuṣpādibhūṣaṇam droṇāparājitāpuṣpaṃ karavīraṃ javāṃ tathā datte caiva javāpuṣpe paṭṭavastraphalaṃ labhet

tāmbūlañca tato dadyāt karpūrādisuvāsitam darpaṇaṃ pādukāṃ chatraṃ cāmaraṃ vyajanādikam yatnatastu baliṃ dadyānna hanyādātmanā punaḥ yadi hanyāt pramādena rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet gṛhītvā śoṇitaṃ pātre svakīyaṃ hṛdayodbhavam pradadyācca mahādevyai sarvasaubhāgyahetave śaktibījena vā dadyānnābherūrdhvamadho nahi tataśca sādhakaśreṣṭho mantraśuddhiṃ mācaret kramāt kramād dvirāvṛttirmantraśuddhiritīritā japañca trividhaṃ proktaṃ vācikopāṃśumānasam tajjapaṃ vācikaṃ viddhi jihvāmātramupāṃśukam vācikasya śataṃ jñeyaṃ ekottaramupāṃśunā nigadaśca tathā jñeyaḥ spaṣṭavācā nigadyate mānasaśca sa boddhavyaścintanākṣararūpavān upāṃśusmaraṇenaiva tulyaṃ bhavati sarvathā mānasoccāraṇāttulyaṃ jāyate sādhakasya ca svaguruṃ mūrdhni sañcintya hṛdi devīṃ tataḥ param japasyādau śivāṃ dhyāyet dhyānasyānte punarjapet dhyānaṃ kṛtvā japenmantraṃ guruktakramato budhaḥ tataḥ sampūjayenmālāṃ toyairabhyukṣya yatnataḥ oṃ māle māle mahāmāle sarvasiddhisvarūpiṇi pūjayitvā tato mālāṃ gṛhītvā dakṣiṇe kare vinā yantrañca mantrañca kavacaṃ mantraśūnyataḥ saṃkhyā kṛtā mṛttikā ca akṣatañca tathaiva ca tarjanyā na spṛśenmālāmaṅguṣṭhāgreṇa cālayet

niḥsetuśca yathā toyaṃ kṣaṇānnimnaṃ prasarpati śūdrāṇāṃ candrabindustha aukāraḥ seturucyate dvisetavaḥ samākhyātāḥ sarvathaiva dvijātayaḥ setuṃ vinā bhavedvayarthaṃ tasmāt setuṃ samācaret pūrvabījaṃ japan yastu parabījantu saṃspṛśet evamuktavidhānena vilambaṃ tvaritaṃ tyajet gaṇanāvidhimullaṅghya yo japettajjapaṃ punaḥ athavā karamālāyāṃ mātṛkāyāṃ tathaiva ca nityajape ca home ca yatra saṃkhyā na coditā aṣṭottaraśataṃ vāpi triṃśadvāpi kadācana yathāśakti japaṃ kṛtvā prāṇāyāmaṃ vidhāya ca tejomayaṃ japaphalaṃ devyā haste samarpayet trividhena natiṃ kuryādaṣṭāṅgakavidhānakaiḥ brahmarandhreṇa karṇābhyāṃ yadbhūmeḥ sparśanaṃ bhavet aṣṭāṅganamanaṃ jñeyaṃ nityahomaṃ tataḥ param na kuryāt kāmyahomaṃ vai vinā kuṇḍena mantravit aṅgulotsedhasaṃyuktaṃ vālukābhiḥ samantataḥ ādhāraśaktimabhyarcya pūrvavacca ṣaḍaṅgakam śabdāstramanunā mantrī nair-ṛtyāṃ jvaladagnikam agniṃ prajvālya mūlena jvālinīñca pradarśayet madhyame milite kṛtvā tanmadhye'ṅguṣṭhakau kṣipet agniṃ sampūjayitvā tu śivaśaktisamāgamāt āvāhanyādikā mudrā darśayitvā tu rakṣayet saṃsthāpya havanīyañca pūrvavat prokṣaṇañcaret pūrvavanmaṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā pūjayet pūrvavartmanā

daśadhā mūlamantreṇa abhimantrya hunettataḥ tāraṃ bhuvo vahnijāyā idañca vāyave padam ityāhutitrayaṃ hutvā mahāvyāhṛtisāṅkam ṣaḍaṅgamanunā ṣaṭkamāhutiṃ juhuyāttataḥ tataḥ svāhā samuccārya aṣṭottarasahasrakam aṣṭottaraśataṃ vāpi tadarddhaṃ vāpi sādhakaḥ māṃsena madhunā cājyairmatsyaiḥ puṣpaistilaistathā apāmārgairbilvapatrairbhṛṅgarājaiḥ suśobhanaiḥ padmaiśca kumudaiḥ kundairnīlaraktotpalaistathā jātībhirmālatībhiśca mallikābhiḥ kadambakaiḥ anena vidhinā mantrī devyā homaṃ samāpya ca guruvṛndaṃ raśmivṛndaṃ samāvāhya hunettataḥ āhutitritayaṃ hutvā punardevyai prayatnataḥ saṃhāramudrayā devīṃ oṃ agnaye tataḥ param visṛjyāgniñca devīñca śaṅkhaghaṇṭāñca vādayet devyaṅgamūrdhni saṃhṛtvā śeṣaṃ karma samācaret pañcatattvaṃ mahādevyai dattvā na svīkaroti yaḥ rogī duḥkhī daridraśca bhūtvā narakamāpnuyāt pānañca trividhaṃ proktaṃ divyavīrapaśukramāt saṃskārādivihīnaṃ yattat pānaṃ pāśavaṃ smṛtam iti śrīmajjñānānandaparamahaṃsaviracite kaulāvalīnirṇaye saptamollāsaḥ annamadhye tvaṣṭapatraṃ padmaṃ nirmāya tatra vai tato dhyāyedannapūrṇāṃ paramānandadāyinīm mambāṃ bhaje sakalabhūṣaṇabhūṣitāṅgīm tattvamudrāṃ pradarśyātha idamannāmṛtaṃ vadet

tatra santarpayedbhaktyā annapūrṇā yajettataḥ hṛdante bhagavatyante māheśvarīpadaṃ likhet yathāśakti japaṃ kṛtvā stutvā devīṃ samāhitaḥ pāpiṣṭhāste caṇḍikāyāḥ prasādabhājanaṃ nahi sādhubhaktasya jihvāyāmaśnāmi kamalekṣaṇe tasmāt kaulikavaktreṣu hotavyaṃ sādhakottamaiḥ kaulānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye yathātantrānusārataḥ kulajñānaratāḥ śāntāḥ śivabhaktā dṛḍhavratāḥ ānandāśruyutā vīrāḥ kathitāḥ kaulikeśvarāḥ iti ye niścitadhiyaḥ proktāste kaulikottamāḥ kulārcanaratapuṃsāṃ kaulikaḥ so'dhikaḥ sadā prīto bhavati yo dṛṣṭvā kaulikaḥ sa śivapriyaḥ devatāgurubhaktaścet kaulikaḥ syācca dīkṣayā yaḥ śaktīḥ svayamāhūya kulābhijñāṃstathaiva ca mādibhiḥ pañcamudrābhiḥ sadbhaktyā paritoṣayet kulajñānī vased yatra sa deśaḥ puṇyabhājanaḥ kulajñāninamālokya svagṛhe'nyagṛhe sthitam praviśya kulayogīśaṃ bhuñjate pitṛdevatāḥ devāḥ kulapriyāḥ sarve tasmāt kaulikamarcayet kuladharmaparā hyete mānuṣeṣu ca kā kathā kaulikendre'rcite samyag yathā tuṣṭā hi caṇḍikā tatphalaṃ nāpnuyāttirthaistapovratamakhaiḥ sadā kaulikasya bhaved vyarthaṃ kaulikaṃ yo'vamānayet kulaniṣṭhaṃ parityajya yaccānyasmai pradīyate pāpācārasamāyuktaṃ sarvalokabahiṣkṛtam

kaulikendraḥ sakṛdbhuṅkte puṇyaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet tasmāt sarvaprayatnena sarvāvasthāsu sarvathā nandanti pitaraḥ sarve gāyanti ca pitāmahāḥ yajñakoṭiphalaṃ tasya vājapeyaśatāni ca pṛthivī hemapūrṇā ca kalpakoṭipradānataḥ kaulikeṣu prasanneṣu prasannā caṇḍikā bhavet punāti kuladharmiṣṭhaścaṇḍālo'pi yadṛcchayā sarvathaiva śivaḥ so'pi tasmādyatnāt samarcayet yatsamīpaṃ samāyānti kulācāryāśca sādhakāḥ svaśaktiṃ vīraśaktiṃ vā dīkṣitāṃ gṛhiṇīmatha anivedya tu yaḥ śaktau kuladravyaṃ niṣevate vinā yantreṇa yā pūjā vinā māṃsena tarpaṇam āhūto yo nivarteta anāhūto'pi yo viśet tiraścāṃ yonimālambya narakān pratipadyate tataḥ kaulāḥ striyaḥ sarvā prakṣālya pāṇipādakam strīṇāmanyatamaṃ sthānaṃ puṃsāmanyatamaṃ pṛthak paṅktyākāreṇa vā samyak cakrākāreṇa vā'thavā taṃ bhakṣayanti yoginyastaṃ śapeccaṇḍikā sadā pravṛtte bhairavīcakre sarve varṇā dvijātayaḥ rahasyamārganiratā ye ye varṇā bhavanti hi svargādipuṇyalokeṣu devādanyo yathā na hi vede'pi sthitamevaṃ hi sarvaṃ brahmeti cābravīt puruṣāḥ śivarūpāśca devīrūpāḥ striyaḥ sadā saṃskārājjyeṣṭhakramato lalāṭe gandhacandanaiḥ kṛtvā vilepanaṃ mālyaṃ pradadyāt sādhakottamaḥ

nayanāgnivāṇasaṃkhyātaiḥ karṣantu sādhakena ca ityapyadhikapānaṃ tu na kartavyaṃ tu sādhakaiḥ tataḥ śrīgurupādāya sākṣāt paraśivāya ca dattvāmṛtarasaṃ pūrṇaṃ gurave tadanantaram kulajāya kulīnāya kulabhaktāya dāpayet vīrebhyo vīrapātrañca bhogapātraṃ svayaṃ pibet sudhābuddhyā tataḥ sarve gṛhītvā pātramuttamam samudre madhyamāne tu kṣīrābdhau sāgarottame gomūtrasadṛśākārāṃ phenāmṛtasamudbhavām ānandaśikhare jāta ānandaśca maheśvaraḥ tasmādimāṃ surādevīṃ pūrṇo'haṃ tāṃ bhajāmyaham tasyopari tato vīraḥ pañca mudrāḥ pradarśayet tālatrayachoṭikābhiḥ kurvīta dikṣu bandhanam ānandabhairavīṃ devīṃ gurupaṅktiṃ prayatnataḥ vaṭukaṃ bhairavañcaiva yoginīṃ ḍākinīṃ tathā ayaṣṭvā bhairavaṃ devamakṛtvā gurutarpaṇam gurupaṅktīrasantarpyaraśmivṛndaṃ tathaiva ca kaulajñānaṃ vinā yo'pi taddravyaṃ bhauktumicchati seveta madyamāṃsāni bhraṣṭaśca pātakī bhavet bhedapāśavinirmukto madyapānaṃ samācaret pāśayeddevatāprītyai tattvamāṃsāni sādhakaḥ yāgakālaṃ vinā'nyatra dūṣaṇaṃ jāyate sadā na sa siddhimavāpnoti paratra na parāṃ gatim na tasya sadgatiḥ kā'pi tapasā sukṛtādibhiḥ pūrṇābhiṣekahīnānāṃ pānamatyantadurgatiḥ

ye'smin cakre pravartante teṣāṃ hiṃsanti bhairavāḥ japapūjāṃ vinā naiva na kāryaṃ dravyabhakṣaṇam mantrasaṃskāraśuddhātmā alipānaṃ samācaret vicārayettato vīraḥ sattarkeṇa viśeṣataḥ kāñjikaṃ kāsamardañca tathaiva ca śivāghṛtam surāṃ pītvā dvijo mohādagnivarṇāṃ surāṃ pibet mohādajñānataḥ pītvā prāyaścittaṃ vidhīyate devān pitṝn samabhyarcya vedaśāstroktavartmanā guruṃ smaran pibanmadyaṃ khādanmāṃsaṃ na doṣabhāk yathā kratuṣu viprāṇāṃ somapānaṃ vidhīyate phalārthināmahaṅkāravatāṃ dūṣaṇameva hi pānerbhrāntirbhaved yasya ghṛṇā syādraktaretasoḥ sa bhraṣṭaḥ pūjayeccaṇḍīṃ devīmantraṃ kathaṃ japet tasmādadvaitabhāvena sādhakaḥ pañcamaṃ bhajet ānandaḥ śekharaḥ prokta ānandastu sadāśivaḥ aho bhuktañca madyaṃ hi mohayet tridaśānapi tayoraikyasamutpannamānandaṃ mokṣa ucyate tasyābhivyañjakaṃ madyaṃ yogibhistena pīyate pūrvavadvidhinā vīraḥ pātrasya vandanaṃ caret vande śrīprathamaṃ karāmbujagataṃ pātraṃ viśuddhipradam jānatā'jānatā vāpi yanmayā kriyate śive iti stutvā mahādevīmanyonya vandanañcaret juṣasvetyanujñāto guruṇā vā kulīnakaiḥ savyenoddhṛtya pātrañca mudrāṃ kṛtvā'pasavyataḥ noddharedekahastena na pibedekapāṇinā

ātmamūlatrikoṇasthe koṭisūryasamaprabhe saśabdaṃ na pibeddravyaṃ na binduṃ pātayedadhaḥ rauravaṃ narakaṃ yāti yāvadāhutasaṃplavam tasmāt pracarvayeccarvyaṃ yathākramavidhānataḥ ekapātre pibeddravyaṃ te yānti narakaṃ kila bahiḥ prakṣālya ca karau kuladravyāṇi dāpayet niṣṭhīvanaṃ malaṃ mūtramadhovāyuvisarjanam parīhāsaṃ pralāpañca vitaṇḍāṃ bahubhāṣaṇam na pādābhyāṃ spṛśet pātramadhamāṅgena sarvathā saśabdaṃ noddharet pātraṃ tathaiva ca na pūrayet sādhāraṃ noddharet pātramanādhāre na niḥkṣipet na pātraṃ laṅghayeddhīmān utkṣipya na ca pātayet vandayecca punaḥ pātraṃ imaṃ mantraṃ smaredbudhaḥ vande pātramahaṃ dvitīyamadhunā'nandaikasamvarddhanam mudrayā sahitaṃ dhṛtvā vandayet pātramuttamam dhyātaṃ devagaṇaiḥ paraṃ munigaṇairmokṣārthibhiḥ sarvadā vandepātramahaṃ tṛtīyamadhunā svātmāvabodhakṣamam pūrvavattarpayitvā tu caturthaṃ vandayettataḥ pāyāt pañcamakāratattvasahitaṃ pātraṃ caturthaṃ namaḥ pūrvavattarpayitvā tu pañcamaṃ vandayettataḥ ādityapramukhaiḥ surāsuragaṇairājñākaraiḥ kiṅkaraiḥ prapibet tu tataḥ ṣaṣṭhaṃ pātraṃ sampūjya mantravit śrīmat sundaritarpaṇaṃ harirasaṃ pātrañca ṣaṣṭhaṃ bhaje pūrvavat tarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā saptamañca samarcayet pātraṃ saptamapūraṇena paramānandādhikaṃ pātu mām labheta sarvakarmāṇi dehānte bhairavo bhavet

pītvā saptamapātrañca śāntistotraṃ paṭhettataḥ cintāmaṇiṃ kulagaṇādhipatiṃ namāmi devīsutaṃ vaṭukanāthamahaṃ namāmi diśatu sakalakāmān kaulikānāṃ gaṇeśaḥ śāpāḥ patantu samayadviṣi yoginīnām stā devyo ripupakṣabhakṣaṇaparāstṛpyantu kaulārcitāḥ stṛpyantāṃ kulaputrakasya pibataḥ pānaṃ sadīpaṃ carum satyañcāpi ca kauladharmaparamaṃ syānme jayaḥ sarvadā kālāgnyādiśivāntañca jagad yajñena tṛpyatu karotu śāntiṃ bhagavān gaṇeśaḥ doṣāḥ prayāntu śāntiṃ sarvajanāḥ sukhībhavantu nandantu ca kulācāryā ye cānye kulapālakāḥ avasthā śāmbhavī no'stu prasano'stu guruḥsadā prītāḥ prasannā varadā bhavantu ste te yāntu vināśamatra samaye śrībhairavasyājñayā ḍākinīnāṃ mukhe yāntu tṛptāste piśitaiḥ sadā iti stotraṃ paṭhan pānaṃ kuryāt sādhakasattamaḥ devīṃ vakṣasi sañjapannanudinaṃ pātraṃ bhaje cāṣṭamam pūrvavattarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā navamañca prapūjayet tatpātraṃ navamaṃ pibecca niyataṃ bhuktiñca muktipradam yathāvidhisamabhyarcya juhuyāt kuṇḍalīmukhe tatpātraṃ daśamaṃ pibecca paramaṃ bhuktiñca muktipradam so'haṃ pratyakcitsvarūpo'hamātmā evaṃ sañcintya vīrendraḥ punaḥ pānaṃ samācaret pānollāsavilāsapūrṇasamaye pātrañca ekādaśam

datte ca siddhihāniḥ syād devatāśāpamāpnuyāt ādāya svīyapātrañca pibed dravyaṃ guruṃ smaran ucchiṣṭaṃ bhakṣayet strīṇāṃ tābhyo nocchiṣṭamarpayet śaktyucchiṣṭaṃ pibeddravyaṃ vīrocchiṣṭañca carvaṇam kaniṣṭhebhyaḥ svaśiṣyebhyaścocchiṣṭañca pradāpayet yāvanna calate dṛṣṭiryāvanna calate manaḥ mantrārthasphuraṇārthāya brahmajñāna sthirāya ca pītvā pītvā punaḥ pītvā patitvā ca mahītale alimīnāṅganāsaṅge yat sukhaṃ jāyate nṝṇām cakramadhye ghaṭe bhagne pātre ca patite tathā dīpanāśe ca tacchāntyai punaścakraṃ samācaret pūrvavat tarpayeddevīṃ parivārasamanvitām dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ tataḥ paścāddarpaṇaṃ cāmaraṃ tathā yathāśakti stavaṃ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇīkṛtya sādhakaḥ oṃ itaḥ pūrvaṃ tataḥ prāṇabuddhidehaṃ tato vadet karmaṇā manasā vācā hastābhyāñca tataḥ padbhyām yaduktaṃ procya tatsarvaṃ māṃ madīyañca saṃlikhet samarpaṇaṃ tataḥ paścādetenaiva samarpayet punarācamanīyañca dadyāddevyai punaḥ punaḥ arghyapātraṃ tataḥ paścāduttolya sādhakottamaḥ tejomayīṃ mahādevīṃ saṃhāramudrayā hṛdi nirmālyakusumairdevīṃ praṇamya gurupādukām kṛtvā so'haṃ vibhāvyātha sādhakaḥ sthiramānasaḥ nāstikebhyo na paśubhyo na mūrkhebhyo pradāpayet naivedyaṃ caṇḍikādevyā vāñchanti vibudhāḥ sadā

mahyaṃ śukrāya sūryāya gaṇeśāya yamāya ca īśānāya mahādevīsādhakāya prakalpayet yatnataḥ sādhakaśreṣṭho nirmālyāni samarpayet mālyaṃ gandhaṃ tato dattvā ātmadehaṃ tato'rpayet śrīpātragrahaṇaṃ kṛtvā ādau cakraṃ karoti yaḥ arghyāmṛtaṃ tato vīraḥ sāmayikebhyo nivedayet prabandhe pūrṇapātrañca pragṛhya sādhakottamaḥ dāsvādyāpi pibedrasaṃ sukhakaraṃ duḥkhasya nirmūlanam arghyasya bindumātreṇa mukto bhavati pātakāt nyubjīkuryācca tadbhūmau tatra puṣpaṃ kṣiped budhaḥ kaniṣṭhāṅgulinā vāmahastasya tilakaṃ tathā yaṃ yaṃ spṛśāmi pādena yaṃ yaṃ paśyāmi cakṣuṣā tataḥ prakṣālya vīrendro gopayet pātramuttamam bhojayecca tato vidvān strībhiśca sādhakaiḥ saha tāmbūlābharaṇādīṃśca tathā talpaṃ susādhakaḥ jāyate bhairavāveśaḥ sarvatra samadarśanaḥ vāraṇāt tripurā ruṣṭā tato hānistu jāyate goṣṭhīmadhye tu yatnena sparśaṃ tasya na kārayet madhumattāya vīrāya puṇyaṃ tasya na gaṇyate bhagarūpā ca sā devī retaḥprītā ca sarvadā dhyātvā kuṇḍalinīṃ śaktiṃ raman reto vimuñcayet ātmadehasvarūpeṇa tatkarṇe mantramutsṛjet ratikāle ca dīkṣāyāmabhiṣekaṃ samācaret sambhoge'bhiṣicennārīṃ raṇḍāñca mantravarjitām namaḥ śabdaṃ samuccārya imāṃ śiktaṃ tato vadet

vahnijāyāṃ samuccārya śuddhimantraḥ prakīrttitaḥ ramamāṇo bhavennityaṃ sarvasiddhimavāpnuyāt rambhā śacyurvaśī mukhyā yā nārī gagane bhuvi tasya varjyā ca yā nārī kathyate tantravartmanā manasā karmaṇā vācā ramaṇaṃ tatra varjayet guroḥ snuṣā ca kanyā ca svaputrī mantraputrikā kaulikasya ca patnī vai sākṣāt siddhīśvarī śivā mātā'pi gauravādvarjyā śivahīnā tathaiva ca mantramātā ca putrī ca bhaginī ca kulāṅganā guruvīravadhūṃ tyaktvā ramyāḥ sarvāśca yoṣitaḥ advaitānāñca kutrāpi niṣedho naiva vidyate garbhaniḥsārakāle tu bālako hi digambaraḥ jananīyonisambandhaḥsutaḥ śiśnā'dhigacchati nirvikāratayā nātra bhavet nahyanyathā tataḥ tadā doṣāya bhavati nānyathā dūṣaṇaṃ kvacit tadārūḍheṣu vīreṣu kāryākāryaṃ na vidyate niścayaṃ muktimāpnoti sahasrayonidarśanāt amedhyamapi medhyaṃ syāddvaitānāñca niścitam agamyā'pi ca gamyā syāddvaitānāṃ suniścitam na svargo naiva narakamadvaitānāñca niścitam tatra tatrāpi boddhavyaṃ sandigdhānāṃ suniścitam tasmācca yatnato vīro guruyoniṃ parityajet pañcatattvamasaṃyuktaṃ pañcamaṃ yastu kārayet tattvahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ karma japakarma ca niṣphalam cakraṃ tyaktvā tu deveśīṃ pūjayettarpaṇaṃ vinā

cakramadhye tu yaddṛṣṭaṃ śubhaṃ vā yadi vā'śubham nityapūjā ca kathitā sādhakānāṃ susiddhaye iti śrīmajjñānānandaparamahaṃsaviracite kaulāvalīnirṇaye aṣṭamollāsaḥ atyantagopanādyastu pañcatattvena pūjayet tasmāt pūjāṃ sadā kuryāt siddhārthī siddhisaṃgrahaḥ sarvapraśamanaṃ yāti īśvaro jāyate bhuvi pūjāhīno'śucirnityaṃ garhitaḥ sarvakarmasu tajjapaṃ viphalaṃ vidyāt sa mantrī pātakī bhavet sa mahāpātakī bhūtvā paśuyonimavāpnuyāt pāraṇaṃ yoginīnāñca bhairavāṇāṃ bhaveddhruvam yadgehe pūjayed devīṃ sadaiva tatra pūjanam divase pañcamaiḥ pūjā rāṣṭrahāniṃ karoti hi tasmāt pañcamakāreṇa divase naiva sarvadā māsapūjā'dhamā proktā māsādūrdhvaṃ paśurbhavet vihitairmādibhirdravyairmāsādūrdhvaṃ samācaret saṃkrāntiḥ pañcaparvāṇi puṇyādi divaseṣu ca pīṭhopagamane vīrākulapīṭhasya darśane evamādiṣu kāleṣu viśeṣadivaseṣu ca mānavaughādipuṃsāñca svajanmadivase'pi ca aṣṭamyāñca caturdaśyāṃ pūjā kāryā prayatnataḥ iti pūrvāpare prāpte pañcatattvaiśca sādhakaḥ bahiḥpūjāvidhānena gandharvo vāpi kinnaraḥ yatirvā bhūpatirvāpi nānyo'sti pūjakaḥ kvacit devaścidānandamayo hṛdi bhāvena dṛśyate tatra tatra mahādevī prakāśamanugacchati

vārāṇasyāṃ mahāpūjā sampūrṇaphaladāyinī tato'pi dviguṇā proktā dvārakāyāṃ viśeṣataḥ vindhye śataguṇā proktā gaṅgāyāmapi tatsamā vindhyavat phaladā pūjā prayāge puṣkareṣu ca tasmāccaturguṇaphalā nandikuṇḍe ca niścitam tataḥ siddhīśvarīyonau tato'pi dviguṇā smṛtā tatsamā kāmarūpe ca sarvatraiva jale sthale devīpūjā tathā śaktyāṃ kāmarūpe surālaye karatoyānadīpūrvaṃ yāvaddikkaravāsinī trikoṇaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇañca kāmarūpamudāhṛtam vyaktād guptaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ labhyate sādhakottamaiḥ anyatra viralā devī kāmarūpe gṛhe gṛhe tato'pi dviguṇā proktā sumerau śivaliṅgake tataḥ śataguṇā proktā kāmākhyāyonimaṇḍale pīṭhānāṃ paramaṃ pīṭhaṃ kāmarūpaṃ mahākulam yatra koṭiguṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ māyā mahiṣamardinī yato devāśca devyaśca munayaścaiva bhāvajāḥ kāmākhyāyāṃ mahāyonau pūjāṃ yaḥ kṛtavān sakṛt atra yatkriyate pūjā sakṛdvā sādhakena ca atha vakṣyāmi sāmānya pūjāyāḥ kramamuttamam aṅgulīvyāpakanyāsau hṛdādinyāsa eva ca dhyānaṃ pūjā japaśceti sarvatantreṣvayaṃ vidhiḥ kṛtañca niṣphalaṃ vidyāt tasmādādau lipiṃ nyaset na dadāti baliṃ yastu śivāyāḥ śivatāptaye paśurūpāṃ śivāṃ devīṃ yo nārcayati nirjane

pūjā japavidhānāni yatkiñcit sukṛtāni ca avaśyamannapānena niyataṃ toṣayecchivām tadaiva sarvaśaktīnāṃ prītiḥ paramadurlabhā pūjitā viguṇaṃ karma saguṇaṃ sādhayed yataḥ rājādibhayamāpanne grahādibhayameva ca bilvamūle prāntare vā śmaśāne vāpi sādhakaḥ gṛhṇa devi mahābhāge śive kālāgnirūpiṇi evamuccārya dātavyo baliḥ kulajanapriyaḥ paśurūpā samāyāti parivāragaṇaiḥ saha tadaiva maṅgalaṃ tasya nānyathā sādhakasya ca nitye naimittike kāmye baliṃ dadyāt prayatnataḥ kulapūjāṃ pravakṣyāmi yathāśāstravidhānataḥ kulatithau kularkṣe ca kulapūjāṃ samācaret yathā viṣṇutithau viṣṇuḥ pūjito vāñchitapradaḥ nityaśrāddhaṃ tathā sandhyāvandanaṃ pitṛtarpaṇam ekarātraṃ dvirātraṃ vā nahi cet kulapūjanam kulapūjāsamaṃ nāsti puṇyamanyajjagattraye anadhīto'pyaśāstrajño gurubhakto dṛḍhavrataḥ icchāsiddhiphalaṃ dadyāt pūjitā suvadhūriva kulapūjāntarāyaṃ tu yaḥ karoti hi durmatiḥ viguṇaṃ yatra yadyat syāt saguṇaṃ kulapūjanāt kva snānaṃ kva ca vā śuddhiḥ kva ca nyāsaviśodhanam labhate sarvasiddhiñca nātra kāryā vicāraṇā dvitīyā daśamī ṣaṣṭhī kulākulamudāhṛtam raviḥ somo guruḥ śauriścatvāraścākulā matāḥ

vāruṇārdrābhijinmūlaṃ kulākulamudāhṛtam tithivāre ca nakṣatre cākule sthāyino'jayaḥ paurṇamāsyantamāsena tithikṛtyaṃ vidhīyate kathitaḥ kulavārādinirṇayaḥ siddhihetave lākṣārasatadvadahe vīrastūlikāṃ racayettataḥ brāhmaṇī bhadrakanyā ca tathā gopālakanyakā caṇḍālī carmakārī ca māgadhīpukkasī tathā kulāṣṭakaṃ tu kathitamakulāṣṭakamucyate gomukhī rajakī śilpī venakī ca tathāṣṭamī tantukārī carmakārī mātaṅgī pukkasī tathā rajakī rajjakī caiva sairindhrī ca vilāsinī viśeṣavaidagdhyayutāḥ sarvā eva kulāṅganāḥ mantratantrasamāyuktāḥ samayācārapālikāḥ gurubhaktā devabhaktā ghṛṇālajjāvivarjitāḥ dīkṣitā manunā yena kena mūlena vā punaḥ vikṛtāṃ vidhavāṃ vyaṅgīṃ vṛddhāñcaiva tapasvinīm lokavedaviruddhāñca tathā niṣṭhurabhāṣiṇīm īrṣyādidoṣasaṃyuktāṃ pramattāñca vivarjayet varṣīyasīṃ pāparatāṃ krūrāmatyantalolupām tataḥ samānayed vīraḥ pūrvoktāṣṭakulodbhavām ghṛṇāhrīṃvarjitāṃ śāntāṃ śivavākyadṛḍhavratām svakāntāṃ parakāntāṃ vā vidagdhāṃ cāruhāsinīm sādhayet siddhimatulāṃ sādhakaḥ sthiramānasaḥ tasyā dehe svakalpoktanyāsajālaṃ pravinyaset brahmaviṣṇuśivānāñca yonirutpattikāriṇī

guṇatrayasamāpannā vākyatrayavibhāvinī bhagarūpeṇa sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ dehamadhyagā sarveṣāṃ jananī sā tu ratyarthaṃ ramaṇī parā yasyāṃ tu jāyate jantustasyāṃ cānte pralīyate devī bhagavatī khyātā bhagavāṃśca sadāśivaḥ sarveṣāṃ yonirūpeṇa sā devī bhagarūpiṇī trikoṇā sā triguṇā sā tridaivatamayī parā tasmādyonau yajed devīṃ nityamānandarūpiṇīm sindūrarajasā caiva yonau cakraṃ samālikhet sarvayoṣinmaye devi sarvakāmārthadāyini anenā'vāhayed devīṃ svīyakramamathācaret yāvat puṃsāṃ prasaṅgo'tra tāvat svairaṃ vivarjayet pramādādyadi pāpātmā tatsaṅgamanugacchati madyaṃ māṃsaṃ vinā yastu kulapūjāṃ samācaret vidhivat pūjanaṃ kṛtvā japtvā stutvā praṇamya ca yāvat sā vihvalā na syāttāvattāṃ na visarjayet tasyā ājñāṃ gṛhītvā tu ret mai naṃ rva ca van thu pū madyaṃ māṃsaṃ tathā cānyaṃ yatkiñcit kulasādhanam tadanujñāṃ mūrdhni kṛtvā śeṣamātmani yojayet kulapūjanametattu kathitaṃ siddhihetave āliṅganaṃ bhavennyāsaścumbanaṃ dhyānamīritam pānaṃ jihvāmṛtaṃ jñeyaṃ ramaṇañca japo bhavet advaitajñānamāśritya sadā devīṃ samarcayet puṇyapāpairna lipyante yeṣāṃ brahma hṛdi sthitam jihvopasthaparityāgī karmaṇā kiṃ kariṣyati

pūjākoṭisamaṃ stotraṃ stotrakoṭisamo japaḥ nahi dhyānāt paro mantro na devastvātmanaḥ paraḥ mantrodakairvinā sandhyāṃ japahomairvinā tapaḥ deho devālayo devi jīvo devaḥ sadāśivaḥ jīvaḥ śivaḥ śivo jīvaḥ sa jīvaḥ kevalaḥ śivaḥ tuṣeṇa baddho brīhiḥ syāt tuṣābhāve tu taṇḍulam dhyāyatāṃ kṣaṇamātraṃ vā śraddhayā paramaṃ tviha tatsarvaṃ pātakaṃ hanyāttamaḥ sūryodaye yathā yasya brahma vicāraṇe kṣaṇamapi prāptañca dhairyaṃ manaḥ yatphalaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ tadevāpnoti tattvavit japastutiḥ syādadhamā homapūjā'dhamādhamā śāstracintā'dhamā jñeyā lokacintā'dhamādhamā samaścet sa tu yogīndro harṣāharṣavivarjitaḥ āste dehe pravāsīva sa yogī paratattvavit nijasvarūpanirmagnaḥ sa yogī paratattvavit nivasanti ca sarvatra sa yogī paramo mataḥ ya āste sa tu yogīndraḥ paśyatyātmānamātmani tena santuṣṭahṛdayaiḥ sevyā devī na saṃśayaḥ iti śrīmajjñānānandaparahaṃsaviracite kaulāvalīnirṇaye navamollāsaḥ sarvabhūtahite yuktaḥ samayācāratatparaḥ mantradhāraṇamātreṇa śivabhāvena tatparaḥ yeṣāñca niścalābhaktirgurau deve manāvapi gururbrahmā gururviṣṇurgururdevo maheśvaraḥ teṣāṃ siddhirbhavedāśu nābhaktasya kadācana sampūjya sakalaṃ karma kuryāttasyā'jñayā sadā

ajñātvā guruvaṃśānāṃ śiṣyaścennaṣṭasantatiḥ naṣṭamārgān mantravidye na tādṛksiddhigocare tantramantrāśca vidyāśca niṣphalā nātra saṃśayaḥ utpādakabrahmadātrorgarīyān mantradaḥ pitā gamanaṃ pūjanaṃ svapnaṃ bhojanaṃ ramaṇaṃ tathā gurau manuṣyabuddhiñca mantre cākṣarabhāvanām gurau mānuṣabuddhyā na paśyet śiṣyaḥ kadācana śrīguruṃ prākṛtaiḥ sārddhaṃ ye smaranti vadanti ca cāpalyaṃ parihāsañca guroḥ sākṣādvivarjayet śrīgurau saṃsthite sākṣāt kiṃ vṛthā dhyānayogataḥ sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ sā pūjā viphalā bhavet tadagre mantratantrāṇāṃ bhāṣaṇaṃ naiva kārayet sarveṣāṃ mantratantrāṇāṃ pitā'sau yaḥ sadāśivaḥ gurudevaṃ vinā caiva tadagre narakaṃ vrajet tasyā'śu siddhayaḥ sarvāḥ santi pādatale sadā tasya siddhirbhavedāśu pūjāhomajapādṛte pratyakṣe vā parokṣe vā pratyahaṃ praṇamed gurum dīkṣāṃ vyākhyāṃ prabhutvañca guroragre na kārayet ṛṇadānaṃ tathā'dānaṃ vastūnāṃ krayavikrayam ājñābhaṅgo'rthaharaṇaṃ gurorapriyavartanam snehadravyaniyogañca nā'nivedya gurau caret gurunāma na bhāṣeta japakālādṛte kvacit guruṃ tuṅkṛtya huṅkṛtya vācā nirbhartsya yaḥ kadā siddhiṃ siddhādhivāsāṃśca śrīpūrvaṃ samudīrayet ekākṣarapradātāraṃ yo guruñcāvamānayet

gurvagre na tapaḥ kuryānnopavāsavratādikam na niyogaṃ gurordadyād duṣṭatāṃ na vibhāvayet avaśyaṃ yadi vāñchā syādanubhūyāttadājñayā mohāllobhāt patedyastu narake ca trisaptake tiraścāṃ yonimālambya kravyādairbhakṣyate sadā patitasyāpi tasyāpi prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate gobrāhmaṇavadhaṃ kṛtvā yatpāpaṃ samavāpnuyāt yadyatra guruṇā sārddhaṃ svapityupaviśettu yaḥ guruvākyahataṃ kṛtvā ātmavākyaṃ tu ropayet anekadhā paśorannaṃ bhuñjate ye ca kaulikāḥ lakṣatrayañjapellopāṃ lakṣaṃ vā'pyajapāṃ japet guruṇā'lokitaḥ śiṣya uttiṣṭhedāsanaṃ tyajet rabhasaṃ maithunaṃ mithyā yo vaded gurumandire na viśedāsane dhīro devatāgurusannidhau deśyāsanaṃ kaniṣṭhānāmitareṣāṃ samāsanam phalapuṣpādikaṃ nītvā yathā śaktyā samarpayet āliṅganapradānena gurau tuṣṭe sakṛdyadi gurutyāge dhruvo mṛtyurmantratyāgāddaridratā gurutyāgakaraḥ śiṣyaḥ prāyaścittī bhaveddhruvam mantratyāgakaraḥ śiṣyastatsaṅgaṃ naiva kārayet brahmāparāśaravyāsaviśvāmitrādayaḥ punaḥ śivo guruprasādena sarvavitsarvagaḥ prabhuḥ tadā kimvā na labhante sādhakā gurusevakāḥ sarvadā gopayedenaṃ guruñca manumeva ca snānodakaṃ tathā chāyāṃ laṅghayenna kadācana

gamayed devatāpūjājapayāgastavādinā gamayedaniśaṃ kālaṃ na vadet paradūṣaṇam kulācāraṃ guruṃ devaṃ manasā'pi na nindayet pratyahaṃ sādhakaḥ kuryāt svayañcet siddhimicchati nālokayet paradravyaṃ paradārāśca varjayet purāṇāgamaśāstrāṇi kalpāṃścāpi na dūṣayet ekasyāvāhanaṃ kṛtvā nānyasādhanamācaret apamṛtyubhavettasya mṛte ca narakaṃ vrajet kuladarśanaśāstrāṇi kuladravyāṇi kaulikān śikṣakān mokṣakān vāpi yoiginīsiddhirūpakān na nindenna jugupseta na hasennāvamānayet kurūpeti nikṛṣṭeti na vadet kulayoṣitam yā kācidaṅganā loke sā mātṛkulasambhavā strīṇāṃ śatāparādhena puṣpeṇāpi na tāḍayet kularodhaprahārañca varjayenmatimān sadā na hiṃsedakhilān jantūnna nindedvāmalocanām na nindet śaktisiddhāntaṃ śaktipūjanatatparaḥ na ninded bahumānyañca na nindecca pativratām na ninded bahulaṃ māṃsaṃ nindāṃ sarvatra varjayet virūpāṃ muktakeśīñca kāmārttāñca na nindayet śaktirūpā yato devī sṛṣṭimadhye vyavasthitā tasmāt śaktiḥ pradhānā ca pūjanīyā prayatnataḥ āraktavasanāṃ nārīṃ yatnād bhaktyā samānayet sukhaṃ śaktiprasanne tu duḥkhaṃ tadvarjanād bhavet śaktau nivedya prathamaṃ tathā cā'bharaṇādikam

śaktau darpaṃ ghṛṇāṃ lajjāṃ varjayet krodhadarśanam śaktau na vismayaṃ kāryaṃ yasmāt kruddhā ca caṇḍikā mṛte'pi narakaṃ yāti śriyamāpnoti pūjanāt sarvañca yuvatīrūpaṃ bhāvayet yatamānasaḥ yadi bhāgyavaśenaiva kuladṛṣṭistu jāyate bālāṃ vā yauvanonmattāṃ vṛddhāṃ vā sundarīṃ tathā tāsāṃ prahāraṃ nindāñca kauṭilyamapi cāpriyam striyo devyaḥ striyaḥ prāṇāḥ striya eva vibhūṣaṇam na paśyet patitāṃ nagnāmunmattāṃ prakaṭastanīm viparītaratā sā tu bhavitā hṛdayopari japasthāne mahāśaṅkhaṃ niveśyordhvaṃ japañcaret māṃsamatsyadadhi kṣaudrabhakṣyadravye yathāruci vinā pītvā surāṃ bhuktvā māṃsaṃ gatvā rajasvalām antaḥśāktā bahiḥśaivāḥ sabhāyāṃ vaiṣṇavā matāḥ kulapūjādiliṅgaistu rahito viṣṇutatparaḥ harināmnā jātabhāvo bhāvākhilaviceṣṭitaḥ smarttavyā ca mahādevī kulīnairvipine gṛhe na karoti kathañcaiva sādhakaḥ kauliko bhavet dikkālaniyamo nātra sthityādiniyamo na ca svecchāniyama ukto'tra śaktimantrasya sādhane pūjanaṃ mānasaṃ divyaṃ mānasaṃ tarpaṇādikam na viśeṣo divārātrau na sandhyāyāṃ mahāniśi śuddhiṃ na cācarettatra nirvikalpaṃ manaścaret ya evaṃ cintayenmantrī sarvakāmārthasiddhibhāk tasya darśanamātreṇa vādino niṣprabhāṃ gatāḥ

sarvadevamayaṃ dehaṃ sarvadevamayīṃ tanūm ātmā ca paramātmā ca jagadvyāpī svayaṃ vibhuḥ śatravaścāpi mitranti sākṣāddāsanti bhūmipāḥ durmukhāḥ sumukhāḥ sarve garvitā praṇamanti ca sarvadā pūjayed devīmasnātaḥ kṛtabhojanaḥ atyantarogayukto vā śucirvā'pyathavā'śuciḥ kṛtārthaṃ manyamānastu santuṣṭanijamānasaḥ kulānnañcaiva bhuñjīta kulīnena saha svapet yasminmantre ya ācārastasya dharmastu tādṛśaḥ taddhastāvacitaṃ puṣpaṃ devatābhyo nivedayet sadākālaṃ japenmantraṃ sarvasiddhiparāyaṇaḥ japaniṣṭho japedyastu sarvayajñaphalaṃ labhet rātrau japaikamātreṇa siddhidā caṇḍikā bhavet piṅgalāyāṃ gate jīve puṃmantraṃ prajapet sadā kṛtārthastena jāyeta svargo vā mokṣa eva vā vismitā vilayaṃ yānti paśavaḥ śāstramohitāḥ etaistu tatkṣaṇāt siddhirvismayo nāsti cāparaḥ kulācāraparibhraṣṭo rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet kulabhraṣṭasya kutrāpi na draṣṭā niṣkṛtiḥ kvacit yoginīnāṃ prakopaśca skhalitāni pade pade ninditaḥ sarvavidviṣṭo vihvalaḥ saṅgavarjitaḥ tatrāpi kulamārgasthāḥ śākinyaḥ kulapālikāḥ tasmādācāravān vīro yoginīnāṃ priyo bhavet tiryagyoniṃ samāpnoti kaulikastadviparyayāt saṃskārasya vihīnatvād guruvākyasya laṅghanāt

bhogo mokṣāyate tasya pātakaṃ sukṛtāyate pañcatattvena karttavyaṃ sadaiva pūjanaṃ mahat ityācāraparaḥ śrīmān japapūjāparāyaṇaḥ aṇimādyaṣṭasiddhīnāmāśrayaḥ sādhako bhavet kāyakleśañca nāstikyaṃ tīrthayātrāmupoṣaṇam vīrahatyā vṛthāpānaṃ vīradravyāpahāritā mahāpātakamityuktaṃ sarvathā parivarjayet bhuktvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ kuryāt siddhavidyāprapūjakaḥ na chedayet kadambañca tripurāpūjakaḥ sadā kuladharmaṃ samāśritya ācāraṃ yo na pālayet niṣkṛtirnāsti tasyaiva mahārauravasaṅkule guptaprakaṭasambhūtaṃ jñānājñānakṛtaṃ tathā prāyaścittaṃ tatra tatra karttavyaṃ sādhakena ca deśaṃ kālaṃ vayo vittaṃ samyak jñātvā yathāvidhi śiṣyo'pi khalu tatproktaṃ prāyaścittaṃ samācaret jāmbūnadasya kaluṣaṃ pariśuddhaṃ yathā'gninā lakṣaṃ nāmno gurorjāpe sarvapāpādviśuddhyati japānmucyeta pāpebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ sādhakaḥ sadā viyacchaktistataḥ kāmaḥ kṣauṇī ca parameśvarī candro'naṅgo dharādevī lopāmudrā prakāśitā varṇāśramāṇāṃ sarveṣāmācāraḥ sadgatipradaḥ tathā prāpnotyasandehaḥ śiṣyapāpaṃ guruḥ sadā na gṛhṇāti hi śiṣyaścet tadā pāpaṃ gurorna hi kadācinnaiva kuryāddhi śūdrāgre vedapāṭhavat kuladravyādikañcāpi na vadet paśusannidhau

kuladharmaṃ tathā caiva paśubhyaḥ parirakṣayet vāñchadāsiddhimavāpnoti nāśayanti prakāśakān nityaṃ pañcaguṇairbhajasva tapasā bhogena tāṃ sādhaka ! iti śrīmajjñānānandaparamahaṃsaviracite kaulāvalīnirṇaye daśamollāsaḥ bhāvastu trividhaḥ prokto divyavīrapaśukramāt ādyabhāvo mahān śreyān sarvasiddhipradāyakaḥ bahujāpāttathā homāt kāyakleśādi vistaraiḥ kiṃ vīrasādhanairlakṣaiḥ kimvā'kṛṣṭakulākulaiḥ svakule prītidānena kiṃ pareṣāntathaiva ca yadi bhāvaviśuddhātmā na syāt kulaparāyaṇaḥ bhāvena gotravṛddhiḥ syād bhāvena kāyaśodhanam kiṃ vṛthā pūjanenaiva yadi bhāvo na jāyate phalābhāvaśca niyataṃ bhāvābhāvāt prajāyate yadvarṇaṃ devatā yatra tattejaḥpuñjapūritam tattanmūrttimayairmantraiḥ svena svenaiva vā punaḥ tatsarvaṃ yoṣiti dhyātvā cintayedyatamānasaḥ tatra bhāvaprakāśaścet sa bhāvaḥ paramo mataḥ tasyā nakhamaṇijyotsnākhaṇḍitāghatamo bhavet suvṛttajānunā cārujaṅghorujaghanaśriyā grīvānayanaparyantaṃ keśāgraiḥ prakarasmitaiḥ snigdhendriyaśca santuṣṭaścaturvargapadāśrayaḥ nivṛttikāle punastasyā bhāvapūrṇāmṛtairnijam tadadhaḥ saparārdhañca cintayettadadhomukham sarvārthasādhakañcaiva sarvarañjanakārakam sarvāhlādanasampūrṇaṃ sarvamohanakāraṇam

evaṃ kāmakalādhyānaṃ sugopyaṃ sādhakottamaiḥ meḍhrasthāne śivākāramādhāre kanakaprabham hṛdi vahniśikhākāraṃ tadūrdhve bhāskaradyutim lambike candravimbābhaṃ bhrūmadhye ratnavadrucim dhṛtvā spṛṣṭavā'thavā dṛṣṭvā dhyātvā kāmakalātanūm kṣaṇaṃ tadvadvimarśena jāyate bhāvasañcayaḥ kule sākṣād yatastattvaṃ devī tiṣṭhati tattvataḥ kuladevī cādyā devī niścalā yasya vidyate iti kāmakalādhyānaṃ kathitaṃ sarvasiddhidam āgate svāgataṃ kuryājllīlāyogāt svalīlayā vāmabhāgasamāsīnāṃ suveśīṃ kāmarūpiṇīm gandhamālyaṃ tato dattvā kuladravyāṇi yojayet pṛcchet kulakathāṃ sarvāṃ laukikālaukikādikām karoti kulaśāstrajñaḥ siddho'pi naśyati dhruvam bhāvayenna kaṭūktyā vai kṛte tu niṣphalaṃ bhavet varaṃ kulamanostyāgo varaṃ kulagurorapi svakule kulabāhulyaṃ yadi syād bhāgyayogataḥ pṛthak sthānaṃ pṛthagdhyānaṃ pṛthakpūjā pṛthak stutiḥ vīrāpatyakule caiva vīrapatnīkule'pi ca tāsāṃ niśvāsayogena taddeśaścaiva naśyati kulajā sā mahāyuddhe vīrāsphālananādinī mātsaryaṃ patividveṣaḥ kaṭūktiḥ kalahādikam evaṃ kulaṃ parityajya sādhayet siddhimātmanaḥ vīrapatnī ca paramā svayameva maheśvarī tadvadhū bhuvaneśānī sarvamantraprabodhinī

dīkṣaṇādeva sarvārthasādhakaḥ sādhako bhavet phalapākaṃ tatra kṛtvā kiṃ na sidhyati bhūtale dṛṣṭādṛṣṭāphalañcaiva devagandharvakinnarāḥ visarjanaṃ vidhātavyaṃ gopanaṃ bhāvaśaktikam yataḥ pativratādharmāt dharmo nāsti jagattraye patireva paraṃ brahma patiḥ prāṇādhikaḥ prabhuḥ sarvadevīmayaścaiva patirevamahāguruḥ śūkarī gardabhī kāko śṛgālī jāyate dhruvam tava liṅge yo hi yāti patirūpadharaḥ kvacit tadā yadi bahirna syāttadā svapatireva hi āgatyopaviśet pārśve mukhaṃ vīkṣya sthirā bhavet uttare nottaraṃ dadyāt vyāharecchubhakarmaṇi yoginīnāṃ mahāpūjā baṭukānāṃ tathaiva ca tāsāṃ mūlatarormūle mūlavidyāñca kālikām yadrūpe prītiretasya kulasya kulavittamaḥ tatra bījārpaṇaṃ kṛtvā kurvanti kularakṣaṇam devajātaṃ narairjātaṃ yathārthakulaśāstrataḥ saptamāṣṭamamāsādvā vṛkṣamadhye sarovare japedaṣṭasahasraṃ vai svayaṃ vṛkṣāt patiṣyati evaṃ kṛte yat patitaṃ tatphalaṃ devanirmitam etalliṅgaphalaṃ jñātvā ānīya kṣālayettataḥ dhenumudrāmṛtīkṛtya homaṃ kuryādalakṣitaḥ bhuktamātre tu tasmin vai cirajīvī kṣitau bhavet nityā madhumatī tasya jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ sudhādhārāsamā vāṇī vaktrāttasya prajāyate

candrasūryāvadhi śrīmān bhunakti bahulaṃ sukham nānāvilāsasampannaiḥ kalākuśalakovidaiḥ amṛtādyaiḥ prītikarairdevabhogyaiḥ sudurlabhaiḥ āyāti sādhakākāṅkṣahṛdayā parameśvarī tatraivā'yānti satataṃ devakanyāḥ sahasraśaḥ tatropagatapīṭhasthā bhuktvā tu bahulaṃ sukham sādhakānāṃ kulajñānāṃ na doṣaḥ phalapātane vighnaṃ karoti sarvatra nijasaṅkocakāraṇāt phalavṛkṣasya hāniścet kadāciddaivayogataḥ tāvanna kulapūjā syādyāvattu niṣkṛtirbhavet etat kāryavidhāne tu yogyo nāstīha bhūtale karoti yadi tatra syādvighnaṃ vā phalapātanam vighnapradhānametattu kadācit phalasādhanam svaphalaṃ samanuprāpya kriyate yadi pāmaraiḥ divyabhāvaḥ sādhakendro marttyo śakrasamo bhavet na deyo yasya kasyāpi paśoḥ gopyaḥ prayatnataḥ nirdvandvamānaso bhūtvā hṛdi kāmakalātanuḥ nijaṃ kulaṃ samādāya svayaṃ bhairavarūpadhṛk vinyaset sakalaṃ nyāsaṃ navayonyātmakaṃ tathā nānāgandhasamākīrṇaṃ kuladravyeṇa yantrakam pūrvavanmaṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā pūrvoktaikatamaṃ ghaṭam tatra mantraṃ vilikhyādau yadyatkulasamudbhavam dhenumudrāṃ pradarśyā'tha amṛtaṃ tadvicintayet indrādayaḥ surāḥ sarve nṛtyanti madhulolupāḥ arghyapātraṃ tridhā kṛtvā gurave caikabhāgakam

pītvā kularasaṃ pūrṇa nānālaṅkārabhūṣitaḥ tattatkalpoktavidhinā tattanmantraṃ prapūjya ca bhaktisvarasapānenadevī bhunakti cāmṛtam tatphalagrahaṇādeva sumeruśṛṅgarohaṇam mūlayoge kṛte tatra japedaṣṭasahasrakam vidhāya tarpaṇaṃ caiva pradakṣiṇamanuvrajan idaṃ vīrakulaṃ caiva sundaraṃ sumanoharam na ca mārībhayaṃ tatra na ca rājabhayādikam lakṣmīrvāṇī sadā tatra susthirā bhavati dhruvam yojanīyaṃ prayatnena na ca vighnaṃ pravartate yoginībhirna luptaṃ tanna ca pāpena yujyate pūjāphalaṃ bhavettatra saptavāsarasammitam na gate nārccite sthāne paśureva na saṃśayaḥ sādhake kṣobhamāpanne devyāḥ kṣobhaḥ prajāyate bhogena mokṣamāpnoti bhogena kulasādhanam tatsarvaṃ kularūpaṃ tu dhyātvā ca viharet sudhīḥ śūnyāgāre nadītīre niḥsaṅgo viharenmudā sarvapīṭhe sarvadeśe kartavyaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ divyairapi ca kartavyaṃ paśubhirna ca pāmaraiḥ yacca devyāḥ purā proktaṃ śāśvataṃ mantrasādhanam divyavīre na bhedo'sti yo bhedaḥ sa tu kathyate divyaśca devavat prāyo vīraścoddhatamānasaḥ ākāragopano vāpi vyakto vā divyasādhakaḥ asaṃskṛtaḥ saṃskṛto vā nityasiktaḥ kuleśvaraḥ devanindāparo vāpi tatpūjādiparo'pi vā

nijabhāvasamāyukto devavat viharet kṣitau viṣṇubhaktiṃ vinā caiva bhaktirna prabhavedyathā guruṃ vinā yathā tantre nādhikāraḥ kathañcana kulaṃ vinā yathā vīro devyā vā mama sādhakaḥ vinā kulena divyānāṃ vīrāṇāñca tathaiva ca avinītaṃ kulaṃ yasya ca kathaṃ mama pūjakaḥ bhāvābhāvāt kule śāstre nādhikāraḥ kathañcana idaṃ vīrakulañcaiva divyādapi manoramam yathāvidhi paśorvidyāṃ gṛhītvā bhāvatatparaḥ na matsyabhojanaṃ kuryānna striyaṃ manasā smaret sindhutīre parvate vā kānane vā surālaye na śūdradarśanaṃ kuryāt kauṭilyaṃ dūratastyajet trisandhyaṃ devapūjā syāt trisandhyaṃ japamācaret na mantramuccared bhuktvā maunī syāt sarvakarmasu puṣpaṃ gandhaṃ jalaṃ caiva svayamānīya pūjayet ṛtukālaṃ vinā gacchenna ca svastriyamādarāt na rātrau bhojayedvidvāṃstāmbūlañca tathaiva ca svajātakusumaṃ caiva hetudravyaṃ tathaiva ca raktavastraṃ na gṛhṇīyāt devībhaktiparāyaṇaḥ kāryaṃ vīrakathālāpaṃ na kuryādvīravanditam tīrthasnānaṃ pīṭhadeśe gamanaṃ dharmatatparaḥ dīkṣitasyā'dhikāro'sti pūjāyāṃ caiva niścitam pūrvasya nādhikāro'sti pūjādeśagatāgatau pūrvadarśanamātreṇa kuladarśanamācaret pūrvasya darśanaṃ naiva satyaṃ satyaṃ suniścitam

tathāpi jāyate śaṅkā tadā devyāḥ pade pade varaṃ svakulakutsā syādvaraṃ svakulanindanam kāyena manasā vācā varaṃ svakulapātanam kulaśāstre dvayaṃ pāpaṃ gariṣṭo bhavati dhruvam tasmādapi mahat pāpaṃ paśusaṅgāt prajāyate na sidhyanti mahāmantrāḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ suniścitam steyaṃ saṃsarga evaite mahāpātakajātayaḥ vīrahatyā vṛthāpānaṃ vīrajāyāśca saṅgamaḥ jñātvā vīravarañcāpi tannindā tadakīrttanam paśunā yaḥ samālāpaḥ samā śayyā samāsanam saṃsargapātakaṃ proktaṃ kulīnasya mahātmanaḥ prabhavanti na tīrthāni na gaṅgā na ca kāśikā naśyanti na ca saṃsargaḥ kṣayaṃ yāti kadācana tadā dvādaśavarṣākhyaṃ vratārthaṃ yatnamācaret ucchiṣṭabhojī tannāmaprajāpī tatpaterapi śucirbhūtvā punarvidyāṃ gṛhītvā śuddhimāpnuyāt dadyāt kulāya pāpānāṃ kṣayārthaṃ sādhakottamaḥ mṛte ca bhāsakākādi yonimālambya sarvataḥ na cainaṃ dīkṣayennāma na cāsya darśanañcaret karmaṇā manasā vācā paśuśāstrādipūjanam niṣedhe kulaśāstrāṇi sādhakaḥ sarvadā caret śvacarmasthaṃ yathā kṣīraṃ na deyaṃ syāddvijeṣvapi aśraddadhānā ye cātra kuladharmeṣu kaulikāḥ kaulāḥ paśuvratāścaiva pakṣadvayaviḍambakāḥ dīkṣaṇāt pūjanāddhomāttathā dṛṣṭyavalokanāt

tasya sarvaṃ hareddevī śāpaṃ dattvā suniścitam tasya vaktraṃ samālokya kulavaktraṃ vilokayet paśūpadiṣṭaṃ yatkiñcit kriyate kulasādhakaiḥ yā yāḥ sarvā mahāvidyāścaṇḍikāyāḥ suniścitam yadi daivāt paśorvidyāṃ labhate kulajairnaraiḥ ajñānād yat kṛtaṃ mātarnā'locya kulakaulikam evaṃ prārthya mahāyatnai ratnaiḥ svarṇādivistaraiḥ bhraṣṭasya cā'ṣṭamī ceti tithireva na cānyathā bhraṣṭā bahuvidhāḥ santi yadyatra kulasādhakāḥ kulācāraṃ paśau guptaṃ tattu teṣāṃ paraṃ viduḥ paśoragre na karttavyaṃ prāṇānte'pi kadācana nirjīve kāṣṭhaloṣṭhe vā śarkarāyāṃ tṛṇe'pi vā cetanādhiṣṭhitaṃ sarvaṃ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ prakalpitam tasmād devyāśca sarvasvaṃ devīpūjāparāyaṇaiḥ sarvathā tatra bhāvau dvau na prakāśyau kadācana sabhāvaḥ paśubhāvena janmatrayavibhāvanāt daivācca jāyate vīro vīrāddevaḥ prajāyate bhāvastu manaso dharmaḥ sa hi śābdaḥ kathaṃ bhavet yathekṣuguḍamādhuryaṃ jihvayā jñāyate sadā eka eva mahābhāvo nānātvaṃ bhajate yataḥ ānandaghanasandohaḥ prabhuḥ prakṛtirūpadhṛk śrotavyaḥ sa ca mantavyo nidhyātavyaḥ sa eva hi śrotavyaḥ śrutivākyebhyo mantavyo mananādibhiḥ tadā sa eva sarvātmāpratyakṣībhavati dhruvam bhāvairbahuvidhaiścaiva bhāvastatrāpi līyate
