dugdhādyabhyāsayogena nānātvaṃ bhajate yataḥ tasmāddadhi tato havyaṃ tasmādapi rasodayaḥ dṛśyate ca sadā tatra na kāryaṃ nāpi kāraṇam jāyejjaniṣyate jātaḥ kāryabhedādi bhāvyate sa strīrnapuṃsakaḥ so'pi sa evā'naṅga eva saḥ eka eva sa evātmā rasarūpī sanātanaḥ tasmāt prakṛtiyogena jñāyate nānyayā kvacit itarād bhidyamāno'pi na bhedamupagacchati na prayogairna ca jñānairna śrutyā na gurukramāt prakṛtyā'dhiṣṭhitaṃ sarvaṃ prakṛtyā vāñchitaṃ jagat na vastu prakṛtirnaiva na pumān parameśvaraḥ ubhayoḥ samavāyastu vastutattvaṃ suniścitam nirvikāraḥ sarvadaiva pramāṇāgocaraḥ pumān upāyāḥ santi bahavo jñātuṃ brahma sanātanam sāṃyātrikāḥ kule deśe yathā nāvaṃ pragṛhya ca tattaṭe nāvamāsthāya kṣaṇād yānti yathā punaḥ tasmāt paramparāyātāste hi kāraṇatāṃ gatāḥ strībhāvaḥ prakṛtirjñeyaḥ pumbhāva puruṣo mataḥ ghaṭapratyakṣatāyāṃ tu āloko vyañjako yathā ghaṭatvaṃ punaretasya bhedakāraṇameva hi sākṣātkāraṇamevaitat prakṛtiścaiva niścitam ekena janmanā tasya paraṃ pratyakṣamāpnuyāt devīputraḥ sa evā'tmā bhairavaḥ parikīrttitaḥ na vaktavyau muktimārgau kulasārau kulottamau daśāhakramayogena bhraṣṭo bhavati sādhakaḥ

kulānmantraṃ gṛhītvā tu bhāvaśuddhiḥ prajāyate tasmād bhāvaparo bhūtvā devīṃ sampūjayet sudhīḥ iti śrīmajjñānānandaparamahaṃsaviracite kaulāvalīnirṇaye ekādaśaḥ ullāsaḥ ārabhyā'nāmikāmadhyāt prādakṣiṇyena vai kramāt tarjanyagre tathā madhye yo japet sa tu pāmaraḥ śaktimālā samākhyātā sarvamantrapradīpanī madhyamāyāstrayaṃ parva tarjanīmūlaparvikā aṅgulīnāṃ viyoge tu chidreṣu kṣarate japaḥ parvasandhiṣu yajjaptaṃ tatsarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet akṣamālā tathā'nyā ca sarvathā siddhaye punaḥ sarvasiddhipradā nityaṃ sarvarājavaśaṅkarī rudrākṣamālikā mokṣe bhavet sarvasusiddhidā tathā māṇikyamālā ca sāmrājyaphaladāyinī padmākṣamālayā lakṣmīrjāyate ca mahaddhanam rudrākṣamālikā sūte japena svamanorathān putrajīvabhavā mālā putraṃ vitanute'cirāt saubhāgyaṃ sphāṭikī mālā rudrākṣe'kṣayakāmadā putrajīvairdaśaguṇaṃ śataṃ śaṅkhaiḥ sahasrakam ayutaṃ sphāṭikaiḥ proktaṃ mauktikairlakṣamucyate sauvarṇairdaśakoṭiḥ syādanantaṃ raktacandanaiḥ raktacandanamālābhiḥ śivatvaṃ labhate dhruvam guñjāyāḥ sarvasiddhiḥ syādvilvakāṣṭhena siddhidā sāmānya kathitā mālā viśeṣāt kathyate'dhunā dantena kālikāyāstu rājadantena meruṇā unmukhyāśca tathā jñeyā mokṣadā mālikā bhavet

gajadantairgaṇeśe tu śaive rudrākṣa ucyate aṣṭottaraśatā mālā catuḥpañcāśikā'pi vā athavā mātṛkāsaṃkhyā mālā kāryā prayatnataḥ aṣṭottaraśataiḥ sarvā siddhiruktā manīṣibhiḥ suvṛttaṃ sundaraṃ bījaṃbadarībījamālikam saṃskārañca tataḥ kuryāt yathāśāstrapramāṇataḥ sarva tadviphalaṃ vindyāt kruddhā bhavati caṇḍikā paṅkajodbhavasūtrañca tathā ca śaṇasūtrakam svarṇādisambhavaṃ sūtraṃ triguṇaistriguṇīkṛtam nitye naimittike śastaṃ śuklaṃ raktaṃ tathā śubham prakṣālya mūlamantreṇa grathayedatha sūtrakam taireva grathitāṃ mālāṃ kārayennā'nyataḥ kvacit ekaikamaṇimādāya brahmagranthiṃ vinirdiśet śaive ca vaiṣṇave saure gaṇeśe śrīkare'pi ca dūṣaṇaṃ yatra nāstyeva granthihīno'pi nityaśaḥ totalāvanavāsinyorvārāhyādyāviśeṣataḥ ekaikamaṇimādāya sādhakaḥ sthiramānasaḥ svayameva japenmantramanyaḥ praṇavamuccaret merumekaṃ vidhāyātha mālānte sādhakottamaḥ vāmato'pi bhaveddevaṃ dhyānataḥ siddhimāpnuyāt evaṃ niṣpādya mālāñca pratiṣṭhāñca samācaret pañcagavye kṣipenmālāṃ śivamantreṇa mantritām kathitaṃ śivamantrañca sādhakānāṃ hitāya ca ghṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ tathā nīraṃ śarkarāmadhusaṃyutam palārdhaṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ prasthaṃ dadhi tathā samam

mūlena mantritaṃ kṛtvā yojayet pañcagavyakam kṣālayet pañcagavyena sadyojātena mārjayet bhave'bhave'nādibhave bhajasva māṃ bhavodbhavāya namaḥ candanāgurugandhādyairvāmadaivena gharṣayet sarva bhūtadamanāya namo nama unmanāya namaḥ sarvataḥ sarvasarvebhyo namaste'stu rudrarūpebhyaḥ gandhacandanakuṅkumairlepayetpuruṣeṇa ca tanno rudraḥ pracodayāt īśānamanunā meruṃ śataṃ caiva tataḥ param brahmādhipatiḥ brahmaṇo'dhipatiḥ śivo me'stu sadāśivom padmākāreṣu cāśvatthapatreṣu sthāpayecca vā sāṅgāvaraṇasaṃyuktāmupacāraiḥ suvistaraiḥ prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ kurvīta aṣṭottaraśataṃ tataḥ praṇavaṃ akṣamālādhipataye tadanantaram tilena ghṛtayuktena śaktyā homaṃ prakalpayet tāro'kṣamālādhipataye susiddhādiṃ vadettataḥ siddhiṃprakalpaya svāhā abhimantritamālayā aṣṭottaraśataṃ vāpi japtvā mālāṃ samarpayet aṣṭottaraśataṃ vāpi japtvā mālāñca gopayet gurorabhāve mālāyāḥ saṃskāraṃ svayamācaret akṣamālāñca mudrāñca gurorapi na darśayet haranti prakaṭādyasmāttasmādyatnena gopayet aśucirna spṛśenmālāṃ śucau na prakalpayet prāyaścittaṃ vidhātavyaṃ japenmantraṃ sahasrakam jīrṇe sūtre punaḥ sūtraṃ prathayitvā śataṃ japet

gurūṇāṃ śilpināñcaiva pūjāṃ kṛtvā tu sādhakaḥ evaṃvidhā sarvamālā sarvadeve pratiṣṭhitā kuṇḍagolodbhavairdravyaiḥ svayambhūkusumena ca karpūrāgurukastūrī tathā mṛgamadena ca athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi mālāṃ sarvottamottamām anulomavilomena mantramāturvibhedataḥ kuryādvarṇamayīṃ mālāṃ sarvamantrapradīpinīm etadrahasyaṃ paramaṃ nā'khyeyaṃ yasya kasyacit kṣamerukaiḥ sāṣṭavargaiḥ kḷptayā varṇamālāyā sabinduṃ varṇamuccārya paścānmantraṃ japet sudhīḥ atha yantrapratiṣṭhānaṃ kathayāmi prasaṅgataḥ tāmre lakṣaguṇaṃ proktaṃ raupye koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet ekatolaṃ dvitolaṃ vā tritolaṃ pañcatolakam sādhakasya manojñaṃ vā kṛtvā pīṭhe susādhakaḥ surekhaṃ sumukhaṃ yantraṃ lekhayitvā vidhānataḥ pratiṣṭhāñca tataḥ kuryād yathāśāstrapramāṇataḥ pañcagavyaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā śivamantreṇa śodhitam tasmāduddhṛtya taccakraṃ sthāpayet svarṇapaṭṭake vāsasā jalamuttolya sthāpayeddhemapīṭhake praṇavaṃ yantrarājāya vidmahe tadanantaram gāyatrīmiti sañjapya śatamaṣṭottaraṃ tataḥ upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhirnānāvidharasāyanaiḥ svakalpoktavidhānena sampūjya parameśvarīm balidānaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā praṇameccakramuttamam gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāttathā ca śilpine tataḥ

nyāsādikaṃ svakalpoktaṃ gāyatraṃ tatra sandiśet atha vakṣyāmi mantrāṇāṃ puraścaraṇamuttamam sādhayet siddhisakalān sākṣāt siddhīśvaro bhavet tataḥ siddhamanurmantrī prayogārho na cānyathā kiṃ homaiḥ kiṃ japaiścaiva kiṃ mantranyāsavistaraiḥ jīvahīno yathā dehī sarvakarmasu na kṣamaḥ puraskriyā hi mantrāṇāṃ pradhānaṃ jīva ucyate prayogañca tataḥ kuryāt sādhakaḥ siddhihetave nagarāt parataḥ krośaṃ krośayugmamathā'pi vā gṛhe japaḥ samaḥ prokto nadyāṃ śataguṇaḥ smṛtaḥ ayutaṃ parvate puṇyaṃ lakṣaṃ bhāgīrathījale yatra vā kutracid deśe liṅge vai paścimāmukhe prayāge suranadyāṃ vā vārāṇasyāṃ varāhake ekaliṅge śūnyagehe catuṣpathe śivāntike mahāniśipuraścaryāṃ kuryādeṣu sthaleṣu ca pūrvādikramato vīraḥ sthāpayet kīlakāni ca vāyuṃ kuberamīśānaṃ brahmānantau tataḥ param īśānaśakrayormadhyamūrdhvaṃ jñeyaṃ sadā budhaiḥ kṣetre ca kīlite mantrī na vighnaiḥ paribhūyate dīpasthāne ca vīrendro yathāvidhi puraḥsaram śuciḥ pūrvadine bhūtvā sādhakaḥ sthiramānasaḥ jñātājñātasya pāpasya kṣayārthaṃ prathamaṃ punaḥ bahubhirvastrabhūṣābhiḥ sampūjya gurumātmanaḥ ārambhakāle niyataṃ parayoṣāṃ prapūjya ca pāyasaṃ piṣṭakaṃ caiva nānārasasamanvitam

aikṣavaṃ modakaṃ caiva nānāvidharasāyanam candanaṃ mṛganābhiñca śrīkhaṇḍaṃ kuṅkumaṃ tathā dhūpadīpañca kauṣeyaṃ puṣpamālāṃ tathā param dvāradeśe tato vīraḥ pūjayed dvāradevatām caturdvāreṣu sampūjya pūrvādikramato budhaḥ bhūtāpasaraṇaṃ kṛtvā dīpasthānaṃ samācaret svakalpoktaṃ vidhāyā'tha prokṣayettadanantaram nānālaṅkārasaṃyuktamarghyodakaviśodhitam aṣṭakanyārūpabhedaṃ vilomayā'marśaceṣṭitam veśyā nāpitakanyā ca rajakī yoginī tathā brahmāṇyādyaṣṭaśaktīnāṃ nāmabhiḥ kṛtasañjñakāḥ arghyaṃ pādyañca pānīyaṃ madhuparkaṃ jalaṃtataḥ dhūpayitvā tataḥ keśān kauṣeyañca nivedayet dattvā tatra samāsīnāṃ nānālaṅkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ tāṃ tāṃ śaktiṃ tato dhyāyed yathākramavidhānataḥ brahmakūrcābjadaṇḍākṣasūtrāṇi karapaṅkajaiḥ stryalaṅkārasamāyuktāṃ brahmāṇīṃ saṃsmaret sudhīḥ kapālaṃ ḍamaruṃ bāṇaṃ śūlaṃ ṭaṅkamabhītidam trinetrāṃ kuṅkumanibhāṃ kaumārīṃ śikhivāhanām vaiṣṇavīṃ garuḍārūḍhāṃ śyāmāṃ madhumadākulām dadhānāṃ pītavasanāṃ muktāmaṇivibhūṣitām phalakāṃ mūṣalaṃ caiva varaṃ khaḍga tathā param indranīlaprabhāmaindrīmairāvataniṣeduṣīm nānālaṅkāraracitāṃ sadā bhaktānurāgiṇīm sāṭṭahāsāṃ śavāsīnāṃ maṇimuktāvirājitām

vibhrāṇāṃ nīlameghābhāṃ bhāvayed bhaktavatsalām mātuluṅgaphalābhītimālāpadmavidhāriṇīm tāṃ tāṃ śakti samāvāhya mūrdhni tāsāṃ prapūjayet bhojyamaṇḍalamadhye tu svarṇādisthānake tataḥ adīkṣitāścettatraiva tato māyāṃ nivedayet kṛpayā hara vighnaṃ me mantrasiddhiṃ prayaccha me kṛpayā hara vighnaṃ me mantrasiddhiṃ prayaccha me kṛpayā hara vighnaṃ me mantrasiddhiṃ prayaccha me kṛpayā hara vighnaṃ me mantrasiddhiṃ prayaccha me kṛpayā hara vighnaṃ me mantrasiddhiṃ prayaccha me kṛpayā hara vighnaṃ me mantrasiddhiṃ prayaccha me kṛpayā hara vighnaṃ me mantrasiddhiṃ prayaccha me kṛpayā hara vighnaṃ me mantrasiddhiṃ prayaccha me eke bahuvidhe devi viśvarūpe namo'stu te vidagdhāñca samālokya tasya vighnaṃ na jāyate dīkṣākāle nityapūjāsamaye nā'rcayed yadi yadi vrīḍāparā sā tu bhojayettadgṛhād bahiḥ ācamya mukhavāsāditāmbūlañca nivedayet binduyuktasya dīrghasya ekaikānte niyojayet mantrāṇi kathitānyeva tāsāṃ vīrastato japet visṛjya ca namaskṛtya varaṃ prārthya sukhī bhavet agrajā vā mātulānī mātā vā tatsapatnikā pūjyāḥ kularasaiḥ sarvā nijāhaṅkāravarjitaiḥ saṃskṛtā'saṃskṛtā vāpi jananī vāpi niṣpatiḥ ekaścet kulaśāstrajñaḥ pūjārhastatra niścitam

ekā cedyuvatī tatra pūjitā cā'valokitā ādāvante ca madhye ca lakṣapūrttau viśeṣataḥ pūrvārjitaphalaṃ nāsti kā kathā parajanmani devīnāṃ krodhasantāpaśamanaṃ vighnanāśanam śaktipūjāṃ samāpyā'tha prakṛtañca samācaret prātareva tataḥ paścājjapenmadhyandināvadhi ekakālaṃ dvikālaṃ vā trikālaṃ vātha sādhakaḥ ekagrāme sthito nityaṃ gatvā vandettato gurum prātarutthāya pūjāyāṃ snānakāle'thavā punaḥ namasyā sarvajātīnāṃ kulīnānāṃ kulārcane abhyaṅgagandhalepañca puṣpadhāraṇameva ca tyajeduṣṇodakasnānamaniveditabhojanam bhūtahiṃsā na karttavyā paśuhiṃsā viśeṣataḥ anyamantrapuraskāraṃ nindāṃ caiva vivarjayet apavitrakaro'śuddhaḥ pralapanna japet kvacit cintāvyākulacitto vā kruddho vā na japet kadā rathyāyāmaśivasthāne na japettimirālaye kṣute'dhovāyugamane jṛmbhaṇe japamutsṛjet kṛtvā samyagjapeccheṣamathavā sūryadarśanam sambhāṣayet kadācinna brahmacaryaṃ samācaret śayītaśuddhaśayyāyāṃ śucirvastradharaḥ sadā nā'lokayedanyaśāstraṃ vedāgamaṃ vinā sudhīḥ divase sarvathā vīro brahmacārī bhavet sadā rātrau sampūjayed devīṃ kulācārakrameṇa tu puraścaraṇakāle tu yadi syāt pīṭhadarśanam

prasaṅgāt kathyate pīṭhapūjā tantravidhānataḥ yoganidrā kāmarūpe mahiṣāsuramardinī jālandhare ca pūrṇeśī pūrṇaṃ śaile ca caṇḍikā athavā kāmarūpasya darśanaṃ yadi bhāgyataḥ vakṣyamāṇavidhānena tāsāṃ jñātvā svanāmakam pūjāṃ samāpayedvīraḥ tadanusmṛtipūrvakam pūjanīyā prayatnena dvedhaṃ tatra vivarjayet yathā kamalajanmāpi ye vā vyāsamukhā dvijāḥ yakṣarakṣaḥpiśācādyā guhyacāraṇavandinaḥ tathā śaivena goptavyaḥ kulācāraḥ sudurlabhaḥ yeṣāṃ jape ca home ca saṃkhyā noktā manīṣibhiḥ yasmiṃśca nigade caiva mantre saṃkhyā vidhīyate kalpokte yat kṛtāsaṃkhyā tretāyāṃ dviguṇā bhavet na divyavīrayoreva yugasevāpariśramaḥ teṣāṃ pūjā trikālaṃ hi rātrau naiva kadācana caturguṇaṃ tu tārāyā vinā śaṅkhākṣamālayā narāsthimālāmādāya japedvā lakṣamekakam caturguṇajapaḥ proktaḥ siddhaye nānyathā bhavet viśeṣataḥ kaliyuge tārā kālī tathonmukhī unmukhyāḥ kālikāyāśca viśeṣaḥ kathyate'dhunā rātrau māṃsāsavairmatsyairmudrābhirmaithunodbhavaiḥ tato nagnāṃ striyaṃ nagno ramaṇakleśato'pi vā dvijanmanāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ dvidhā vidhirihocyate tatastu taddaśāṃśena homayeddhaviṣā'nale iti śrīmajjñānānandaparamahaṃsaviracite kaulāvalīnirṇaye dvādaśollāsaḥ

ādau bhūmiṃ parīkṣeta vāstujñānaviśāradaḥ navahastapramāṇaṃ vā saptahastamathāpi vā vicchidraṃ tu caturdvāraṃ divyadṛṣṭivibhūṣitam ādau kuṇḍaṃ prakurvīta sādhakaḥ siddhihetave ṣaḍasraṃ paṅkajākāraṃ aṣṭāsraṃ tāni nāmataḥ samantāt kuṇḍametat syāccaturasraṃ śubhāvaham kartturdakṣiṇahastasya madhyamāṅguliparvaṇaḥ yavānāmaṣṭabhiḥ kḷptaṃ mānāṅgulamitīritam nyaset purastādekāṃśaṃ koṇārdhārdhapramāṇataḥ sūtrayugmaṃ tato dadyāt kuṇḍaṃ yoninibhaṃ bhavet ekamekaṃ tyajedaṃśamadha ūrdhvañca mantravit ardhacandranibhaṃ kuṇḍaṃ ramaṇīyamidaṃ bhavet ekaikamaṃśaṃ tanmānādagrato lāñchayet punaḥ aṣṭādaśāṃśake kṣetre nyasedekaṃ bahirbudhaḥ aṣṭadhā vibhajet kṣetraṃ madhyasūtrasya pārśvayoḥ kuryāt pārśvadvaye matsyacatuṣkaṃ tantravittamaḥ caturasrīkṛtaṃ kṣetraṃ vibhajyā'ṣṭādaśāṃśataḥ vṛttāni karṇikādīnāṃ bahistrīṇi prakalpayet pūrvoktaṃ vibhajet kṣetraṃ caturviṃśatibhāgataḥ antaḥsthacaturasrasya koṇārdhārdhapramāṇataḥ diśaṃ prati yathānyāyamaṣṭasūtrāṇi pātayet yāvān kuṇḍasya vistāraḥ khananaṃ tāvadīritam kuṇḍāderdvyaṅgulaṃ tyaktvā karttavyā mekhalāḥ śubhāḥ utsedhāyāmato jñeyā dvyekārdhāṅgulisammitāḥ aṣṭādaśāṅgulaṃ jñeyam aratnimānaṃ dhīmatā

ekahastamite kuṇḍe vedāgninayanāṅgulāḥ eka hastasya kuṇḍasya vardhayet tatkramāt sudhīḥ caturhasteṣu kuṇḍeṣu vasutarkayugāṅgulāḥ vasuhastamite kuṇḍe bhānupaṅktyāṣṭakāṅgulāḥ vistārotsedhato jñeyā mekhalāḥ sarvato budhaiḥ ṣaṭcaturdvyaṅgulāyāmavistāronnatiśalinī tridvyekāṅgulamānena kramānmūlāgramiṣyate sthalādārabhya nālaṃ syāt yonyā madhye sarandhrakam muṣṭyaratnyekahastānāṃ kuṇḍānāṃ yonirīritā tattat kuṇḍānurūpaṃ vā mānamasya nigadyate netravedāṅgulopetā kuṇḍeṣvanyeṣu vardhayet yonikuṇḍe yonimabjakuṇḍe nābhiṃ vivarjayet bahiraṃśadvayenāṣṭau patrāṇi parikalpayet śatahome'ratnimātraṃ hastamātraṃ sahasrake caturhastādike'pyevaṃ karttavyaṃ sādhakena ca daśalakṣeṣu ṣaṭkaraṃ koṭyāmaṣṭakaraṃ smṛtam lakṣāṇāṃ daśakaṃ yāvat tāvaddhastena vardhayet sarvasiddhikaraṃ kuṇḍaṃ caturasramudāhṛtam śatrukṣayakaraṃ tryasraṃ vartulaṃ śāntikarmaṇi vṛṣṭidaṃ rogaśamanaṃ kuṇḍamaṣṭāsramīritam lakṣmīpradaṃ varttulañcacandrārdhaṃ tu bhayaṃ haret caturasraṃ śāntilakṣmīpuṣṭi-ṛddhipradāyakam ṣaḍasraṃ sarvasampattikāraṇaṃ pauruṣapradam guṇāni sarvakāryāṇi caturasre bhavanti hi vaiśyānāmardhacandrābhaṃ śūdrāṇāṃ tryasramīritam

kuṇḍasya rūpaṃ jānīyāt paramaṃ prakṛtervapuḥ udaraṃ kuṇḍamityuktaṃ yoniḥ pādau tu paścime hastamātraṃ tu tat kuryādbālukābhiḥ suśobhanam eṣāmekatamaṃ kuṇḍaṃ niṣpādya sruksruvau tataḥ śrīphalaśiṃśapākṣīraśākhiṣvekatamaṃ budhaḥ viṃśatyaṃśairbhaveddaṇḍo vedī tairaṣṭabhirbhavet vedītryaṃśena vistāraḥ kaṇṭhasya parikīrttitaḥ kaniṣṭhāṅgulimānena sarpiṣo nirgamāya ca vidadhīta bahistasyā ekāṃśenā'bhito'vaṭam aṃśenaikena parito dalāni parikalpayet daṇḍamūlāgrayorgaṇḍī guṇavedāṅgulaiḥ kramāt ṣaḍbhiraṃśaiḥ pṛṣṭabhāgo vedyāḥ kūrmākṛtirbhavet mukhasya pṛṣṭhabhāgasya samproktaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ srucaḥ caturbhiraṃśairānāhaḥ karṣājyagrāhi tacchiraḥ mūlāt ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ tyaktvā agrecaina dvisaptakam sruvasya vidhirākhyāto yathātantravidhānataḥ aṣṭādaśāḥ syuḥsaṃskārāḥ kuṇḍānāṃ tantracoditāḥ tenaiva tāḍanaṃ darbhairvarmaṇā'myukṣaṇaṃ matam samīkaraṇamastreṇa varmaṇā secanaṃ matam vilepanaṃ kalārūpakalpanaṃ tadanantaram śareṇa vajrīkaraṇaṃ hṛdayena kuśaiḥ śubhaiḥ yāge kuṇḍāni saṃskuryātsaṃskārairebhirīritaiḥ tisrastisro likhed rekhā hṛdā prāgudagapragāḥ rekhāṇāmudagaprāṇāṃ brahmavaivaśvendavaḥ vṛttaṃ kṣitigṛhaṃ caiva kuṇḍamadhye likhettataḥ

maṇḍale kālavahniñca rudrameva tataḥ param maṇigehaṃ prapūjyātha kalpavṛkṣaṃ tataḥ sudhīḥ dharmaṃ jñānañca vairāgyaṃ aiśvaryañca yathākramāt paramānandakandañca samvinnālaṃ tataḥ param vikāramayakeśaraṃ mātṛkāmayakarṇikām sattvarajastamaścaiva ātmānamantarātmanām nāmādyakṣarabījādyān caturthyantānnamo'nvitān vāgīśvarīñca vāgīśaṃ yajedyogasvarūpakam vāgīśvarīmṛtusnātāṃ nīlendīvarasannibhām māyābījaṃ samuccārya vāgīśvarīñca ṅeyutām yogīśvaraṃ svamantreṇa tato vahniṃ samānayet tāmrapātre puṭīkṛtya kravyādāṃśaṃ parityajet saṃskuryāttaṃ yathānyāyaṃ caturbhirvīkṣaṇādibhiḥ yojayedvahnibījena caitanyaṃ pāvake tataḥ astreṇa rakṣitaṃ paścāt kavacenā'vaguṇṭhitam pradakṣiṇaṃ tadā tāramantroccāraṇapūrvakam śivabījadhiyā devyā yonāveva viniḥkṣipet jvālinīṃ darśayitvā ca jvālayenmanunā'munā sarvajñā'jñāpaya svāhā matro'yaṃ samudīritaḥ suvarṇavarṇamamalaṃ samiddhaṃ viśvatomukham vinyasedātmano dehe mantrī jihvā havirbhujaḥ vahnīrāghīṃśasaṃyuktāḥ sādiyāntāḥ savindavaḥ jihvāstāstrividhāḥ proktā guṇabhedeṣu karmasu bahurūpā'tiriktā ca sātvikyo yāgakarmasu lohitā'nantaraṃ śvetā dhūminī ca karālikā

viśvamūrttisphuliṅginyau dhūmravarṇā manojavā etāḥ sapta prayujyante krūrakarmasu mantribhiḥ amartyapitṛgandharvayakṣanāgapiśācakāḥ vahṇeraṅgamanūn nyasyettanāvuktena vartmanā dhūmavyāpī saptajihvo dhanurdhara itīritaḥ mūrttīraṣṭau tanau nyasyed deśiko jātavedasaḥ pradakṣiṇavaśānnyasyeducyante tā yathākramam aśvodarajasañjño'nyaḥ punarvaiśvānarāhvayaḥ tārāgnaye padādyāḥ syurnatyantā vahnimūrttayaḥ āsanaṃ kalpayitvā'gnermūrttiṃ tasya cintiyet dhyāyedvahniṃ baddhamauliṃ jaṭābhiḥ darbhairagarbhamadhyasthamekhalāyāṃ paristaret prādakṣiṇyena sampūjyāste brahmādyaṣṭamūrttayaḥ vaiśvānara jātavedapadaṃ paścādihā'vaha vahnijāyāvadhiḥ prokto manuḥ pāvakavallabhaḥ keśareṣūktamārgeṇa pūjayedaṅgadevatāḥ dalāgre mātaraḥ pūjyāḥ sāsitāṅgādibhairavāḥ paścādādāya pāṇibhyāṃ sruksruvau tāvadhomukhau tadagramadhyamūlāni śodhayettau yathākramāt punaḥ pratāpya tau mantrī darbhānagnau viniḥkṣipet ājyasthālīmathā'dāya prokṣayedarghavāriṇā niruhya vāyavyeṅgārān hṛdā teṣu niveśayet dīptadarbhayugmamājye kṣiptvā'nale kṣipettataḥ dīptena darbhayugmena nīrājyājyaṃ savarmaṇā ghṛte prajvalitān darbhān pradarśyā'strāṇunā guruḥ

gṛhītvā ghṛtamaṅgārān saṃyojyā'gnau jalaṃ spṛśet dhṛtvotpunīyādastreṇa ghṛtamutpavanantvidam ghṛtena plāvanaṃ kuryāt saṃskārāḥ ṣaḍudīritāḥ niḥkṣipya bhāgau dvau kṛtvā pakṣau śukletarau smaret suṣumṇāṃ madhyato dhyātvā kuryāddhomaṃ yathāvidhi juhuyādagnaye svāhā agnerdakṣiṇalocane juhuyādatha somāya svāheti hṛdayāṇunā juhuyādagnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāheti tanmukhe ityagninetravaktrāṇāṃ kuryādudghāṭanaṃ sudhīḥ juhuyādagnimantreṇa trivārān sādhakottamaḥ aṣṭābhirājyāhutibhiḥ praṇavena pṛthak pṛthak anantaraṃ jātakarma syānnāmakaraṇaṃ tathā cūḍopanayane bhūyo mahānāmnā mahāvratam śubheṣu syurvivāhāntāḥ kriyāstāḥ krūrakarmasu tataśca pitarau tasya sampūjyā'tmani yojayet mantrairjihvāṅgamūrttīnāṃ kramādvahneryathāvidhi avadāya sruveṇā'jyaṃ catuḥ sruci pidhāya tām juhuyādvahnimantreṇa vauṣaḍantena sampade tāraṃ ramā tathā māyāṃ klīṃ glauṃ tadanantaram me vaśamānaya procya vahnijāyā tataḥ param sāmānyaṃ sarvadevānāmetadagnimukhaṃ matam arcayedvahnirūpāṃ tāṃ devatāmiṣṭadāyinīm ājyena mūlamantreṇa vahnyaikīkaraṇaṃ tvidam mūlamantreṇa juhuyādājyairekādaśā'hutīḥ juhuyādaṅgamukhyānāmāvṛtīnāmanukramāt

trimadhvaktaistilairmantrī hunejjapadaśāṃśataḥ śūkarī karasaṅkocī haṃsī muktakaniṣṭhikā abhicāre ca puṣṭau ca śāntyādau ca yathākramāt dātuḥ puṇyaphalaṃ nāsti hotā ca narakaṃ vrajet ājyena madhunā caiva śarkarā ca madhutrayam svakalpavihitaidravyaiḥ sādhako yatamānasaḥ anukte tu havirdravye tilājyaṃ havirucyate divā japadaśāṃśena madhuratrayasaṃyutam yonikuṇḍe sthite sarpirmāṃsamatsyayutaṃ bhṛśam mallikājātipunnāgairhomād bhāgyodayo bhavet rājaputtrasya rājyāptiḥ paṅkajaiḥ śriyamāpnuyāt bandhūkapuṣpairvakulairjavotthaiḥ kiṃśukodbhavaiḥ lavaṇairmadhuropetairhutvā karṣati sundarīm kṣīrāktairamṛtākhaṇḍairhomo nāśayati jvaram rājīlavaṇa homena śatrūna mārayate'cirāt sarvaṃ trimadhuropetaṃ homadravyamudāhṛtam bilvaprasūnairjuhuyādīpsitāṃ śriyamāpnuyāt candanāgurukarpūrarocanākuṅkamādibhiḥ nirguṇḍīmūlahomena nigaḍānmucyate naraḥ haridrācūrṇasaṃmiśrairlavaṇaiḥ stambhayet parān hutvā samyagavāpnoti sādhakaḥ sarvamīpsitam vaśayedvacahomena narānnarapatīnapi palāśakusumaiḥ puṣṭiṃ dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ śriyaṃ labhet hutvā hemamavāpnoti vittavidyāvarastriyaḥ marīcahomairmaraṇaṃ ripurāpnoti niścitam

homaṃ samidvaraiḥ kuryānnāśayatyāpadāṃ kulam vrīhibhirjuhuyāddhīro vatsarāt vrīhimān bhavet āragvadhaiḥsamṛddhiḥ syādājyena labhate dhanam kāmyahomaṃ sadā dhīraḥ kuryādayutasaṃkhyayā tāni saṃmantrya vidhivadasakṛt sādhakottamaḥ yugānāmayutaṃ tena pūjanaṃ jāyate tathā na tasya durlabhaṃ kiñcittriṣu lokeṣu vidyate hunedājyena takreṇa māṃsena rudhireṇa ca āmiṣādibhirapyevaṃ śmaśāne juhuyāt sudhīḥ ājyaṃ caiva viśeṣeṇa juhuyāt sarvasiddhaye yat yat kāmayate kāmaṃ tattadāpnoti niścitam yonikuṇḍe hunedvidvān yathāvat sādhite'nale raktacandanapuṣpeṇa kṛṣṇena ca viśeṣataḥ dhane dhaneśvaro bhūyādājñayā ca śacīpatiḥ atha dhyātvā careddhomaṃ dadhisiddhānnataṇḍulaiḥ vidyākāmena hotavyaṃ śarkarāyutapāyasaiḥ rajasvalāyā vastreṇa madhunā saha sarpiṣā sadyomārjāramāṃsena ghṛtena madhunā saha bandhūkakusumairhomaṃ kṛtvā raktānvitairdhruvam rambhāpuṣpaṃ śālamatsyaṃ juhuyānmantravittamaḥ sākṣataṃ vilvapatrañca juhuyācca sahasrakam evaṃ jñātvā prakurvīta dravyamānamathocyate pañcagavyañca tatsaṃkhyaṃ bhavenmadhu tathā samam lājā muṣṭimitā jñeyā pṛthukaṃ śuktimeva ca matsyaṃ māṃsaṃ tathā jñeyaṃ rudhiraṃ śuktimātrakam

ekaikapatrapuṣpāṇi tathāpūpāni kalpayet mātuluṅgaṃ catuḥkhaṇḍaṃ panasaṃ daśadhā bhavet kapitthañca tridhā jñeyaṃ ūrvārukaṃ tridhā bhavet dūrvātrayaṃsamuddiṣṭaṃ guḍuco caturaṅgulā taṇḍulāḥ syustadardhañca athavā muṣṭisammitāḥ muṣṭimānāḥ sarṣapāśca lavaṇaṃ śuktimānakam rāmaṭhaṃ tatsamaṃ jñeyaṃ rocanā tatsamā bhavet tintiḍībījamānāni samuddiṣṭāni deśikaiḥ śayānamājyahomeṣu niṣaṇṇaḥ śeṣavastuṣu jvalat śikhā mukhaṃ vahnerboddhavyaṃ sādhakottamaiḥ svarṇasindūravālārkakuṅkamakṣaudrasannibhaḥ bherīvāridahastīndradhvanirvahneḥ śubhāvahaḥ padmendīvarakalhārasarpirguggulasannibhaḥ pradakṣiṇāstyaktakampāḥsuprabhāḥ śikhinaḥ śikhāḥ kundendudhavalo dhūmo vahneḥ proktaḥ śubhāvahaḥ śveto rāṣṭraṃ dahatyāśu vāyasasvarasannibhaḥ pūtigandho hutabhujo hoturduḥkhaprado bhavet śukapakṣinibho dhūmaḥ pārāvatasamaprabhaḥ evaṃvidheṣu doṣeṣu prāyaścittāya sādhakaḥ svīyasaṃkhyāvidhānena hutvāśeṣaṃ samācaret udvāsya devatāṃ kumbhe sāṅgāvaraṇapūrvikām ekaikāmāhutiṃ hutvā pariṣicyādbhirātmani naimittike kāmyahome dahettānna tu nityake tataḥ santarpayenmantrī homasyāpi daśāṃśataḥ gandhodakena vā kuryāt sarvatra sādhakottamaḥ

athavā homapātrādau yantraṃ kṛtvā tataḥ param ādau santarpayedyantre gurvādīṃstu yathākramāt pūrvadravyairdevamukhe tarpayedvidhinā tataḥ prasaṅgāt kathyate kāmyatarpaṇañca viśeṣataḥ tarpayitvā mahādevīṃ kāmyatarpaṇamācaret majjābhiśca yathā tattat svakīyena kacena ca meṣamāhiṣaraktena nararaktena caiva hi evaṃ tarpaṇamātreṇa sākṣāt siddhīśvaro bhavet bṛhaspatisamo bhūtvā devīvadbhuvi modate kālāgurudravopetairvaśayejjagatīmimām toyaiḥ kuṅkamamiśraiśca stambhayedakhilaṃ jagat karpūrāktajalenaiva karṣayedasurānapi sarvaśāstreṣu kathitaṃ tarpaṇaṃ śubhadāyakam tarpayenmadirābhiśca matsyamāṃsaiḥ samaṃ budhaḥ sthāpayedātmahṛtpadme parivāragaṇaiḥ saha abhiṣekaṃ prakurvīta gandhatoyaiḥ susādhakaḥ mūlamantraṃ samuccārya tataścā'mukadevatām ityuccārya svamūrdhni taṃ cintayitvā samantrakam kṣipettoyaṃ yathāsaṃkhyaṃ gaṇān siñcettataḥ param tattanmantrayutān viprān bhojayed devatādhiyā tattaddevapriyairdravyairabhiṣekadaśāṃśataḥ taddaśāṃśān haviṣyānnaiḥ bhojayed bhaktibhāvataḥ hetuṃ māṃsañca matsyañca carvaṇañca pradāpayet siddhamantrī bhavet so'pi nātra kāryā vicāraṇā pañcāṅgeyañca kathitā puraskriyā susiddhaye

sūryārghyaṃ jalapānañca praṇāmaṃ caiva pūjanam tattatkarmadaśāṃśena kuryāddhomādikaṃ budhaḥ ravyarghyasya daśāṃśena jalapānaṃ samācaret dakṣahaste jalaṃ nītvā mūlānte'mukadevatām tatsaṃkhyāñca samāpyā'tha mūlānte svīyadevatām pūjanañca tataḥ kuryāt yathāvidhividhānataḥ viprārādhanamātreṇa vyaṅgaṃ sāṅgaṃ bhaved yataḥ dvijādīnāñca varṇānāṃ vidhiḥ proktaḥ śubhāvahaḥ itareṣāñca varṇānāṃ triguṇādisamīritaḥ tattaddaśaiva kāryāṇi daśaśūnyaṃ na kārayet dakṣiṇāṃ gurave dadyāt mantrāṇāñca viśuddhaye tattadabhāvato mantrī kulīnāya kulāya vā tattatkalpasamācārānmantrasiddhiḥ prajāyate iti śrīmajjñānānandaparamahaṃsaviracite kaulāvalīnirṇaye trayodaśollāsaḥ śmaśāne tu puraścaryā kathitā bhuvi durlabhā śākte caiva viśeṣeṇa sādhayet sādhakottamaḥ aṣṭamyāñca caturdaśyāṃ pakṣayorubhayorapi akṣālitacitāyāṃ tu sādhako nirbhayaḥ sudhīḥ nānāphalañca naivedyaṃ svakalpoktena sādhitam samānaguṇasampannaiḥ sādhako vītabhīḥ svayam no cet svayaṃ kevalo'sau bhairavaḥ parikīrttitaḥ citāyāḥ paścime bhāge upaviśya sthiraḥ śuciḥ gurupādarajo dhyātvā vāmapādapuraḥsaraḥ vidhivat pūjayitvā tu puṭāñjaliḥ paṭhedimam piśācayakṣasiddhāśca gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ

siddhidāstā bhavantvatra tathā ca mama rakṣakāḥ śmaśānādhipatiṃ paścād bhairavaṃ kālabhairavam pādyādibhiśca mantrajño baliṃ paścānnivedayet imamante sāmiṣānnaṃ baliṃ gṛhṇadvayaṃ vadet siddhiṃ me ca prayacchā'nte svāhānte'pi baliṃ diśet bhairavabhayānakāt pūrvaṃ māyābījaṃ paṭhet sudhīḥ kūrcānte kālaśabdānte bhairaveti tataḥ param hūmante ca mahākāla pūrvavaduttare haret kālarātri mahākāli kālike ghoraniḥsvane kālakāyai baliṃ dattvā bhūtanāthāya dāpayet praṇavādyena manunā dāpayedbalimuttamam śmaśānamastakecaiva baliṃ pūrvavadāharet asthisamprokṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā tatra pīṭhe manuṃ nyaset likhitvā svīyamantrañca sthāpayedāsanopari kūrcabījadvayaṃ paścāt māyāyugmaṃ samuddharet dānavān dārayetyuktvā haneti dvitayaṃ tataḥ svāhānte varmacā'strānto vīrārdanamanurmataḥ tanmadhye bhairavo devo na vighnaiḥparibhūyate arkendusitavāṭyālamūlairnirmitavarttikām astraṃ prapūjayettatra dīpaṃ saṃrakṣayettataḥ svasvakalpoktavidhinā bhūtaśuddhyādikañcaret nānāvidyāprabhedena ṣoḍhā ca bahudhābhavet vinyasenmātṛkāsthāne mātṛkāṃ tārasampuṭām vidhivat pūjayitvā ca nijadevīṃ susādhakaḥ ekākṣaraṃ yadi bhaved diksahasraṃ tato japet

ataḥ parantu mantrajño gajāntaka sahasrakam japādau tu baliṃ dadyāt paścādapi baliṃ haret tadāpi ca baliṃdadyāt mahiṣaṃ chāgameva vā taruṇaṃ sundaraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kṣatādidoṣavarjitam samānīya svavāme ca prokṣayettadanantaram narmadā yamunā gaṅgā karatoyā sarasvatī ajasnāne maheśāni sānnidhyamiha kalpaya parāparāya parameṣṭhine hūṅkārāya ca mūrttaye brahmarandhre ca brahmāṇaṃ mastake medinīṃ tathā jyotīṃṣi netrayorviṣṇuṃ vadane paripūjya ca vāmagaṇḍe tathā vahniṃ grīvāyāṃ samavarttinam nāsāmūle ca śvasanaṃ skandhe caiva dhaneśvaram ito'nyathā pāpayutaṃ malamūtravasāyutam anyeṣāṃ mahiṣādīnāṃ balīnāmatha pūjanāt bhūṣayedraktamālyena sindūreṇa viśeṣataḥ chāga tvaṃ balarūpeṇa mama bhāgyādupasthitaḥ caṇḍikāprītidānena dāturāpadvināśine yajñārthe balayaḥ sṛṣṭāḥ svayamevasvayambhuvā tato vāgbhavo māyā ca kamalā tadanantaram śivabuddhyā susañcintya taṃ pūjya ca tataḥ param kṛṣṇaṃ pinākapāṇiñca kālarātrisvarūpiṇam raktāmbaradharaṃ caiva pāśahastaṃ kuṭumbinam iti dhyātvā susampūjya namaskuryāt prayatnataḥ śrīgarbho vijayaścaiva dharmapāla namo'stu te rasanā tvaṃ caṇḍikāyāḥ suralokaprasādhakaḥ

vajreśvari padasyānte lauhadaṇḍaśca ṅeyutaḥ viṣaṃ māyāyugaṃ kāliyugmaṃ vikaṭaśabdataḥ dvayaṃ chedayayugmañca sarvaduṣṭāṃśca māraya cikidvandvaṃ pibadvandvaṃ rudhiraṃ sphroṃ (sphoṃ) yugantataḥ anena mantritaṃ khaḍgamuttolya sādhakottamaḥ āṃ hūṃ phaḍiti mantreṇa chedayitvā tataḥ param gandhapuṣpānvitaṃ kṛtvā utsṛjenmantramuccaran rudhireṇa tataḥ paścādāpyāyatāṃ tataḥ param na dikṣu vīkṣaṇaṃ kuryāt na ca bandhusamāgamam pakṣikīṭapiśācānāṃ yadvā manasi saṃsthitam sādhanañca samāpyātha dakṣiṇāṃ gurave dadet samyak siddhaikamantrasya nā'sādhyaṃ vidyate kvacit svakulānte puraścaryā rātrau kāryā na cānyathā sarvapāpaharaṃ caiva sarvarogavināśanam mahābalo mahābuddhirmahāsāhasikaḥ śuciḥ teṣāṃ kṛte pravakṣyāmi vīrasādhanamuttamam sarvasiddhirbhavatyeva ahorātre kalau yuge kṛte tu daśabhirvarṣaḥ satyaṃ siddhirna saṃśayaḥ dbāhye ca punarvastraṃ mūlena candanādikam iṣṭadevaṃ guruṃ natvā rātrau praharamadhyataḥ akṣubdho bhuktabhojyastu yadi syādvīrasādhakaḥ pūrvoktadivase vīro nānopacārasaṃyutaḥ pāyasānnaṃ surāṃ caiva māṣabhaktabaliṃ tathā elālavaṅgakarpūrajātikhadiramārdrakam caṣakaṃ yajñakāṣṭhañca svaprādeśapramāṇakam

yaṣṭividdhaṃ śūlaviddhaṃ khaḍgaviddhaṃ payomṛtam taruṇaṃ sundaraṃ śūraṃ raṇe naṣṭaṃ samujjvalam na svayaṃ ghātayedvidvān mantrāṇi tatra varjayet anāturamṛtaṃ kuṣṭhi saptarātrordhvagaṃ tathā gṛhītvā mūlamantreṇa pūjāsthāne samānayet bilvamūle śmaśāne vā tatsamīpe vanasthale vīrārdanāṅkite bhūmau māyā moho na vidyate ye cātretyādimantreṇa bhūmau puṣpāñjaliṃ kṣipet māyāsphuradvayaṃ bhūyaḥ prasphuradvitayaṃ punaḥ caṭayugmaṃ tadante ca pracaṭadvitayaṃ punaḥ ghātayadvitayaṃ varmaphaḍanto'ghorako manuḥ varmāstrānto mahāmantraḥ sudarśanasya kīrttitaḥ praṇavaṃ kūrcavajaṃ tu mṛtakāya namaśca phaṭ atīva paramānanda śivānanda kuleśvara vīro'haṃ tvāṃ prapadyāmi santiṣṭha devikārcane praṇavaṃ śabdabījañca mṛtakāya namastataḥ raktayukto yadi bhavet bhakṣayet kulasādhakam upacāraṃ svadakṣe tu sthāpayitvā susādhakaḥ gṛhītvā tatra dātavyaṃ sarvaṃ naiva ca saṃspṛśet mṛdvāsane tato vīro vīrāsana parigrahaḥ ātmarakṣāṃ vidhāyātha aghoreṇa samāhitaḥ anena manunā vīraḥ sarṣapān dikṣu niḥkṣipet pitṛṇāṃ svargadātā tvaṃ martyānāṃ mama rakṣakaḥ iti kṣiptvā tilāṃstatra caturbhāgaṃ śavāditaḥ kuśaśayyāṃ paristīrya tatra saṃsthāpayecchavam

niḥkṣipya ca tataḥ kuryācchavaṃ paścādadhomukham bāhumūlādikaṭyantaṃ caturasraṃ vibhāvya ca tatra caileyamajinaṃ kambalāntaritaṃ nyaset niḥkṣipeddaśa kāṣṭhāni pūrvādidaśadikṣu ca viṣamindrapadaṃ likhya surādhipataye tataḥ vighnanivāraṇaṃ kṛtvā siddhiṃ prayaccha ṭhadvayam svasvanāmādikaṃ kṛtvā pūrvavadbalimuddharet catuḥṣaṣṭiyoginībhyo ḍākinībhyo'pi sandiśet samānaguṇasampannaṃ māntrikaṃ vijitendriyam saṃsthāpyāsanamabhyarpya svamantrānte parāntataḥ kuśān pādatale dattvā śavakeśān pragṛhya ca tatra devīṃ susampūjya upacāraiḥ suvistaraiḥ oṃ vaśo me bhava deveśa mama vīrapadantataḥ anena manunā mantrī abhilapya kṛtāñjaliḥ trāhi māṃ devadeveśa śavānāmadhipādhipa tadotthātuṃ na śaknoti śavastu niścalo bhavet paṭṭasūtreṇa badhnīyāt śavapādadvayaṃ tataḥ hastayoḥ kuśamāstīrya pādau tatra nidhāpayet sadā devīṃ hṛdi dhyātvā maunī japanamācaret jayadurgāmanunā'rghyaṃ tenaiva sarṣapān kṣipet devīṃ tatrāpi sampūjya prajapenmanumuttamam pūrvoktakramayogena akṣamālāṃ vidhānataḥ yat prārthayasi deveśi dātavyaṃ kuñjarādikam ityuktā saṃskṛtenaiva nirbhayastu punarjapet tataḥ satyaṃ kārayitvā varantu prārthayennaraḥ

tadā punarjapeddhīmān ekāgramānasaṃ yathā yatnatastena boddhavyaṃ naro vā devayonijaḥ āgatya vighnaṃ kurute māyayā'cchādya vigraham prabhātasamayo jātastvatpitā krośate gṛhe kadācitkena vā dṛṣṭastadā'niṣṭaṃ bhaviṣyati mṛtāḥ pitṛgaṇāstatra dūradeśanivāsinaḥ strīputrasevakādīṃśca gṛhītvā nīyate paraiḥ nijakāntāṅgasaṃsparśavastrādyābharaṇādikam divase yatra vā śaṅkā saiva tatra prajāyate strīrūpadhāriṇī devī dvijarūpadharaḥ pumān sādhunā'sādhunā vāpi yoṣiccedvaradāyinī niṣpāpapuruṣecaiva satkulanaiśca saṃskṛtā sammukhe'sammukhe vāpi saṃskṛtaṃ vakti cāparam na cedevaṃ bhaveccaiva māyāracitavigrahaḥ sā cet saṃskṛtamākhyānaṃ vakti vā vyaktamīdṛśam athavā utkaṭaṃ kiñcit jyotirvā nīlalohitam vicārya tadgṛhītavyamevaṃ dik parikīrtitam avaśyaṃ tatra bhetavyaṃ na tatra pratyayaḥ kvacit etacchāstraprasaṅgena kṛtvā kuṭilavigrahāḥ tasmāttattu bhavanno vā vicāre yatnamācaret phalaṃ jātamiti jñātvā juṭikāṃ mocayettataḥ dattvā piṣṭamayānante karttavyaṃ samupoṣaṇam brāhmaṇān bhojayettatra pañcaviṃśati saṃkhyakān tatraḥ snātvā ca bhuktvā ca nivaseduttame sthale tena cennirdhanatvaṃ syāttadā devaḥ prakupyati

śayyāyāṃ yadi gacchedvai tadā vyādhiṃ vinirdiśet yadi vakti dine vākyaṃ tadā sa mūkatāṃ vrajet gobrāhmaṇānāṃ nindāñca na kuryācca kadācana prātarnityakriyānte tu bilvapatrodakaṃ pibet tataḥ śatatrayādūrdhvaṃ devānāṃ tarpaṇaṃ jalaiḥ ityanena vidhānena siddhiṃ prāpnoti sādhakaḥ asāṅga sāṅgamevaṃ vā niṣphalaṃ saphalañca vā śavābhāve śmaśāne vā kāryā vai vīrasādhanā catuṣpathe caturdikṣu puruṣaṃ hṛdayaṃ khanet madhye tathā khanedekaṃ tatra mṛdvāsanaṃ bhavet mahākālādidevebhyo baliṃ pūrvavadāharet digvāsāśca japenmantramayutaṃ sarvadaivatam sarvasiddhirbhavedvidvān sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ sādhakaiḥ saha sāmagrīṃ pūjāyāṃ vividhāṃ tathā varmāstramanunā hastapramāṇaṃ caturasrakam tato nāthayugantrāhi yugalaṃ tadanantaram ityātmānaṃ śavaṃ caiva veṣṭayitvā ca sādhakaḥ ḍākinīhākinībhyaśca śākinībhyo'pi sandiśet vāmadevāya dattvā vai raktadantāya dāpayet dakṣiṇe rudrakālāya vajranābhāya sandiśet tataḥ sampūjayed devīṃ svakalpoktavidhānataḥ udvarttanaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā snāpayitvā tu sādhakaḥ jīvanyāsaṃ vidhāyātha pādyādibhiḥ prapūjayet āsanaṃ pūrvavat kṣiptvā mūlamuccārya sādhakaḥ ananyamānaso bhūtvā japāt siddhiḥ prajāyate

gurupādaprasādena mā hiṃsanti ca hiṃsakāḥ devatā yadi vāme vai āgacchati kadācana hūṅkāriṇaiva tāṃ kuryāt svadakṣe sādhakottamaḥ tathāpi ca baliṃ dattvā aśaktau manasā'thavā śavādikañjale kṣiptvā gṛhaṃ gacchet yathāsukham snātvā tatra manuṃ japtvā ayutaṃ sādhakottamaḥ bilvamūle nijakroḍe śavamāropya yatnataḥ sahasraṃ tatra japtvā vai sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet hastau ca bhūmisaṃlagnau kampamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ nārasiṃhī bhavenmudrā sarvasiddhipradāyikā kuṅkumāgurukastūrīrocanāghanacandanam ekatra sādhitaṃ kṛtvā pratyekaṃ sādhayennaraḥ bījaṃ pratyekaṃ dravyāṇāṃ militānāñca sādhakaḥ asya tilakamātreṇa rājānaṃ vaśamānayet tenaiva guṭikāṃ kṛtvā tatra kālīṃ prapūjayet jihvāgre rudhiraṃ gṛhṇa cāmuṇḍe ghoraniḥsvane kāli kāli pracaṇḍogre tato'straṃ kavacaṃ tataḥ kūrcayugmaṃ tu nīlāyāḥ kathitaṃ mantramuttamam candrakhaṇḍasamīyuktaṃ tato nīlapadaṃ tataḥ santapteyaṃ mahāvidyā kathitā suradurlabhā tena nīlapatākeyaṃ saṃyojyā nīlasādhane bhṛguṃ sargānvitaṃ paścāddīrghaṃ kavacamuddharet mama śatrupadasyānte tato bhakṣapadaṃ vadet rājyaṃ me dehi sambhāṣya bhṛguṃ sargānvitaṃ vadet ekacatvāriṃśadarṇo manuḥ prokto dhruvādikaḥ

yā sā vidyā mahātārā sā karāleti kīrttitā namaḥ svāheti mantro'yaṃ daśākṣara udīritaḥ ebhirāmantritaṃ caiva mūlenaiva sahasrakam mahāṣṭamīnavamyostu saṃyoge purataḥ sthitaḥ kabandhaṃ muṇḍapuñjañca dīpādibhiralaṃkṛtam tāmbūlapūravaktrañca añjanāñcitalocanam atha pūrvodite sthāne catuṣpathe viśeṣataḥ saptamāṣṭamamāsīyaṃ garbhajaṃ yadi vā śavam ānīya sthāpayedādau nyāsajālaṃ samācaret abhyarcya cā'sanaṃ dattvā rakṣāmātmani kārayet tato japtvā sarvamantra sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet śavasthāpanamantro'yaṃ śavāsanamanuṃ tataḥ karakāñcīṃ samādāya muṇḍamālāvibhūṣitaḥ śmaśāne ca sakṛjjaptvā sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet tatra sakṛjjapitvā tu devatāmelanaṃ bhavet tadbhasmatilakaṃ kṛtvā svayaṃ vīreśvaro bhavet digvāsā vimalo bhasmabhūṣaṇo muktakeśakaḥ tadā tasya mahāsiddhirjāyate śatajāpataḥ tatrā'pyānīya sampūjya gajāntakasahasrakam mahāśavāḥ praśastāḥ syuḥ pradhānaśavasādhane sarveṣāṃ jīvahīnānāṃ jantūnāṃ nīlasādhane evaṃ nīlakramaṃ caiva kathitañca śubhāvaham kuje vā śanivāre vā naramuṇḍaṃ samāhitaḥ niḥkṣipya bhūmau hastārdhamānataḥ kānanāntare ekākī prajapenmantraṃ sa bhavet kalpapādapaḥ

taddināttaddinaṃ yāvattāvadaṣṭottaraṃ śatam athavā vijane'raṇye'sthiśayyāsano naraḥ aṣṭamyāñca caturdaśyāṃ pakṣayorubhayorapi tāvajjaptvā nirātaṅkaḥ sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet nadyāṃ samudragāminyāṃ nābhimāvasthite'mbhasi grāsādvimuktiparyantaṃ japaṃ kuryādananyadhīḥ tadante mahatīṃ pūjāṃ kuryād brāhmaṇabhojanam sūryagrahaṇakālāddhi nānyaḥ kālaḥ praśasyate śaratkāle caturthyādi navamyantaṃ viśeṣataḥ japedekākī vijane kevalaṃ timirālaye sa bhavet sarvasiddhīśo nātra kāryā vicāraṇā praviśya mantrī vidhivattāḥ samabhyarcya yatnataḥ kevalaṃ kāmabhāvena japedaṣṭottaraṃ śatam mahāsiddhirbhavet sadyo latādarśanapūjanāt prapūjya tatra saṃskāraṃ kṛtvā tasyai nivedayet tāṃ visṛjya namaskṛtya svayaṃ japtvā susaṃyataḥ athavā gurumānīya devabhāvena pūjayet tatsutaṃ tatsutāṃ caiva patnīṃ caiva viśeṣataḥ sahasrāre guroḥ pādapadmaṃ dhyātvā prapūjya ca gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādyathāvibhavavistaraiḥ guruṃ vilaṅghya śāstre'sminnā'dhikārī suro'pi ca guruvaktraṃ vinā caiva siddhi hāniḥ prajāyate anyathā pretarājasya bhavanaṃ yāti niścitam iti śrīmajjñānānandaparamahaṃsaviracite kaulāvalīnirṇaye caturdaśollāsaḥ homādikaṃ hi viphalaṃ kumārīpūjanaṃ vinā

yathā yathā devatāyā pūjanaṃ vā yathāguroḥ yathāśaktyā hi vitaret kumāryai yadyadīpsitam puṣpaṃ kumāryai yaddattaṃ tanmerusadṛśaṃ matam alpamapyathavā mantrahīnaṃ bahuguṇaṃ bhavet kumārīvandanādeva kumārīsadṛśo bhavet kumārī yoginī sākṣāt kumārī sarvadevatā sukumārī mahādevī tridhā mūrttirvyavasthitā yatra kāle na kiñcit syād devāsuramahoragāḥ ādyasṛṣṭeśca yā śaktiḥ pratyakṣā sā tu tattridhā bhūrbhuvomūrttirūpā sā ekā pūjyā kumārikā nityakrameṇa deveśi pūjayedvidhipūrvakam pūjitāḥ pratigṛhyante nirgacchantyavamānitāḥ bhūtavetālagandharvā ḍākinīyakṣarākṣasāḥ pṛthivyādīni sarvāṇi brahmāṇḍaṃ sacarācaram te tuṣṭāḥ sarvatuṣṭāśca yastu kanyāṃ prapūjayet ghnanti vighnān pūjitāstāstathā śatruṃ mahotkaṭam grahā yakṣāḥ kṣayaṃ yānti bhūtavetālapannagāḥ mahābhayāni durbhikṣamutpātāni sahasraśaḥ kumārī pūjanādeva na tasya prabhavanti ca catuṣkaṃ divyavetālaṃ bhavet kumārikārcanāt dvitīyavatsarādūrdhvaṃ yāvat syādaṣṭamābdikam athavā ṣoḍaśābdāntaṃ yāvat puṣpaṃ na jāyate bālapriyañca naivedyaṃ balābhāvaviceṣṭitam ekavarṣā bhavet sandhyā dvivarṣā ca sarasvatī subhagā pañcavarṣā ca ṣaḍvarṣā ca umā bhavet

navabhiḥ kālasaṅkarṣā daśabhiścāparājitā trayodaśe mahālakṣmīrdvisaptā pīṭhanāyikā evaṃ krameṇa pūjyā tu yāvat puṣpaṃ na vidyate mahāparvasu sarveṣu viśeṣaśca pavitrake piṅgalāṃ pūjayedyastu ṣoḍaśaiścaiva bhaktimān pūjayet kulavidyāñca caikāṃ bālakabhairavīm vāṇī māyā tathā lakṣmīrmāyā kūrcadvayantataḥ ekādaśasvareṇā'ḍhyo bhṛguvindvinda saṃyutaḥ evaṃ dvābhyāṃ tribhiścaiva saptadhā navadhā punaḥ vāgbhavena jalaṃ deyaṃ māyayā pādaśaucakam śaktibījena puṣpāṇi dhūpaṃ ṣaṣṭhena dāpayet śrīṃbījena śriyo lābho hrīṃbījenā'risaṅkṣayaḥ nyāsādikaṃ prakurvīta ādau svīyakrameṇa tu aiṃ klīṃ śrīṃ klauṃ hsauḥ kulakumārike hṛdayāya namaḥ aiṃ klīṃ saiṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ aiṃ siddhi jayāya pūrvavaktrāya namaḥ kraṃ kālike dakṣiṇavaktrāya namaḥ aṣṭottaraśataṃ vāpi ekāṃ kanyāṃ prapūjayet bhaktibhāvena sampūjya tasyai sarvaṃ nivedayet bālāmalaṅkṛtāṃ paśyan cintayet sveṣṭadevatām pradakṣiṇatrayaṃ kuryādādimadhye śubhaṃ bhavet paścācca dakṣiṇā deyā rajatasvarṇamauktikaiḥ kumārīpūjane caiva jātimātraṃ na cintayet nānādoṣodbhavā vāpi guṇalāvaṇyasaṃyutāḥ yathāyathā tatpriyakṛt sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet

tatkṣaṇāllabhate mokṣaṃ satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ te tuṣṭāḥ sarvatuṣṭāśca yastu kanyāṃ prapūjayet gohatyāṃ strīvadhaṃ caiva sarvapāpaṃ praṇaśyati ye tu ye tu puna sarve kanyādānaṃ prakalpayet rudraloke vasennityaṃ trinetro bhagavān hariḥ kumārīkalpamākhyātaṃ athavā'nyatamañcaret pūrvavadvidhivadvīro nava bālakamānayet gandhapuṣpākṣatākalpairyathāvibhavavistaraiḥ svakāryaphalasiddhyarthaṃ vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ navarātrakṛtāṃ pūjāṃ mahādevyai samarpayet evaṃ navakumārīṇāmarcanaṃ prativatsaram mano'bhilaṣitaṃ prāpya nivasettavasannidhau pūjayedvidhivadbhaktyā nava rātriṣu mantravit icchāṃ jñānāṃ kriyāṃ durgāṃ vaṭukañca gaṇeśvaram prauḍhollāsena saṃyuktāḥ santuṣṭā yadi cet tadā evaṃ yaḥ pūjayed devīṃ prativarṣaṃ yativrataḥ tisro vā pañca vā sapta pūjayed devatādhiyā athavā'nyaprakāreṇa kathyate mithunārcanam gaurīśivo ramāviṣṇū vāṇīsarasijāsanau bhadrakālīvīrabhadrau bhairavībhairavāvapi tritārādinamo'ntena tattannāmnā vidhānataḥ gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ pūjya tattvādyaiḥ paritoṣayet evaṃ kṛte na sandehastuṣṭā mithunadevatāḥ prativarṣaṃ tu yaḥ kuryād bhaktyā ca mithunārcanam bhṛguvāre yajedyatnāt kāntāmārūḍhayauvanām

kulākulāṣṭamāṃ caivā āmantrayā'hūyapuṣpiṇīm ātmānaṃ gandhapuṣpādyairalaṃkuryāt susādhakaḥ kṛtvā kramārcanaṃ dhūpadīpañca kuladīpakam māṃsādibhakṣyabhojyādyaistoṣayed bhaktibhāvataḥ yauvanollāsasahitaḥ svayaṃ taddhyānatatparaḥ japādikaṃ samāpyātha tayā saha niśāṃ nayet pūjayedvidhinā caiva tasya puṇyaṃ na gaṇyate athānyaṃ sampravakṣyāmi samayācāramuttamam mānavaḥ kulaśāstrāṇāṃ kulacaryānusāriṇām paranindāsahiṣṇuḥ syādupakārarataḥ sadā catuṣpathe kalāśūnye yadi daivādgatirbhavet gṛdhraṃ vīkṣya mahākālīṃ namaskuryādalakṣitam kuraraṃ droṇakākaṃ tu kṛṣṇamārjārameva ca kṛśodari mahācaṇḍe muktakeśi balipriye śmaśāne ca śivāṃ dṛṣṭvā pradakṣiṇamanuvrajan ghoradaṃṣṭre kaṭhorākṣi kiṭiśabdaninādini raktavastrāṃ raktapuṣpāṃ vilokya tripurāmbikām bandhūkapuṣpasaṅkāśe tripure bhayanāśini kṛṣṇavastraṃ tathā puṣpaṃ rājānaṃ rājaputrakam mahiṣaṃ kuladevañca dṛṣṭvā mahiṣamardinīm jaya devi jagaddhātri tripurādye tridaivate madyabhāṇḍaṃ samālokya matsyaṃ māṃsaṃ varastriyam ghoravighnavināśāya kulācārasamṛddhaye raktadhārāsamākīrṇavadane tvāṃ namāmyaham eteṣāṃ darśane caiva yadi naivaṃ prakurvate

eteṣāṃ māraṇoccāṭahiṃsanaṃ vā bhayādibhiḥ pradhānāṃśasamudbhūtā ete kulajanāḥ priye labdhasiddhisamāyogāt ḍākinīhiṃsanaṃ yadi baṭukānāṃ bhairavāṇāṃ tasya siddhirna jāyate yaṃ dṛṣṭvā yuvatī nārī kalākuśalasaṃyutā utkṣipya bhujamūlasya vāsasaṃ kṣipyate yadi kaṇḍūyabhāvavyājena śithilīkṛtavāsasā skhalat pādayugāt pādaṃ patitā punarutthitā ityādibhāvabhāvitāṃ dṛṣṭvā sādhakasattamaḥ tatra sthitvā punaḥ kṣobhaṃ kuryāt kāma vāparaḥ vidagdhāṃ vā mahābhraṣṭāṃ kutsitāṃ vāpi hīnajām sambhogena vinopekṣāṃ na kuryācca kadācana kruddhā bhagavatī tasya śāpaṃ dadyāt sudāruṇam niṣkṛtirnāsti tasyaiva yāvadācandratārakam mahādevyai vinā dattvā na bhoktavyaṃ kadācana namaskuryāt prayatnena caṇḍikāṃ sādhakottamaḥ yadā kuryāttadā natvā devīṃ yātrāṃ samācaret tatra devyai nivedyaiva karttavyañca prapūjanam vane vā durgamevāpi yadi gacchati sādhakaḥ tarpaṇādau prakurvīta tṛpyatāṃ brahmabhairava tṛpyatāṃ bhairavī mātā pitā bhairava tṛpyatām jyotiṣṭomāśvamedhādau yatra yaṃ yaṃ prapūjayet striyo dṛṣṭvā tathaikatra yuvatyatimanoharāḥ dadyāttattatpriyaṃ dravyaṃ manasā cintya caṇḍikām kanyāyā bhāṣaṇe śrīmattripurāyāḥ prapūjanam

evaṃ vadet pradāne tu kanyakāyāḥ prapūjane atrā'śakto bhavedyastu tasyārthaṃ likhyate stavaḥ śrīrmālinī ca siddhā'mbā mahātripurasundarī sampradāyāḥ kulaṃ kaulā rahasyātirahasyagāḥ bhagamālā nityaklinnā bheruṇḍā vahnivāsinī nityā nīlapatākā ca vijayā sarvamaṅgalā pūrṇākhyā ca tathā jñeyā kāmeśī modinī tathā sarveśvarī tathā kaulī vāgīśī sarvakāminī svapnāvatī śūlinī ca mātaṅgī surasundarī prāṇavidyā tathaikākṣī caikapādā mahāṅkuśā trikhaṇḍā triśirā śaurī gaurī vindhyanivāsinī kālī kuṇḍamayī kuṇḍarūpiṇī bandhurūpiṇī kṣobhiṇī nādinī bhadrā lalitā bahurūpikā troṭeśvarī mahāvidyāḥ kathitāstava bhairava manuścandraḥ kuberaśca manmathastadanantaram krodhabhaṭṭārakaścaiva pañcamī ca prakīrttitā aurvo vahniryamaścaiva nair-ṛto varuṇastathā aniroddho bharadvājo dakṣiṇāmūrttireva ca dhātrī śeṣaḥ pramattaśca unmattaḥ kulabhairavaḥ prahlādaḥ śukadevaśca rāmo rāvaṇa eva ca bṛhaspatiryaduśreṣṭho dattātreyo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ duryodhanastathā kuntī sītā ca rukmiṇī tathā puṣpadanto mahābuddho bāṇaḥ kālaśca mandaraḥ nārado bhīṣmakarṇau ca meruścāruṇa eva ca mahāvidyāprasādena svasvakarma samanvitāḥ

prātaḥkāle śucirbhūtvā yaḥ paṭhet prayatātmanā aśucirvā nirālambo sālambo vā kulāntike cakrasaṅketakaṃ caiva gurusaṅketakaṃ tathā samayācārasaṅketamakṛtvā yo'tra varttate evaṃ stotraṃ paṭhitvā tu saṅketamānayed dhruvam atha vaiśākhamāsasya śuklapratipadīśvari manojñe rahasi sthāne pūrvābhimukhamāsthitaḥ kṛtvā puroditān nyāsān devatābhāvamāsthitaḥ arghyaṃ nivedya taccheṣaṃ śaktyā saha pibettataḥ dhyāyaṃstanmaṇḍale devīmaṣṭottarasahasrakam evaṃ śuklapratipadaṃ samārabhya dine dine amāvasyādine dhīraḥ pūjayed bhaktakaulikān evaṃ yo māsamātrantu kuryāt sūryodayārcanam yatkiñcidudite sūrye maṇḍale sveṣṭadevatām ṣoḍaśairupacāraistu cakrapūjāpuraḥsaram madhyāhne pūjayedvāpi sāyāhne vāpi pūjayet kāṅkṣitāṃ labhate siddhiṃ devavadvicaredbhuvi snātvā śuklāmbaradharaḥ sāyaṃ sandhyāmupāsya ca yauvanollāsasahitaścandrasthāṃ devatāṃ smaran candrāstodayaparyantaṃ japenmantramananyadhīḥ paurṇamāsyāṃ yathāśaktyā pūjayecchaktikaulikān sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā sarvaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ śuklapakṣārcanaṃ yadvattadvat pakṣe sitetare iha bhuktvā'khilān bhogān devavat priyadarśanaḥ atha kārttikamāsasya śuklapratipadi dhruvam

prasupte jīvaloke tu muditātmā mahāniśi ājyenānāmikāṅguṣṭhe varttiṃ prajvālya sādhakaḥ madhusampūrṇakalase kāṃsyapātre manohare dīpe sāvaraṇāṃ devīṃ dhyātvā vidhivadarcayet aṣṭottarasahasraṃ tu japenmantramananyadhīḥ amāvasyādine śaktyā pūjayet śaktikaulikān sarvakāmasamṛddhātmā sarvaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ aṣṭāṣṭakārcanaṃ kuryācchaktaścedekavāsare dvātriṃśaddivaseṣveva catuḥṣaṣṭidineṣu vā kramajñaścet svayaṃ kuryādvittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ maṅgalādyaiśca nipuṇairaṣṭabhiḥ śaktibhistathā akṣobhyādicatuḥṣaṣṭimithunāni samarcayet kramalopaṃ na kurvīta sveṣṭakāyārthasiddhaye bhakṣyabhojyādibhirnānāpadārthaiḥ ṣaḍrasānvitaiḥ prauḍhāntollāsaparyantaṃ kuryāt śrīcakrapūjanam brahmaviṣṇumaheśādi devatābhiḥ sa pūjyate yadarcanāccatuḥṣaṣṭi yoginīgaṇasaṃstutaḥ punarāvṛttirahito nivasecchivasannidhau kulapūjāṃ vinā cakre nādhikāraḥ kathañcana kulapūjāṃ suniyataṃ yaḥ karoti sa kaulikaḥ nīco'pi vā sakṛd bhaktyā kārayed yaḥ kulārcanam tasmāt sarvaprayatnena sarvāvasthāsu sarvadā vedaśāstroktamārgeṇa kulapūjāṃ karoti yaḥ idaṃ satyamidaṃ satyaṃ satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ iti śrīmajjñānānandaparamahaṃsaviracite kaulāvalīnirṇaye pañcadaśollāsaḥ

adīkṣitakulo yo hi sādhanaṃ samupācaret adīkṣitakulāsaṅgāt siddhihāniḥ prajāyate sa kulīnaḥ kathaṃ caiva pūjayet parameśvarīm yatkule kuladīkṣā tu na syāt pāpī sa eva hi parayoṣā yadi syācca svayaṃ tasyā gururbhavet kulabhaktaṃ guruṃ prārthya dīkṣayet kuladīkṣayā gaṇeśo gāṇapatyaśca gaṇadīkṣāprabhuryataḥ kulīnaḥ sarvamantrāṇāmadhikārī bhavet sadā dīkṣāyāṃ kulapūjāyāṃ śiṣyatve yadi vā gurau adhastāt dṛṣṭipātena tasya vidyā'pyadhomukhī pārśvāvalokanenaiva vyādhidāridryapīḍitā etādṛśaṃ kulaṃ caiva yadi kuryāt kathañcana etādṛśa kulasyāgre prayogaḥ phalado na hi parānandarasāghūrṇahṛdayā lolalocanā tāmbūlapūritamukhī sindūrāñjanasaṃyutā devīvāhaṃ devadeva upadeśaṃ samācara ityuktvā sarvaśṛṅgāraveśāḍhyaḥ sthiramānasaḥ tadgātre deyamantrasya nyāsajālaṃ pravinyaset śakticakraṃ tridhā'veṣṭya tatra kāmakalāṃ likhet tatra devīṃ samāvāhya dhyātvā tāṃ tu prapūjayet mūlavidyāṃ tridhā'vṛttyā kathayet vāmakarṇake mātṛpitṛkṛtaṃ nāma varjayitvā vadettataḥ sakulājñāṃ samādāya lajjālasyavivarjitā ityanujñāṃ gurorlabdhvā praṇameddaṇḍavad bhuvi hṛtpādāmbhoruhacchāyāṃ dehi mūrdhni yaśodhana

sarvasvaṃ gurave dadyāttadardhaṃ vā dayāyuje stutvā natvā yathāśaktyā svakalpoktaṃ samācaret pūjārhā ca yadā devī tadā mātā na saṃśayaḥ tatkṛtvā tena pāpena ubhau narakagāminau na karttavyaṃ na karttavyaṃ na ca vākyaṃ kadācana sāṅgāvaraṇapūjādau yadā na kṣaraye kulam tarpayitvā kulaṃ dhyātvā japenmantraṃ nirākulaḥ na nyāso yoṣitāñcāpi na dhyānaṃ na ca pūjanam sarvavidyāprayogaṃ tu tataḥ kuryāt susādhakaḥ yatprāpya kuladevena labhyate vāñchitaṃ mahat amṛtaṃ varṣate sā tu tridinaṃ pṛthivītale pūrṇameva bhavettasya saphalaṃ ca manoratham ānīya pramadāṃ divyāṃ pramattāṃ yauvanānvitām sarvadānandahṛdayāṃ ghṛṇālajjāvivarjitām svakāntāṃ parakāntāṃ vā saṃsthāpya tūlikopari tasyāstu madanāgāre pūjayet parameśvarīm śivahīnā yadā śaktiḥ sarvādau varṣate hi yat taddravyaprāptimātreṇa kiṃ na sidhyati bhūtale svecchā ṛtumatī śaktiḥ sākṣāddevī maheśvarī vastrālaṅkārapuṣpaiśca śaktiñca paripūjayet kulapuṣpaṃ tadeva syāt sarvasiddhipradāyakam kuṇḍodbhavaṃ siddhipradaṃ prakārāntaramucyate svakalpoktaṃ samācarya sādhako jitamānasaḥ pūjayedakṣataiḥ śuddhaiḥ tasyā madanamandiram śuddhamantrauṣadhenaiva mathayenmadanālayam

gṛhṇīyāttat prayatnena dravyaṃ kuṇḍodbhavaṃ śubham eteṣāṃ dravyamadhye tu svayambhūkusumaṃ mahat labdhvā tatparamaṃ dravyaṃ lākṣārasasamanvitam raktena candanenāpi vaṭīṃ kṛtvā sugopayet likhitvā pūjayedbhaktyā yāṃ tithiṃ prāpya sādhakaḥ prabuddhāstatprayogena yāvat sā punarāgatā tithikrameṇa sā devī paurṇamāsyāṃ phalapradā kṣīṇāti pūrṇatāṃ yāti yāvat sā tithirāgatā evaṃ yathā prabuddhā sā naiva tādṛk kadācana yoginyaśca mahānāgā rākṣasādānavāśca ye etenākṣatayogān madhumatīsiddhimālabhet atha vakṣye ca śāktānāṃ kāmyapūjanamuttamam vidhivallikhite yantre kulācāreṇa rātrike janmāntarakṛtāḥ sarve nāśamāyānti niścitam javāpuṣpaiścakrarājaṃ pūjayenmāsamātrakam brahmahatyādi pāpāṃśca pūrvajanmakṛtānapi ketakītaruṇaiḥ patraiḥ pūrvavat pūjayecchivām saubhāgyamatulaṃ tasya jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ pūrvavat parameśāni sarvapāpaṃ vināśayet māsamātreṇa hantyeva pātakān pūrvajanmajān śvetapadmairmahādevīṃ pūjayed bhaktibhāvataḥ māsamātreṇa sakalān mokṣastasya kare sthitaḥ trailokyaṃ vaśagaṃ tasya sarvapāpaṃ praṇāśayet pūrvavat parameśānīṃ māsamātraṃ na saṃśayaḥ mallikāmālatījātīkundaiśca śatapatrakaiḥ

kulācārakrameṇaiva pātakān śatajanmajān muktistasya kare satyaṃ vācāṃpatisamo bhuvi pūrvakrameṇa sampūjya māsamātraṃ prayatnadhīḥ campakaiḥ pāṭalairdevīṃ bakulairnāgakeśaraiḥ saubhāgyamaṇḍalaṃ tasya māsamātreṇa niścitam śamīdūrvāṅkurāśvatthapallavairathavā'rkajaiḥ athātaḥ sarvavidyānāṃ likhyate siddhikāraṇam catuṣpathe vā nadyāṃ vā vaṭamūle triśūlake sindūreṇa likhenmantraṃ vipulaṃ sādhyadarbhitam tarpayitvā tadantaḥsthaḥ prajapenniśicārataḥ atha rātrau puṇyagehe udyāne vā surālaye tataḥ pūrvoktarūpeṇa kulakṣobhaṃ samācaret puṣpāṇi racayedvīro māṇikyaghaṭitāni ca nānāpuṣpaiḥ sugandhaiśca karpūrakṣodacarcitaiḥ dāsabhūtāḥ bhavantyeva mahārogāṃśca nāśayet muktāratnarañjitāni svarṇapuṣpāṇi sādhakaiḥ ekaviṃśatirātreṇa rājaputrī vaśībhavet pravālaghaṭitaiḥ svarṇapuṣpaistu bahubhiryajet puṣpaiśca vividhaiścaiva saptāhācca suniścitam tathā marakatakṣiptasvarṇapuṣpaiśca pūjayet vidhivat tasya varadā bhairavī bhavati sthiram kusumairarcayeccakraṃ trisaptāhāt suniścitam suvarṇaracitaiḥ puṣpairvajrakeśaravarjitaiḥ devā daityāvaśāṃstasya jāyante nātra saṃśayaḥ ekaviṃśatirātreṇa tathā nīlaiśca nīrajaiḥ

gomedaghaṭitaiḥ puṣpaiḥ svarṇapuṣpairyajed budhaḥ saptāhād vairiṇo vaśyā ghātasteṣu prajāyate svarṇaratnamayaiḥ puṣpairpunarnavaiḥ prapūjyate kravyādayastadvaśyā hi bhavantyeva na saṃśayaḥ sacampakādibhirdhīrastrailokyaṃ stambhayet kṣaṇāt nirmālyabhūtaiḥ kusumairarcitaiḥ parameśvarīm tadā devāśca munayaḥ pannagā rākṣasādayaḥ janmakoṭibhavaṃ pāpaṃ nāśayennātra saṃśayaḥ tadāśvamedhadaśakaphalaṃ bhavati sarvadā pūrvoditasvapuṣpaiśca pūjā kāryā susādhakaiḥ tatra tatraiva dātavyaṃ yaddātavyaṃ sukhecchayā kevalaṃ yonipuṣpaistu trailokyaṃ stambhayedbhṛśam nāśayenmohayet sarvānsamudravalayāṃ dharām śuklāmbaradharo dhīraḥ śuklagandhādibhūṣitaḥ śuklago brahmacārī tu śuklāsanaparigrahaḥ piṣṭakaṃ pāyasaṃ dugdhaṃ annaṃ bahuvidhaṃ tathā kṛtasaṅkalpavīrendraḥ sādhayedvāgbhavākṣaram kūrparadhavalāṃ śubhrapuṣpābharaṇabhūṣitām muktāphalasamudbhūtajapamālālasatkarām evaṃ dhyātvā prapūjyaiva vāgīśīṃ sādhakottamaḥ tasmājjotirmayīṃ dhyāyet jihvāgre'mṛtarūpiṇīm tataśca naṣṭahṛdayo grāmyo mūrkho'tipātakī jaḍo mūrkho'tidurmedhā gataprajño vinaṣṭadhīḥ satpaṇḍitaghaṭāṭopajetā'pratihataprabhaḥ kumāratarasphāra vṛttālaṅkārapūrvakaiḥ

vedavedāṅgavedāntasiddhāntajñānapāragaḥ purāṇarasavādādigāruḍānekamantravit vicitracitrakarmādiśilpānekavicakṣaṇaḥ nānāśāstrādiśikṣādivettābhuvanaviśrutaḥ atha kāmakalāsaktaḥ sādhako raktamandire raktavastrāvṛtaḥ samyaṅmadhye kāmakalātmanā nānopahārabalibhiḥ kuṅkumādibhirarcayet bandhūkakusumākārakāntibhūṣaṇabhūṣitām yathoktasaṃkhyaṃ sañjapya kāmarājaṃ susādhakaḥ rājāno vaśamāyānti pannagā rākṣasāḥ surāḥ manaścintitayoṣittu dāsīvadvaśagābhavet vidyādharī kinnarī vā yakṣī nāgāṅganā'thavā jvalanmadanaduṣprekṣyadahanottaptamānasā niveditātmasarvasvā vaśagā tasya jāyate cintitā yoṣitāṃ yonau kṣobhayati ca tatkṣaṇāt sammohonmādanāropacittakarṣakarī tathā dhāraṇāsamprayogeṇa karoti vaśagaṃ jagat raktavarṇāṃ striyaṃ dhyātvā tadīyamahasā tataḥ dhyāyan sammohayennārīṃ madanottaptamānasām etatkāmakalādhyānāt pañcakāma ivāparaḥ yantraṃ vidadhyāt kāmastu manmathāntargato bhavet makaradhvajasañjñantu sarvametat susādhakaḥ trailokyamohano nāma prayogo'yaṃ pradarśitaḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhāraparyantāṃ śarīre cintayet parām hemaprabhābhāsamānāṃ vidyullatāsamaprabhām

jñānamudrāñca dadhatīṃ sākṣādamṛtarūpiṇīm pūrvasaṃkhyaṃ japedbījaṃ nānāvighnaṃ vināśayet vainateyasamo mantrī viṣabhāraṃ vināśayet bhūtapretapiśācāṃśca nāśayennātra saṃśayaḥ duṣṭavyādhigrahāṃścaiva ḍākinīrūpikā gaṇāḥ athavā yena vidyeyaṃ paripūrṇā vicintyate padmarāgamaṇisvacchā cintanāt sādhakasya ca tannāmasmaraṇānmantrī yoginīnāṃ bhavet priyaḥ putravān dhanavān dhīro mantraṃ dhyātvā na saṃśayaḥ prayacchati mahādevī khecarīsiddhimuttamām cakrametat samāsādya sthitāstā nātra saṃśayaḥ kṣobhayet svargabhūrloka pātālatalavāsinaḥ vāgbhavāt vākpatitvañca kāmāt kāmasamo bhavet sarvasiddhirbhavatyeva kūṭatrayasya jāpataḥ iti śrīmajjñānānandaparamahaṃsaviracite kaulāvalīnirṇaye ṣoḍaśollāsaḥ yasya vijñānamātreṇa kṣipraṃ vidyā prasīdati tatra yaśca bhramāvartto'pāna ityucyate budhaiḥ gacchantī brahmarandhre'pi praviśantī svaketane tena mantraśikhā jātā sarvamantrapradīpikā śikhāhīnāstathā mantrā na sidhyanti kadācana vinā'nena na sidhyanti kalpakoṭiśatairapi punaḥ pralīyate tasyāṃ kālāgnyādiśivāntikā tasyāstu bandhamātreṇa tannāsti yanna sādhayet nāsau sidhyati mantraśca satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ punaḥ dagdhāḥ santrāsitā hīnā malināstu tiraskṛtāḥ

vṛddhā bālāstathā srastāḥ prauḍhā yauvanagarvitāḥ aṃśakena vihīnāśca khaṇḍaśaḥ śatadhā kṛtāḥ siddhimokṣapradāḥ sarve sādhakena niyojitāḥ tattat sidhyatyanāyāsād yonimudrānibandhanāt tato'dhikārī tantre'smin bhavet sādhakasattamaḥ nā'sau lipyati pāpena yonimudrānibandhanāt kṛtvā pāpasahasrāṇi asaṃkhyātāni sarvadā duṣṭamantrāśca sidhyanti mantrāścānye tu kiṃ punaḥ sthānadhyānaviniryuktāḥ susiddhā api vairiṇaḥ sakalaṃ niṣkalaṃ sūkṣmaṃ tathā sakalaniṣkalam sakalaṃ brahmabandhasthaṃ tadūrdhvaṃ viddhi niṣkalam bindusthitaṃ kalābhinnaṃ kalātītaṃ tadūrdhvataḥ eṣu sthānaṅgatā mantrāḥ sthānasthāḥ parikīrttitāḥ dhyānasthāścaiva te mantrā vijñeyāḥ sādhakena vā yasya yatra dṛḍhā bhaktirjāyate satataṃ yadi athātaḥ sarvavidyānāṃ likhyate siddhikāraṇam catuṣpathe vā nadyāṃ vā vaṭamūle triśūlake sindūreṇa likhed yantraṃ vipulaṃ sādhyadarbhitam tarpayitvā tadantaḥsthaṃ prajapenniśicārataḥ rātrau puṇyagṛhe caiva udyāne vā surālaye tataḥ pūrvoktarūpeṇa kulakṣobhaṃ samācaret pīṭhānāṃ paramaṃ pīṭhaṃ kāmarūpaṃ mahāphalam vihāya sarvapīṭhāni tasya dehe vasecchivā yatra koṭigaṇaiḥ sārdhamādyā vasati mardinī yato devyaśca devāśca munayaścaiva bhāvajāḥ

dvividhaṃ caiva tatpīṭhaṃ guptaṃ vyaktaṃ sadā paśau vyaktaṃ sarvatra deveśa labhyate kulasundaraiḥ athavā'nyaprakāreṇa kathyate sādhanaṃ mahat upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhistāṃ sampūjya vidhānataḥ mantraṃ vilikhya yathoktaṃ pūjayet kulavartmanā mahābhāgāṃ tato mūladevīmāvaraṇaiḥ saha tatra pīṭhe yoganidrāṃ pūjayitvā tato yajet kāmarūpaṃ tato gatvā tatra kātyāyanīṃ yajet tato jālandhare gatvā pūrṇeśīṃ prathamaṃ yajet tataḥ pūrṇagiriṃ gatvā yajeccaṇḍīṃ samāhitaḥ sindūrabindupīṭhe ca kāmākhyāṃ prathamaṃ yajet evaṃ pīṭheśvarīṃ japtvā pūjayediṣṭadevatām saṃkhyāpūrvaṃ tataḥ pṛcchenmahādevī kulottamam tataḥ praṇamya deveśīṃ vṛṇuyādvaramuttamam akṣobhitaḥ kulācāraparicaryāparo bhavet tataḥ prasannā bhavati saiva kulavarapriyā tato dhyātvā nyasedādau mātṛkāntarasañjñakam akārādikṣakārāntamekaikakramayogataḥ mūrddhādicaraṇāntañca tasmānmūrddhāvasānakam dhyāyet kālīṃ mahādaityayuddharāgamahonmukhīm vāme śaṅkhaṃ tathā carma dhanustarjanameva ca pitāmbaradharāṃ devīṃ pīnonnatakucadvayām evaṃ dhyātvā mahādevīṃ mānasairupacārakaiḥ tataḥ so'haṃ vibhāvyātha puṣpaṃ niḥkṣipya mastake kṛtvā ca pūrvavadvīraḥ sadāśivaṃ yajettataḥ

yantramadhye samāvāhya mūlena parikalpitām sampūjya ca mahādevīṃ pūjayettadanantaram śāktaṃ japtvā ca gurvādīn nāradañca tato yajet durgā ca prathamā jñeyā dvitīyā varavarṇinī kṛttikā pañcamī proktā ṣaṣṭhī caivābhayapradā āyudhāni dalāgreṣu yādibhiḥ kramato yajet tadastrāṇi bahirjaptvā tarpayittvā vidhānataḥ tarpayitvā mahādevīṃ mantrajāpaṃ samācaret kulācārasya saṃsiddhyai bhuktimuktisusiddhaye aṣṭākṣarī samākhyātā vidyā mahiṣamardinī na kasmaicit pravaktavyā kathitā siddhikāriṇī tadāṣṭavargā dātavyā saphalaṃ tasya sādhanam vadhūbījādikāṃ vāpi kavacādyāṃ japettadā vāgbhavādyāṃ japet tāṃ tu devīṃ vākyaviśuddhaye etatpūrvasthitā devī surasiddhividhāyinī gurūṇāṃ kulanāthānāṃ māyāpāśavimocinī aṣṭalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ taddaśāṃśaṃ hunettataḥ yathāśakti japaṃ kṛtvā samāpyātha stutiṃ paṭhet bhaktebhyo varade devi mahiṣaghni namo'stute karālavadane śyāme namaste surasundari raktamāṃsasamākīrṇavadane tvāṃ namāmyaham visarjanaṃ vidhāyātha prayogañca tataścaret athātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi dūtīyajanamuttamam yasmāt kṣipraṃ bhavet siddhirnānyathā janmakoṭibhiḥ kiṃ japanyāsavidhinā dhyānapūjādivistaraiḥ

gandharvarūpavān bhūtvā yonau sampūjya sādhakaḥ trikoṇeṣu trayo devā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ tatra vidyāṃ jagaddhātrīṃ kulāmṛtaiḥ kulakramāt tatra yatra kriyate pūjā japaṃ vā tarpaṇaṃ punaḥ yuvatīyonimāsthāya sarvasiddhirbhavedyataḥ sarvālaṅkārasaṃyukto raktavastravibhūṣitaḥ svakalpoktaṃ prakurvīta nyāsādikaṃ susādhakaḥ arghyapātre pratiṣṭhānaṃ kāryaṃ hetujalena ca puṣpānyakāryamadhye ca uparyupari pūjayet ādhāraśaktiṃ kūrmañca tathānantavarāhakam keśarāṇi ca sampūjya karṇikāyāṃ yajettataḥ apūrvān pūjayedetān sādhakaḥ siddhihetave pūjayitvā tataścaiva gururūpān samarcayet sadanuṣṭhānaniratāṃ sāttvikībhaktisaṃyutām cāturyaudāryadākṣiṇyakaruṇādiguṇānvitām manogṛhītaviśvāsāṃ yadvā saṅketamāgatām viliptāṃ raktavastreṇa raktagandhavibhūṣitām sudhūpairdhūpitāṃ tanvīṃ dūtīkarmaṇi yojayet tasya gātre svakalpoktaṃ nyāsajālaṃ vidhāya ca japtvā ca hūnikāmadhye prasūnaiśca sugandhibhiḥ samākīrṇe suparyaṅke pūjayet kulanāyikām baṭukaṃ gaṇapaṃ durgāṃ kṣetrapālaṃ tathaiva ca trikoṇe pūjayenmūrdhni kāmeśīṃ tasya madhyage trikoṇe pūjayitvā tu vasantaṃ madanaṃ tathā dakṣapādādimūrdhāntaṃ vāmamūrdhādikaṃ tathā

śraddhā prītīratiścaiva dūtiḥ kāntirmanoramā mohinī dīpanī caiva śoṣaṇī caiva śaṅkarī ṣoḍaśasvarasaṃyuktā etāḥ kāmakalā yajet ṛddhiḥ saumyā marīciśca tathā caivāṃśumālinī tathā tuṣṭāmṛte caiva kalāḥ somasya ṣoḍaśa tasyāstu madanāgāre pūjayed bhagamālinīm athodari bhagānte ca bhagamāle bhagāvahe sarvabhagavaśaṅkari bhagarūpe tataḥ param bhagāni me hyānayānte varade'tha samālikhet kledaya drāvayā'moghe bhagavicce tataḥ param sattvān bhageśvari brūyāt vāgbhavaṃ blūṃ jamādikam sarvāṇi bhagāni me vaśamānaya coddharet bhagamālāñca nityāñca ṅeyutāṃ manumuddharet sarvānandamaye madhye cakrarājaṃ samarcayet tatrāpyāvāhanaṃ nāsti jīvanyāsaṃ tathaiva ca tārañca bhuvaneśānīṃ tripurāyāstrayaṃ tataḥ anena manunā mantrī svaliṅge pūjayecchivam nivṛttiñca pratiṣṭhāṃ ca vidyāṃ śāntiṃ tataḥ param samagravidyāmuccārya tattrikoṇe prapūjayet sarvasaṅkṣobhaṇīṃ mudrāṃ baddhvā yoniṃ vicālayet tarjanyau daṇḍavat kṛtvā madhyamoparyanāmike kṣobhayedathavā mantrī gajahastākhyamudrayā niḥkṣipedaṅgulīḥ sarvā gajatuṇḍākṛtiryathā uccaredbhagamālāñca drāviṇībījamuccaran rajomayaṃ rajaḥ sākṣāt saṃvideva na saṃśayaḥ

śivaśaktisamāyogo yoga eva na saṃśayaḥ āliṅganañca kastūrī karpūraṃ cumbanaṃ bhavet līlādikaṃ dhūpadīpaṃ kucamardaṃ śivārcanam kuladravyeṇa saṃśodhya śivaśaktimayo bhavet kuṇḍe triguṇasampanne śrībindunilaye pare viviktuḥ kutsanaparo jāyate gurutalpagaḥ tarpayitvā mahādevīṃ śaktaye dakṣiṇāṃ dadet trividhaṃ tripurāyāśca kathitaṃ pūjanaṃ mahat tadā suvistaraiḥ stavaiḥ sarvāṇi pariśodhayet aśvamedhādiyajñādau vājihatyā kathaṃ bhavet paiṣṭībhavaṃ dhānyabhavaṃ tathā cakravinirmitam mādakaṃ dharmasañchedāt varjyamāhurmanīṣiṇiḥ brahmahatyāsurāpānasvarṇasteyādipātakān vicārayet sadā sarvaṃ sattarkeṇa susādhakaḥ mīnaṃ na bhuñjate hanta vidhavā tat kathaṃ payaḥ jalaṃ jalacaraṃ viddhi ghaṭapūrṇaṃ samānayet anāmiṣaṃ nāsti kiñcit sarvaṃ kṣīrādikaṃ tathā sarvabhūteṣu vijñānaṃ tathā jñeyaṃ susādhakaiḥ tatkāṣṭhaṃ dahyate tena tathā brahmamayaṃ jagat yajñayuktasya nānyasya anyathā pātakaṃ bhavet dharmādharmaparijñānāt saṃskārācca pavitratā vicārayenmantravittu bhrāntireva na saṃśayaḥ kathaṃ taddūṣaṇaṃ yena prāpyate paramaṃ padam bindustu paramaṃ dravyaṃ kāyo'yaṃ śivarūpakaḥ pṛthivyāpastato vāyurākāśaṃ candrasūryakau

pitṛtastrīṇi jāyante majjāsthisnāyureva ca ṣāṭkauṣikamidaṃ proktaṃ śarīraṃ paramarṣibhiḥ śarīraṃ yadi śuddhaṃ syāttadā tatra na dūṣaṇam tataḥ pavitraṃ dehasya kāraṇaṃ kena dūṣyate savikalpo yadi bhavet pāpabhāgjāyate naraḥ nānājīvamayaṃ tattu purīṣaṃ kena dūṣyate tenodakena yajjātaṃ mūtraṃ kena ca dūṣitam male mūtre ca yo doṣo bhrāntireva na saṃśayaḥ tato vicārya matimān sādhakastarkaśodhitaḥ pūjyapūjakabhedaśca mithyaiva paramārthataḥ sarvaṃ brahmamayaṃ viddhi sattarkeṇa sasādhakaḥ tarpayitvā mahādevīṃ śaktyā yaddakṣiṇāṃ dadet vakṣye'haṃ sarvaśāktānāṃ dūtīyajanamuttamam saṃsthāpya tatra śaktiñca pūrvavadapi pūjayet pūjayecca tatastasyāṃ pañca kāmān samāhitaḥ kāma bījañca kandarpa manmathañca tataḥ param praṇavādinamo'ntañca krameṇa gandhapuṣpakaiḥ vaṭukaṃ bhairavaṃ caiva durgāñca kṣetrapālakam mahāpretāsanaṃ madhye bālāmeva prapūjayet durgāṃ bhruvostathā lakṣmīṃ rasanāyāṃ sarasvatīm mukhe sudhānidhiṃ pṛṣṭhe glūṃ bījānantaroditam pūjyāḥ kāmakalāstasyāḥ nāyikā'ṅgeṣu sarvaśaḥ bhūtiḥ kāntirmanojñā ca vimalā modinī tathā dīpanī śoṣaṇī caiva vaśaṅkarī tathā punaḥ tataścandrakalāḥ pūjyā āśiraścaraṇāvadhi

ṛddhiśca saumyā marīcirbahumāyā tataḥ param tuṣṭistathā'mṛtā caiva pūjyāścandrakalā imāḥ bhagamālāmanuṃ procya pūjayettadanantaram jaṃ blūñcaiva tataḥ klinne sarvāṇīti tato vadet strīṃ sphrīṃ kledinī bījaṃ klīṃ klīṃ ca tataḥ param pūjayitvā tataścakraṃ nijadevīṃ tato yajet dhūpairdīpaiśca naivedyairvividhaiḥ kulasādhakaḥ arcayed gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ svaśivaṃ tadanantaram namaḥ śabdaṃ tataḥ paścāt śivāyeti tato vadet nivṛttiñca pratiṣṭhāṃ ca vidyāṃ ca tadanantaram samagravidyāmuccārya trikoṇaṃ caiva pūjayet vajreśvarīkālike ca tathā dikkaravāsinīm tadanujñāṃ tato labdhvā bhuktvā tāmbūlamuttamam prajapet kṣobharahitaścāṣṭottarasahasrakam japānte tajjapaṃ devyai samarpya tadanantaram galaccandradravaṃ tasmād gṛhītvā tarpayecchivām visarjanaṃ vidhāyātha śaktiñca paritoṣayet evaṃ yajanamātreṇa mantrasiddhirna saṃśayaḥ samprāpya divasaṃ pūrvadevīñca vidhivadbhage tasya lakṣmīrmahāvidyā bhavecca bhuvi durlabhā āmantrya vidhivadyoniṃ tatraiva yoginīṃ yajet ṣaṭsahasraṃ divārātrau japtvā mantramananyadhīḥ athātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi prakārāntaramuttamam bhagādyairbhagamāmantrya bhage bhagavatīṃ tataḥ dvilakṣeṇa mahāvāgmī trilakṣeṇa mahākaviḥ

vāksiddhiśca bhavettasya pañcalakṣapramāṇataḥ saptalakṣeṇa vīrendro jīvanmukto bhavennaraḥ vidhivacchaktimāsādya sādhakaḥ sthiramānasaḥ rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā haviṣyāśī jitendriyaḥ jāyate mantrasiddhistu nātra kāryā vicāraṇā athavā viṣuve caiva māsāntapakṣayorapi śmaśāne vā yathāśaktyā gurorvā śivasannidhau likhanañca prakurvīta kuṅkumāgurucandanaiḥ sampūjya vidhivad bhaktyā sādhakaḥ sthiramānasaḥ lakṣamekaṃ tadūrdhvaṃ vā daśabhirhomamācaret paritoṣya guruṃ paścānmantrasiddhiśca jāyate lakṣmīstasya sadā gehe vāṇī vaktre suniścitam athavānyaprakāreṇa dūtīyajanamuttamam vastrālaṅkaraṇaṃ caiva dattvā tasyai yathocitam padmaṃ bhūmau samālikhya ṣaṭkoṇāntargataṃ likhet tatastāṃ gandhapuṣpādyairnānopahāravistaraiḥ tasyā gātre nyasenmantraṃ pañcabāṇān krameṇa tu dīkṣayitvā tanmūlena devībuddhyā yajettataḥ yonau kāmeśvarīṃ caiva nābhau vajreśvarīṃ tataḥ yoniṃ sadā'kṣatāṃ kṛtvā japedvidyāṃ tataḥ parām śaktimānīya vidhivat pūjayedyonimaṇḍale bhaginīṃ bhagajihvāñca bhagāsyāṃ bhagamālinīm bhagastanīṃ bhagāṅgīñca bhagasthāṃ bhagasarpiṇīm vāgbhavaṃ kāmabījañca kamalābījameva ca pūjayitvā tataḥ paścānmūlamantraṃ japettataḥ

sarvaśāstrārthavettā ca sarvagaḥ sarvavit prabhuḥ yoṣitāṃ yonimāsthāya sarvasiddhirna saṃśayaḥ itthaṃ pūjāvidhiṃ kṛtvā sarvasiddhiyuto bhavet aiśvaryamatulaṃ prāpya vaśīkuryājjagattrayam rākṣasairmanujairnityaṃ pūjyo bhavati sādhakaḥ ante ca ramate devyā sākṣāt smaraharopamaḥ sarvapāpavinirmukto ramet kalpāyutaṃ bhuvi atulāṃ śriyamāpnoti sa gacchetpārvatīpadam bhojayedyuvatīṃ yastu sa bhavet pṛthivīpatiḥ sa bhavet sādhakaśreṣṭho mātṝṇāñca bhavet priyaḥ tadā tadā prapūjyeta devīṃ dhyātvā yathāvidhi etattu sarvabhūtānāṃ tantrāṇāṃ gopitaṃ bhuvi nirvikalpastu mantrajño bhaved vai sādhakaḥ sadā dīkṣitasyā'dhikāro'tra nānyasyaiva kadācana amṛtatrayasaṃyogāt duṣṭamantro'pi sidhyati tryamṛtena puṭīkṛtya yo mantraṃ bhajate'cirāt pañcahrasvā sandhivarṇā vyomerāgnijalandharā pañca vargākṣarāṇi syurvāntaṃ śvetendubhiḥ saha puraścaryādibhirmantro yadi siddho bhavenna hi drāvaṇaṃ bodhanaṃ vaśyaṃ pīḍanaṃ poṣaśoṣaṇam vāruṇenaiva bījena grathanaṃ kārayenmanum uṣīrarocanākhyābhirmantraṃ saṃgrathitaṃ likhet pūjanājjapanādarcanād drāvitaḥ siddhido manuḥ sārasvatena bīje sampuṭīkṛtya taṃ japet āraktacandanaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ haridrā madanaṃ śilā

dhāryaṃ kaṇṭhe na cet siddhiḥ pīḍanaṃ tasya kārayet dhyāyettu devatāṃ tadvattadadhottararūpiṇīm tathā bhūtena mantreṇa homaṃ kāryaṃ dine dine bālāyāstritayaṃ bījamādyante tasya yojayet poṣito'yaṃ bhavet siddho na cet kurvīta śoṣaṇam eṣā vidyā gale dhāryā likhitā śavabhasmanā āgneyena tu bījena mantrasyaikaikamakṣaram brahmavṛkṣasya tailena mantramālikhya dhārayet evaṃ krameṇa kurvīta puraścaraṇamuttamam mantrasiddhirbhavedyena puraścaryādibhirvinā kṣapayati duradṛṣṭaṃ vādirāḍ jāyate saḥ madhumatirapi heyaḥ kiṃpunaḥ siddhisaṅghāḥ manupuṭitapaṭīyān sādhayet śāntacetāḥ racita yuvativeśastaddhiyā dhyāyate saḥ svayamapi racitāṅgaḥ kṣobhakṛdyoginīnām manupuṭitavimṛgyaṃ yojayettadbahiryaḥ stava caraṇatalāntardhūlijālairviśālaiḥ tadanu kaṭhinabījaṃ lokadhātrīṃ tadantaḥ śivabhṛgumadapṛthvīśaktiyuktaṃ susiddhaṃ hariharacaturāsyasvasvabhūtiprasūtam bhuvanabhayavināśaḥ kṣobhiṇīṃ yojayitvā smaraharaharirūpī kāmarūpaḥ kuberaḥ bhajati yadi gurūṇāṃ varṇamūlaṃ vimṛgyam tadupari mṛgacihnaṃ dvandvametat bhavānyāḥ tava samanaya yuktaṃ bījamanyad bhavānyāḥ bhajati janani yuṣmatpādapadmotthabhaktyā

likhitamapi svabuddhyā prāpya kasmādakasmāt tadapi yadi vidadhyāddigyutaṃ dantavarṇam trijagati kimihāste kleśalabhyaṃ kathañcit vipina bhuvi ca madhye kautukān māṃ manuṣyaḥ iti śrīmajjñānānandaparamahaṃsaviracite kaulāvalīnirṇaye saptadaśollāsaḥ akasmāt saṃlabhed gandhaṃ dhūpasya kusumasya vā svapne vṛṣaṃ gajāśvaṃ vā yadvā'rohati sādhakaḥ svapne vā jāyate yoṣidvṛndaiḥ sammilanaṃ niśi rājñāṃ tathā'ṅganānāñca darśanaṃ nṛtyagītayoḥ rathaṃ vā taraṇiṃ vāpi svapneṣvārohayettu yaḥ dhvajañca pratimāṃ caiva rājānaṃ rudhiraṃ tathā madirālokanaṃ māṃsaṃ striyaṃ vā cāruhāsinīm labhedvā bhakṣayedvā'pi sparśayedvā kadācana caragoruṇitamvāyā vakṣojamukhapaṅkajam teṣāṃ prasādaḥ snehañca vātsalyaṃ priyadarśanam yadi bhāgyavaśāccaiva kuladṛṣṭistu jāyate akālapanasaṃ caiva bhakṣaṇaṃ darśanaṃ tathā paramānnabhakṣaṇañca śoṇitañca viśeṣataḥ sādhakaṃ dravyarūpañca devatāṃ vā prapaśyati siddhidravyaṃ śavaṃ caiva vasanābharaṇādikam siddhaḥ so'pi bhavet satyaṃ saṃśayo nāsti niścitam pīṭhādigamanaṃ tatra devatādarśanaṃ tathā bālakaṃ bhikṣukaṃ caiva phalādīnāṃ tu lolupam manasā bhāvite kārye śaṅkhādidhvanirutsavaḥ ajñātajanasamvādo naṣṭadravyodayaṃ tathā

kṣudrasya mahatī pūjā sukṛtī ca kṛtastutiḥ mantralābhastathā svapne gurūṇāṃ duhitustathā asugandhiḥ sugandhiśca śraddhā puṣpodbhavastathā iti vijñāya vīrendraḥ prayogañca samācaret kṛṣṇavarṇabhaṭaṃ svapne prahārastena melanam rājyakṣobhavahnivāyujantubhirvadhadarśanam anyamantrārcane śraddhā svadevārcananindanam gaṇeśaṃ vaṭukaṃ paścāt kṣetreśaṃ yoginīstathā kumāraṃ baṭukaṃ bhadraṃ lakṣmīṃ sucārunāyakam pūjayitvā vidhānena baliṃ paścānnivedayet athātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi kāmyaprayogamuttamam pūjayitvā mahārātrau tridinaṃ prajapenmanum vetālapādukāsiddhiṃ khaṅgasiddhintathaiva ca kulāgāraṃ puṣpitāyā dṛṣṭvā yo japate naraḥ kevalaṃ guptabhāvena sa tu vidyānidhirbhavet vaśamāyānti te sarve sādhakasya na cānyathā prajapya cā'yutaṃ prājñaḥ etadeva phalaṃ labhet prajaped yo bhavet sadyo vidyāyāvallabhaḥ svayam gadyapadyamayī vāṇī sabhāyāṃ tasya jāyate tannāmnā sudhiyaḥ sarve praṇamanti mudānvitāḥ athavā dhanakāmastu mahadaiśvaryakāmukaḥ aṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā kulamāmantrya tattvavit athavā hastamāropya sthiradhīḥ pūtamānasaḥ pṛthvīmṛtumatīṃ vīkṣya sahasraṃ yadi nityaśaḥ mahācīnakrame devīṃ dhyātvā devīṃ prapūjayet

sa bhavet kuladevaśca kuladrumagataḥ śuciḥ tatsudhādhārasāreṇa tarpayenmātṛkānane cāmaraṃ ravivimbañca tilapuṣpaṃ sarovaram mukhaprasādaṃ suvacaḥ sulocanaṃ suhāsyakam labhate ca yathāsaṃkhyaṃ sādhakaḥ sthiramānasaḥ tasyāpi ṣoḍaśāṃśena phalaṃ nārhanita te śavāḥ latārateṣu japtavyaṃ mahāpātakamuktaye latābhāve samutsārya svaśukraṃ sādhakottamaḥ iti cīnakrameṇaiva tārā śīghraphalapradā mahācīnakrameṇaiva kālikā phaladāyiṇī tāsāntu samatā jñeyā guptasādhanasādhane tāsāṃ tu samatā jñeyā guptasādhanasādhane mahācīnakrameṇaiva chinnamastā tu siddhidā yathā kālī tathā tārā yathā bālā tathonmukhī yathā'sau tripurā bālā tathā tripurabhairavī anyā yā yā mahāvidyā tathā bhavati niścitam etatyantrañca mantrañca putrebhyo'pi na darśayet athātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi kāmyasādhanamuttamam āmantrayettataḥ paścāt pañcaviṃśatisaṃkhyayā tadambupānato mantrī vāgmī drutaṃ kavirbhavet kāmyakarttā mahāvāgmī bhavet śrutidharā naraḥ sarvajñatāṃ labhedvīro nātra kāryā vicāraṇā pradīpakalikākāraṃ jihvāyāṃ mūlamantrakam trimāsādūrdhvato mantrī pūrvavat phalamāpnuyāt prātareva hi japtavyamaṣṭottarasahasrakam

balidānādikaṃ sarvaṃ vidhāya pūrvavad budhaḥ japedayutasaṅkhyaṃ tu sarvakāmārthasiddhaye sahasraṃ devīmabhyarcya śmaśāne sādhakottamaḥ svagātrarudhirāktaiśca bilvapatraiḥ sahasraśaḥ śmaśānaśayano vīraḥ śavāsanagataḥ śuciḥ kavirvāgmī dhanī dakṣaḥ sarvayoṣitpriyaḥ sukhī kṣudraviṭcuarabhūtāni devīṃ dhyātvā vināśayet aṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā sādhako labhate śriyam śmaśāne'bhyarcya devīntu sarvasiddhiṃ tu vindati sukhī syānnātra sandeho mahākālavaco yathā raktacandanadigdhāṅgīṃ raktapuṣpairalaṃkṛtām mantraṃ proccārayettatra ne ga ve ge śa liṃ pra bha pūjayitvā tatra devīṃ yo vai dhyāyecca devatām aṣṭamyāñca caturdaśyāṃ pūjayitvā yathāvidhi candanañcā'rkakusumaṃ tathā śvetāparājitām aṣṭottaraśataṃ jāpyaṃ yāvajjīvanasaṃkhyayā prātaḥ snānarato mantrīṃ nityamaṣṭottaraṃ śatam anena vidhinā mantrī grahakṣudraripūn jayet svakalpoktaṃ vidhāyā'tha sādhako vijitendriyaḥ vivāde japakāle vā yatkiñcit kulasādhane rātrau prapūjayed gehe sthitvā padātmikāṃ parām ehi mātarjagaddhātri sañcāre caraṇākule evaṃ nimantrayitvā tu saptavārān susaṃyataḥ tato vīkṣeccakrarājaṃ sādhakaḥ sthiramānasaḥ sādhakābhimukhaṃ cihnaṃ ubhayoryadi caikataḥ

viparītaphalaṃ dadyādviparīte suniścitam viparītaphalaṃ tattu viparītañca niścitam athātaḥ pādukāmantraṃ kathayāmi samāsataḥ sarvabhūte mahāśaktiḥ pādāgre yā sthitā yataḥ ādyantarahitā devī pādukādisvarūpiṇī svatantreyaṃ mahāvidyā na prakāśyā kadācana sṛṣṭikrameṇa deveśīmahāsṛṣṭipravarttinī brahmaviṣṇusvarūpā sā mahādevasvarūpiṇī ante kṣetreṇa siddhiḥ syāccheṣe gandharvayonayaḥ pādukā paramā vidyā saptākṣarasamanvitā kathiteyaṃ mahāvidyā yatnād gopyā sadaiva hi etattantrañca mantrañca prayogañca tathā param anyathā pretarājasya bhavanaṃ yāti niścitam iti śrīmajjñānānandaparamahaṃsaviracite kaulāvalīnirṇaye aṣṭādaśollāsaḥ śāntivaśyastambhanāni vidveṣoccāṭane tataḥ rogakṛtyā grahādīnāṃ nirāsaḥ śāntirīritā pravṛttirodhaḥ sarveṣāṃ stambhanaṃ tadudāhṛtam sadvidyāsiddhikālādīn jñātvā karmāṇi sādhayet rātrāveva prayogādau śivāyai ca susiddhaye uccāṭane smṛto vāyurbhūyo'gnirmāraṇe mataḥ pītā bhūmiḥ pañcabhūta rūpametadudīritam trikoṇaṃ svastikopetaṃ vahnerardhendusaṃyutam tattadbhūtasamābhāni maṇḍalāni vidurbudhāḥ śabdasparśarūparasagandhā bhūtaguṇāḥ smṛtāḥ tiryak saṃspṛśi mārutasya paritaḥ spṛṣṭe marudvartmanaḥ

rvāyoḥ śāntikanirviṣīkaraṇayorvyomno hi taścodayaḥ yantraṃ kuryāt rocanayā guṇḍikayā haridrayā śītāṃśusalilakṣauṇīvyomavāyuhavirbhujām vaśyādau lekhanī dūrvā ākarṣe śikhipucchikā ratirvāṇī ramā jyeṣṭhā durgā kālī yathākramāt athātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi ṣaṭkarmakāla nirṇayam budhejyaravisaṃyuktā śāntikarmaṇi pūjitā navamī pauṣṭike śastā aṣṭamī navamī tathā ākarṣaṇe tvamāvasyā navamī pratipattathā kṛṣṇā caturdaśī tadvadaṣṭamī mandavārakāḥ caturdaśyaṣṭamī kṛṣṇā tvamāvāsyā tathaiva ca budhacandradinopetā pañcamī daśamī tathā śubhagrahodaye kuryāt śubhāni ca śubhodaye īśaścandrendranir-ṛtivāyvagnīnāṃ diśo matāḥ ṛtavaḥ syurvasantādyā ahorātraṃ dine dine hemantaḥ śāntike prokto vasanto vaśyakarmaṇi prāvṛḍuccāṭane jñeyaḥ śaranmāraṇa karmaṇi vaśye ca stambhane śastā gajacarmaṇi dveṣake mahiṣāśvayorvā carmaṇi sādhayet sādhakottamaḥ vajraṃ bhadrakamityāhurāsanāni manīṣiṇaḥ ūrvorupari vīrendraḥ kṛtvā pādatale ubhe pūjājapavidhānena aṅguṣṭhaṃ dhāraṇañcaret ṛjukāyaḥ sukhāsīnaḥ svastikaṃ tat pracakṣate etadvā svastikaṃ proktaṃ savye nyasyetaraṃ karam niveśya bhūmau saṃsthāpya romasthaḥ kukkuṭāsanaḥ

pārśvapādau ca pāṇibhyāṃ dṛḍhaṃ baddhvā suniścalaḥ ūrvoḥ pādau kramānnyasya jānvoḥ pratyammukhāṅgulau muṣalāśanikhaḍgādyāḥ śāntikādiṣu karmasu talāntamilitāṅguṣṭhau kṛtvaiṣā padmamudrikā saṃyojyāṅguṣṭhakāgrābhyāṃ tarjanyagre kṣipettataḥ anyonyābhimukhau hastau kṛtvā ca grathitāṅgulau gadāmudreyamākhyātā vidvadbhiḥ parikīrttitā kuryānmuṣalamudreyaṃ sarvavighnavināśinī kaniṣṭhāṃ madhyamāṃ caiva jyeṣṭhāṅguṣṭhena ca kramāt kaniṣṭhānāmikāṃ baddhvā sāṅguṣṭhenaiva saṃyutā sitaraktapītamiśrā kṛṣṇadhūmrā prakīrttitāḥ yadvarṇadevatā yatra tadvarṇañcopahāraṇam mantreṇāntaritān kuryānmāraṇāni yathāvidhi yogaḥ pallava ityete vinyāsāḥ ṣaṭsu karmasu grathanaṃ tadvijānīyāt praśastaṃ śāntikarmaṇi vidarbha eva vijñeyo mantribhirvaśyakarmaṇi eṣa syāt stambhane śasta ityukto mantravedibhiḥ vidveṣasya vidhāne tu praśasto nyāsa uttamaḥ ante nāmno bhavenmantraḥ pallavo māraṇe smṛtaḥ śāntikarmaṇi miśraṃ vā japenmantrasya siddhaye mantratulyāṅgamaṇibhirjapedākṛṣṭakarmaṇi akṣamālāṃ samālokya vidveṣoccāṭane japet kṛtvā'kṣamālāṃ japtavyaṃ śatrumāraṇamicchatā anāmikāmadhyabhāge mālāṃ saṃsthāpya sādhakaḥ tarjanyāṅguṣṭhayogena vidveṣoccāṭayorjapet

mātṛkayā'thavā kuryād yathātantravidhānataḥ athavānyaprakāreṇa kathyate sādhanaṃ mahat tatpārśve sādhyamālikhya tāḍayed divyadṛṣṭibhiḥ gorocanādibhirdravyaiḥ svīyacandraṃ samālikhet jvalantīṃ nāmasahitāṃ kāmabījavidarbhitām adṛṣṭapūrvā sā śaktiḥ drutamāyāti durlabhā āyāti sādhakaṃ samyak mantramūḍhā satī śubhā udyatsūryasahasrābhamātmānamaruṇaṃ tathā anena kramayogena yuvā kandarparūpavān sarvaraktopacārastu mudrānihitavigrahaḥ sa bhaveddāsavat satyaṃ dhaneśo vāpi vākpatiḥ adṛṣṭā vā satī vāpi yogamudrādharā'pi vā nāginīmapsarāṃ vāpi gandharvīṃ vā surāṅganām madanodbhavasantāpāṃ sphurajjaghanasustanīm mahākāmakalādhyānāt sādhakaḥ sthiramānasaḥ rocanābhāgamekaṃ tu bhāgamekaṃ tu kuṅkumam ekatra tilakaṃ kuryāt trilokavaśakārakam rājānaṃ nagaraṃ grāmaṃ yatkiṃcidanyaducyate yonipuṣpairliṅgapuṣpairmiśrīkṛtya ca sādhakaḥ rahasyasthānake mantrī likhedrocanayā bhuvi pratimāṃ sundarīṃ ramyāṃ vilikhya sumanoharām yasyā nāma mahāvidyāmaṅkuśāntarvidarbhitam bindunādakalākrāntamaṅkuśaṃ parikīrttitam svarāntaṃ pṛthivīsaṃsthaṃ ratibindusamanvitam nīladāḍimbapuṣpābhaṃ cintayeddehasandhiṣu

mudrāṃ tu kṣobhiṇīṃ baddhvā mantramaṣṭaśataṃ japet tato'pyadhikasarvāṅgīṃ kāmabāṇaiḥ supīḍitām evamākarṣayennārīṃ yojanānāṃ śatairapi aṣṭamīrātrimārabhya caturdaśyāṃ samāpayet tāmbūlapūritamukho muktakeśo jitendriyaḥ gandhacandanapuṣpaistu digvāsāḥ kulabhūṣaṇaḥ sā samāyāti kāmārttā yatra devaḥ sa pūjakaḥ vāmabhāge samāsīnaṃ raktavastravibhūṣitam sarvaśṛṅgāraveśāḍhyaṃ sphuraccakitalocanam lalāṭe mantramālikhya sādhyanāmavidarbhitam tāmbūlapūritamukhaḥ kulaṃ tadabhisaṃhitam yannāmnā likhitaṃ yantraṃ tāñca nayati tatkṣaṇāt dvīpāntarasahasreṣu rakṣitāṃ nigaḍādibhiḥ nitambavimbaviddhvastasphurajjaghanamaṇḍalām kavāṭalohasannaddhapūrikāvivarāntare evamākṛṣṭisiddhiścet sādhakaḥ kauliko bhavet rātrau vīravaro vāpi divyo vā sādhakottamaḥ vilikhya mālinīṃ devīmāraktavasanojjvalām maṇinā sādhyanāmānaṃ vilikhya tasya madhyataḥ kāmarājena saṃyuktāṃ devaṃ dhyātvā susādhakaḥ yannāmnā dīyate caiva sā vaśyaṃ pratipadyate yoginyo'psarasaścāpi ke pare narakiṅkarāḥ iti cet jñāyate lokaistadā bhraṣṭo bhaviṣyati anayākṛṣṭikarmajña iti cet pratipadyate yadi svapnāvatīṃ vidyāṃ sādhakaḥ sthiramānasaḥ

japtvā vighnaṃ kadāciddhi pathi tasya na vidyate niḥsaṅgena sadā kuryāt kulākṛṣṭiṃ viśeṣataḥ jalamadhye ca durmārge ārāme vā śmaśānake aṣṭottarasahasraṃ tu yo japtvā gacchati dhruvam athavā sa sarvakāryeṣu japtvā cāṣṭasahasrakam na ca vighnaṃ tatastatra tatra tatra japāntaram athavā mātṛkāṃ sarvāṃ likhitvā cakrabāhyataḥ sādhyanāmānvitaṃ kṛtvā dhārayedvāmabāhuke athavā mātṛkāyuktāṃ svasañjñāṃ cakramaṇḍitām anena vidhinā vāpi rocanāgurucandanaiḥ sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ vāpi sakalaṃ jalamaṇḍalam kāmarājena bījena mahākāmakalātmanā balirasyā likhedevaṃ veṣṭayenmātṛkākṣaraiḥ śikhāyāmathavā vastre śarīre yatra kutra vā sammohayati rājānaṃ vājinaṃ duṣṭakuñjaram cakravajrāṇi vetālaṃ durdamaṃ rākṣasaṃ tathā yena vīreṇa tatsarvaṃ sa kuryāddāsavadvaśam catuḥsamudraparyantāṃ jvalantīṃ cintayettataḥ dṛṣṭyā'karṣayate lokaṃ dṛṣṭyaiva kurute vaśam dṛṣṭyā karṣati vāgīśaṃ dṛṣṭyā sarvavilocanam etat prapūjanaṃ rātrau cakraṃ sindūramiśritam madhye dikṣu vidikṣvevaṃ yadā devīṃ prapūjayet bhūrjapatre vilikhyaiva rocanāgurukuṅkumaiḥ svanāmadarbhitaṃ kṛtvā yadi bhūmau nidhāpayet dhārayedvāmahastena kaṇṭhe vā bhujamūlake

rocanā kuṅkumāktañca lākṣālaktakasaṃyutam kastūrīdravasaṃyuktaṃ ekīkṛtya tataḥ param tasya vyāghragajavyādhiripusarpaviṣādikam bhayaṃ na vidyate kutra paramañcābhicārakam na śakto hiṃsituṃ tasya romaikamapi sarvathā adhastānnāmasaṃyuktāṃ rocanākuṅkumānvitām tāmbūladhūpamudakaṃ patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ dadhi kastūrīṃ ghusṛṇaṃ cailāṃ lavaṅgaṃ jātipatrakam aṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā yasmai kasmai prayacchati striyaśca sakalā vaśyā dāsībhūtā bhavanti hi pītadravyeṇa saṃlikhya dhārayedindradiggatam sahasravadanaścāpi mūko bhavati niścitam dakṣiṇābhimukho vahnau dagdhvā mārayate'cirāt kṛtvā śarāvamadhyasthaṃ vidviṣṭaṃ sarvajantuṣu nīlakarpaṭake samyak nīlasūtreṇa veṣṭayet dugdhalākṣārocanābhirmahānīlarasena ca anenaiva vidhānena jalamadhye viniḥkṣipet etanmadhyagatāṃ pṛthvīṃ nāgarīṃ vā surāṅganām likhitvā pītavarṇena svīyacakraṃ yadā'rcayet sindūreṇa likheccakraṃ pūjayeduttarāmukhaḥ cakraṃ gairikayā'likhya pūjayet paścimāmukhaḥ dakṣiṇābhimukho bhūtvā nityaṃ cakraṃ yadā'rcayet cakraṃ vahnimukho bhūtvā rātrau sampūjayet sudhīḥ rocanāliptitaṃ cakraṃ dugdhamadhye vaśaṅkaram tailasthaṃ cakrarājaṃ tu vidveṣaṇakaraṃ param

ekāyutaṃ japaṃ kuryāt prayogeṣu ca sādhakaḥ tasmin homaṃ prakurvīta saṃskṛte havyavāhane cūrṇitaṃ juhuyānmantrī saptāhādvaśayejjanān vaśayet sakalān devān gandharvān kiṃ suparṇakān yasya nāmnā sa vaśyaḥ syādanenaiva na saṃśayaḥ jalaṃ pañcāśataṃ dadyādvaśaṃ nayati vāñchitam kūrcalajjādvayaṃ cānte ādyābījaṃ tathaiva ca nāgayajñopavītāñca candrārdhadhṛtamastakām aṣṭottaraśatāmantrya pūrvadravyeṇa sādhakaḥ śatābhimantritaṃ kṛtvā rocanātilakena tu ādye caikaṃ tu bījānāṃ tathaivānte ca ekakam svāhāntaṃ mantramuccārya bhavedākarṣaṇaṃ mahat mahākālāgra āsīnāṃ dhyātvā cākarṣaṇañcaret ākarṣayati mantrajñaḥ kimanyat bhuvi yoṣitaḥ piṅgākṣīṃ kṛṣṇavarṇāñca kartrīkharparadhāriṇīm ante ca ṭhadvayaṃ dattvā prajapenmanumuttamam uccāṭayati piṅgākṣī saṃdrāvayati kekarā vikṣobhayati saṃkṣubdhā sampātayati sannatā yaṃ yaṃ bhāvaṃ jano dhyāyet tatra tatra smaredapi uccāṭanādi sarvatra maithunānte samācaret ulūkakākapakṣaiśca homācchatrūn vināśayet pūrvoktena vidhānena citākāṣṭhahutāśane vidveṣaṇavidhānena anyonyakalahānvitam sahasreṇa pramāṇena kuryāddhomaṃ yathāvidhi kṛṣṇavastreṇa saṃveṣṭya badhnīyāt raktatantubhiḥ

saptāhābhyantare tasya dhruvamuccāṭanaṃ bhavet yannāmnā dīyate tacca so'cirānmṛtyumarhati sahasraṃ parisañjapya niśāyāṃ ravivāsare kṣetre tu śasyahāniḥ syājjavahānisturaṅgame dveṣyadveṣakayornāmni tayordveṣo mahān bhavet puttalīḥ pañca kurvīta sāṅgopāṅgāḥ śubhāḥ samāḥ cakrihastamṛdā'nyā syādanyāmadhumayī tathā prokṣayecca tathā kṣīradadhyājyamadhubhiḥ kramāt kurvīta puttalīṃ saumyāṃ sarvāvayavaśobhitām raktavastradharāṃ śuddhāṃ puttalīṃ dāruṇā kṛtām mṛṇmayīṃ pratimāṃ pādadeśe nyasyettathātmanaḥ lavaṇena kṛtāṃ paścāt pratimāṃ saṃspṛśan japet agnimādāya sandīpya sādhyanakṣatradārubhiḥ kuśītarājidūrvābhirdattvā'rghyaṃ praṇamet sudhīḥ tvarānandana śatrughna niśāyāṃ havyavāhana jātavedo mahādeva taptajāmbūnadaprabha oṃ durge sarvaviparyāsi grastaṃ yuktaṃ tvayā jagat tamomayi mahādevi mahādevasya suvrate oṃ durge durge durgāsi durgasaṃrodhanākule bhadrakāli bhavābhītibhadrasiddhipradāyini prāṇāsiśaktirudrādyairutkramyotkṛtya cānaya sādhyaṃ saṃhṛtya nirvartyaṃ puttalīṃ sādhakottamaḥ prathamo dakṣapādaśca tatkarastadanantaram madhyādūrdhvaṃ pañcamaḥ syādardhoṃ'śaḥ ṣaṣṭha īritaḥ sapta sapta vibhāgo vā prayogeṣu yathāvidhi

yajamāno dhanairdhānyaiḥ prīṇayed gurumātmanaḥ kiṃ punarmanujān bhūpān sadyo'pyasya vimohitāḥ niveśayad yathāpūrvaṃ sādhakendro yathāvidhi varāhapārāvataviṭ tiladrumaiśca rāmaṭhaiḥ snuhikṣīreṇa sampiṣṭaiḥ pūrvoktalavaṇānvitaiḥ japapūjādikaṃ kuryāt prāguktavartmanā sudhīḥ durgāṃ vā bhadrakālīṃ vā samārādhya yathāvidhi vāmaṃ pādaṃ samāruhya dakṣiṇaṃ dhruvamānasaḥ kṛṣṇāṣṭamīṃ samārabhya yāvat kṛṣṇacaturdaśī dvisaptāhaprayogeṇa mārayet ripumātmanaḥ smṛtvā śūladharāṃ devīṃ devāṃśca tatkṣaṇājjayet kulālamṛttikāyāṃ tu pratimāyāṃ hṛdi nyaset vidhāyāgniṃ japenmantramaṣṭottarasaharakam abhyarcya ca tataḥ paścāt tīkṣṇatailena mantravit teṣu sampātayed bhūyaḥ spṛṣṭvā tānyayutaṃ japet prāpnuyānnaṣṭasañjñāyāṃ palāyanaparāyaṇaḥ niḥkṣipet śatrusenāyāṃ gūḍhaṃ rātrisamāgame parasparavirodhena gacchedvigataceṣṭayā sādhyapādarajoyukto homāduccāṭayet ripūn śaptāṃ pratiṣṭhitaprāṇāṃ chedayedaṅgaśaḥ puraḥ kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ śmaśāne havyavāhane unmattasamidhāṃ homānmattāḥ syuḥ śatravaḥ kṣaṇāt juhuyānniśi kāntāre śatru kālātithirbhavet viṣaliptaviliptāṅgīmabhyukṣya nikṣipejjale tarjanītriśikhaṃ dorbhyāṃ dhārayantīṃ bhayaṅkarīm
