mārayedavivādena ripūn bandhusamanvitān dhyātvā mantraṃ japenmantrī pūrvavannāśayedarīn sṛjantīṃ bāṇanivahān dhārayantīṃ ca tarjanīm ripuñca parasenāñca śīghramuccāṭayed dhruvam sādhyanāmāṅkitaṃ kṛtvā śatrusadṛśaputtalīm ekāyutaṃ japaṃ kṛtvā trirātrānmāraṇaṃ bhavet mahājvālā bhavettasya taptatāmraśalākayā kuṇḍalinyā mukhe kṣiptvā vairiṇaṃ sādhakottamaḥ prātareva vibhāvyātha japedayutasaṃkhyakam bhūrjapatre svarṇapatre nimbapatre vilikhya ca vahnipatre riporvidyāṃ likhitvā patrake'male sahasrajanmabhirjaptvā vidyā na hi phalapradā vahnibījaṃ puṭaṃ kṛtvā dṛṣṭyā dagdhvā vicintya ca padmapatre yasya mantraṃ puṭīkṛtya ca dīpanaiḥ vāṅmāyākamalābījaṃ dīpanaṃ parikīrtitam jale ca nikṣipenmantraṃ punarnava itīritaḥ kārayedakṣavṛkṣeṇā'pyedāyudha pañcakam pañcagavyeṣu nikṣipya tāni spṛṣṭvā japenmanum avaṭeṣu ca pūrṇeṣu pañcagavyena sādhakaḥ nivasettasya madhyādi pūjāṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi baliñca vikirettatra teṣāṃ mantrī yathākramāt dīnāṃśca kṛpaṇādīṃśca toṣayed bhojanādibhiḥ yatreyaṃ vihitā rakṣā deśe vā nagare'pi vā agnyutpātādayo doṣā bhūtapretādi saṃyutāḥ nekṣantāṃ tāṃ diśaṃ bhītyā tarjitā devatājñayā

goptavyañca prayatnena nānyathā narakaṃ vrajet dhyāyet kālīṃ karālāsyāṃ sudaṃṣṭrāṃ bhīmalocanām vīrāsanasamāsīnāṃ mahākāloparisthitām muṇḍamālāgaladraktacarcitāṃ pīvarastanīm vāme khaḍgamuṇḍakhaṇḍadhāriṇīṃ dakṣiṇe kare śakuntapakṣisaṃyuktāṃ bālacandravibhūṣitām caṇḍahāsacaṇḍanādacaṇḍasphoṭaiśca bhairavaiḥ sevitāśeṣasiddhaughasevitaiḥ sevitāṃ sadā iti śrīmajjñānānandaparamahaṃsaviracite kaulāvalīnirṇaye ekonaviṃśollāsaḥ bhaumavāre niśīthe ca catuṣpathagato naraḥ svakalpokta vidhānena sampūjya nijadevatām aṣṭottarasahasraṃ tu japtvā stutvā ca sādhakaḥ atha vakṣye ca vetāla siddhiṃ sarvottamottamām bhaumavāre madhyarātrau gatvā kulayugānvitaḥ sahasraṃ homayedvīrastatraiva pitṛkānane kṛtvā durgāṣṭamīrātrau śmaśāne niḥkṣipettataḥ śavāsanagato vīro japedaṣṭasahasrakam spheṃ spheṃ daṇḍa mahābhāga yoginīhṛdayapriya evamāmantrya vetālaṃ yatra yatra prapūjyate gaccha gaccha mahābhāge pāduke varavarṇini evamāmantrya pādukāṃ dadyāt pādatale tataḥ atha vakṣye khaḍgasiddhiṃ sādhakānāṃ hitāya ca kṛtvā tatra mūlamantraṃ likhitvā prajapenmanum tat sahasraṃ tato hutvā mahāśavakalevare kulāṣṭamyāmardharātre citāmadhye samāhitaḥ

madhuratrayasaṃyuktaṃ bilvapatreṇa saṃyutam balyante sā mahāmāyā devī mahiṣamardinī gṛdhravadatiśabdena khaḍgamuttolya dhārayet kāṃ īṃ ūṃ kuru kalyāṇi vipakṣādapi vistaram chittvā chitvā punaśchittvā gato'pyākṛṣyate punaḥ kulamīnaṃ kuladravyaṃ kulamadyaṃ kuleśvaraṃ vidhivat pūjanaṃ kṛtvā sādhakaḥ sthiramānasaḥ bhūmau phūtkāramātreṇa vivaraṃ tatra jāyate tatraiva gamanaṃ tasya bhūtalāntaḥ prasarpiṇaḥ kāyasaṅkocamāsādya gacchatyavikalo naraḥ yādikṣāntaṃ caturbhāge sindūrarajasā likhet pūjayet rātrisamaye kulācārakrameṇa tu evaṃ ṣaṇmāsayogena siddho bhavati sādhakaḥ varadābhayadhāriṇyaḥ pradhānatanavaḥ striyaḥ añjaliñcārghyavat kṛtvā paramīkaraṇaṃ bhavet hṛdayaṃ madhyamānāmā tarjanībhiḥ smṛtaṃ śiraḥ daśabhiḥ kavacaṃ proktaṃ tisṛbhirnetramīritam diśastenaiva badhnīyāt choṭikābhiḥ samantataḥ smaraṇāt kālikā devī sarvabandhavimocinī brahmāṇī devagandharvasevitā śivagehinī sādhakasya kṣaṇaṃ dhyānāt pratyakṣā suravanditā śatakoṭimukhenāpi pañcabhiśca kathaṃ priye ādau mātā tathā guptā māgurītyabhidhīyate mama prabhutvamāpannā mama mātā yaśasvinī ityuktvā śaṅkaro mohāt mūrcchitaḥ punarudgataḥ

jāto'sau śaṅkaro devyāḥ pādapadmaṃ samāśritaḥ kevalaṃ dhyānayogena sarvasiddhimupālabhet prayogaprabhavā devī prasanna bhaktavatsalā sahasraṃ parijapyaitat sandhyāyāṃ ravivāsare sahasraṃ parijapyeta vipulāṃ kavitāṃ labhet raktapuṣpaśatenāpi maṇḍite kujavāsare sampūjya rājasammānaṃ kujavāre niśārdhake ravau vāre trayodaśyāṃ haviṣyāśī jitendriyaḥ putradātā niśābhāge dharapatnīsāhayavān dīrghamāyurvaśakaraṃ putraṃ saṃlabhate'cirāt śatamaṣṭottaraṃ mantraṃ dhārayettilakaṃ yadi paranārīratā ye vā japanti paścimāmukhāḥ catuṣpathe sahasrārdhaṃ muktakeśo digambaraḥ acalāṃ kamalāṃ labdhvā sukhaṃ prāpnoti bhūtale japettu kālikādhyānādaṣṭādhikaśataṃ niśi matsyāśī nityamāṃsāśi rātrau paścimadiṅmukhaḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ tacchaturyamavallabhaḥ aṣṭau dināni labhyeta kanyāṃ śīlaguṇānvitām sahasrārdhapramāṇena dhanadena samo bhavet catuṣpathe mahārogānmukto rogī bhaved dhruvam tasya dāridryasaṃnyāsaṃ karoti japamastake viśālayā rājamānā triṃśallocanamālayā khaḍgabāṇagadāśūlaśaṅkhacakrabhuśuṇḍibhṛt madhukaiṭabhayoryuddhe yaiṣā sā tāmasī śivā raktamadhyā raktadehā nīlajaṅghorujānukā

aṣṭādaśabhujā pūjyā sā sahasrabhujā raṇe akṣamālāṃ tu muṣalaṃ bāṇāsiṃ kuliśaṃ gadām śaktidaṇḍacarmapāśaṃ pānapātraṃ kamaṇḍalum smartavyā stutikālādau mahiṣāsuramardinī evaṃ dhyātvā naro nityaṃ labhetepsitamātmanaḥ sākṣāt sarasvatī proktā śumbhāsuranibarhiṇī śaṅkhaghaṇṭālāṅgalañca kārmukañca tathā param punastārañca vārāhī caṇḍīmantraḥ samīritaḥ iti śrīmajjñānānandaparamahaṃsaviracite kaulāvalīnirṇaye viṃśollāsaḥ caturthāśramiṇāṃ madhye avadhūtāśramo mahān yadi na syāttadā caiva śṛṇu yat kathayāmi te tadājñayā vimuktaḥ syāttāṃ sampūjya kulāntare nirdvandvo nirahaṅkāraḥ śuddhanāḍījitendriyaḥ baddhapadmāsano yogī yogaṃ yuñjīta yatnataḥ aṅguṣṭhau tu nibadhnīyāddhastābhyāṃ vyutkrameṇa tu gudāttu dvyaṅgulādūrdhvamadhomeḍhrāttu dvyaṅgulam kandamasti śarīre'smin puṇyāpuṇyavivarjitaḥ jīvastu mūlacakre'smin adhaḥprāṇaścaratyasau tatra nāḍyaḥ samutpannāḥ sahasrāṇāṃ dvisaptatiḥ iḍā ca piṅgalā caiva vāmadakṣiṇataḥ sthite pṛṣṭhamadhyagatā sā tu saha mūrdhni vyavasthitā muktimārge sadā guptā meḍhramūrdhni vyavasthitā pañcavarṇojjvalā devī pañcabhūtanivāsinī pūrayitvā tu vicinnā citrā sā granthirūpiṇī tasyā madhye brahmanāḍī mṛṇālatanturūpiṇī

gudameḍrāntare granthi suṣumnā sandhiruttamā suvarṇābhaṃ vādisāntaṃ hemavarṇaṃ suśobhanam taruṇāruṇasaṅkāśāṃ śūlakhaṭvāṅgakau tataḥ dugdhābhāṃ saṃsthitāṃ dhyāyet ḍākinīṃ locanatrayām apānākhyaṃ hi kandarpaṃ ādhāre ca trikoṇake bandhūkapuṣpasaṅkāśaṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabham tasyordhve kuṇḍalī śaktiraṣṭadhā kuṇḍalākṛtiḥ adhovaktrasthitādevī ūrdhvapucchā'tiśobhanā sā ca vidyullatākārā mṛṇālatantusannibhā brahmadvāramukhaṃ nityaṃ mukhenāvṛtya tiṣṭhati mukhena śvāsaṃ praviṣṭā brahmarandhraṃ mukhaṃ tadā nānyaḥ panthā dvitīyo'sti śarīre paramasya ca adhovaktrāṇi padmāni mūlādīni yathākramāt caturaṅgulavistāraṃ kandamūlaṃ khagāṇḍavat evaṃ dhyātvā ca vīrendraḥ sthiracittaḥ sthirendriyaḥ nava dvārāṇi saṃyamya kukṣimāpūrya vāyunā vāyunā bhidya tadvaktraṃ ūrdhvavaktraṃ tu kārayet ullāsojjvalakārasya śikhā yāti samujjvalā ūrdhvaṃ bhittvā tu liṅgaṃ vai itaraṃ puṣkaraṃ tataḥ nṝṇāmete ṣaḍguṇāḥ sambhavanti paṭutvamārogyamadīnatā ca svādhiṣṭhānaṃ mahāpadmaṃ liṅgamūle rasacchadam sindūraprasphuradvarṇairbādilāntaiśca maṇḍitam dadhānāṃ śyāmavarṇāñca rākiṇīṃ tritayānvitām vicintya sthiracittena adhiṣṭhānaṃ prabhedayet

suciraṃ jīvati vītamṛtyubhītiḥ dṛḍharuddho ghanatāñca śītaraśmiḥ padmamadhye sthitaṃ śuddhaṃ vidyutābhaṃ trikoṇakam raktavarṇaṃ caturvaktraṃ dadhatañca trilocanam brahmasattvākṣamoṅkāraṃ sthitaṃ nābheradhaḥ sadā vidyutpuñjasphuradvarṇairḍādiphāntaiśca maṇḍitam mānasaṃ saṃvibhāvyātha bhedayettadanantaram hāniścākhiladuḥkharogaśamanaṃ kālasya vā vañcanam drutasvarṇaprabhāvarṇaiḥ kādiṭhāntaiśca maṇḍitam abhayaṃ ḍamaruṃ śūlaṃ pāśañca karapaṅkajaiḥ tatraivāṅguṣṭhamātmānaṃ pradīpakalikopamam śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśaṃ vāṇīlakṣmīvibhūṣitam pītāmbaradharaṃ śāntaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam prabhedayettataḥ paścāt sādhakaḥ sthiramānasaḥ rdūrādeva ca darśanañca khagatiḥ syādyoginīmelanam tadante vyomabījañca śuklaṃ haimagajasthitam ākāśasahitaṃ padmaṃ śākinīṃ paricintayet pāśāṅkuśau pustakañca jñānamudrāñca dhāriṇīm ardhanārīśvaraṃ devaṃ nānāmaṇivibhūṣitam dhyātvaivaṃ cakrarājaṃ tu bhedayet sādhakottamaḥ kṣitau ciraṃ jīvati vītamṛtyuḥ stadīyaṃ sāmarthyaṃ śamayitumalaṃ nāpi gaṇapaḥ vidyutkoṭiprabhaṃ cakraṃ bhruvorūrdhve manonmanī yonimadhye sthitaṃ liṅgamitaraṃ taruṇāruṇam bindusthāṃ hākinīṃ śukramedomajjāsvarūpiṇīm

cāpaṃ mudrāṃ dadhānāñca śuklāṃ netratrayānvitām oṅkārajyotiṣaṃ kalpapradīpābhaṃ jaganmayam tataḥ saṅkṣobhaṇadvāre dhyāyet padmaṃ suśobhanam tatra bindunilaye ca dūrato darśanaśravaṇayoḥ samarthatā gamanañca pure pareṣāṃ punarutthānamapyaho mṛtasya muḍuśreṇīṃ viṣṇorapi padamuḍūnāmapi patim bhavatyeva na sandeho'pyatha syāt sādhakasya ca makārabindurūpeṇa tadūrdhve candramaṇḍalam cetasā samprapaśyanti nādānte vṛṣabhadhvajam vyāghrāmbaraṃ tu tanmadhye adhomukhaṃ saśaktikam prasannavadanaṃ śāntaṃ sarpayajñopavītinam nānyat paśyanti tatraiva antaraṃ vṛṣabhadhvajam tatra saṃsthaṃ manaḥ kṛtvā taddhyānamīśvaraṃ viduḥ śaṅkhinīnālaṃ saṃsthāpyavyāptiśūnyaṃ vibharti yaḥ candanodyānamadhyasthaṃ vedikāṃ tu tadantare sravantamamṛtaṃ nityaṃ devyaṅge kamalāntare sphuradraśmijālaḥ sudhāṃśuḥ samāste surairapyagamyaṃ sugopyaṃ suyatnāt saudhīṃ dhārāṃ vimuñcannabhimata phalado yogināṃ yogagamyaḥ kartuṃ hartuṃ syācca śaktiḥ samagrā vādhaściraṃ jīvati mṛtyumuktaḥ sūkṣmatvāt sadṛśī nirantaragalatpīyūṣadhārādharā sūkṣmatvāt sadṛśī trilokajananī yā dvādaśārkaprabhā nityānandapadasthaloruvigaladdhārā nirālambanā keciddhaṃsapadaṃ nirañjanapadaṃ kecinnirālambanam

dhyāyeccaitanyarūpāmabhimataphalasamprāptaye śaktimādyām hākinyādyāḥ samastāḥ kamalajapadagāṃ tarpayet kuṇḍalīṃ tām iḍā ca piṅgalā caiva suṣumnānilayaṃ vrajet candramārgeṇa vāyuñca pibettañca śanaiḥ śanaiḥ sūryamārge pibedvāyuṃ candramārgeṇa recayet dhyātvā tacca padaṃ tu sādhakavaraiḥ dūrīkṛtaścāntakaḥ jarāmaraṇaduḥkhādyairmucyate bhavasāgarāt punaḥ pralīyate yasyāṃ kālāgnyādiśivāntakam tasyāstu bandhamātreṇa tannāsti yanna sādhayet nāsau tatphalapātrañca satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ dagdhāḥ santrāsitā hīnā malināśca tiraskṛtāḥ vṛddhā bālāstathā prauḍhāstathā yauvanagarvitāḥ aṃśakena vihīnāśca khaṇḍaśaḥ śatadhā kṛtāḥ siddhimokṣapradāḥ sarve sādhakena niyojitāḥ tattat sidhyatyasandeho yonimudrānibandhanāt tato'dhikārī bhavati tantre'smin sādhakottamaḥ nāsau lipyati pāpena yonimudrānibandhanāt ayāsājjāyate siddhirabhyāsānmokṣamāpnuyāt mantrāṇāṃ siddhirabhyāsādabhyāsādvāyusādhanam etadbhedaṃ vijānāti sa yāti paramaṃ padam dineśāṅgulimānena tadardhañcopavāsataḥ ata ūrdhvaṃ vahedvāyustriguṇaṃ yadi daivatam śarīrasamatāṃ nītvā nyūnaṃ vā sādhakottamaḥ yojayitvā tato jīvaṃ kuṇḍalyā sahitaṃ sudhīḥ pīyate khādyate yattu tatsarvaṃ kuṇḍalīmukhe

bhikṣā kāryā na ca svārthaṃ kuṇḍalyāḥ prakṛteḥ punaḥ avadhūtāśrame sthitvā bhairavānandatatparaḥ tantramantrārcanaṃ sarvaṃ mayi jātaṃ na cānyathā raktamālyāmbaradharo hetuyuktaḥ sadā bhavet yena kenāpi veśena yena kenā'pyalakṣitaḥ unmattamukajaḍavat virale lokamadhyage nānāveśadharo yogī vicarettu mahītale sarvabhakṣo yathā vahnistathā yogī sadā śuciḥ kṣīyate na ca pāpena badhyate na ca janmanā tathā jñānaparo yogī krīḍannindriyapannagaiḥ gandhaṃ puṣpañca tāmbulaṃ naivedyaṃ yatra yadbhavet ātmanyeva samāyojya devīrūpakuleśvaraḥ pūrṇo'haṃ bhairavaścāhaṃ nityānando'hamavyayaḥ sarvaśāstrābhiyukto'haṃ sarvamantrārthapāsyāḥ ānandarūpavān bhūtvā sarveṣāṃ priyakāraka cirājjātadhūto dvitīyo maheśaḥ virakto'vadhūto dvitīyo maheśaḥ kaulo dharmaḥ paramagahano yogināmapyagamyaḥ iti śrīmajjñānānandaparamahaṃsaviracite kaulāvalīnirṇaye ekaviṃśollāsaḥ samāptaḥ
